Chapter 445


However, Li Fan's face was full of doubt. "Would others really transfer their contribution points so easily? I don't think so."

"It would be better if they don't! This way, we can use it as an excuse to get rid of some of them, so they stop pestering me!" He Zhenghao thought to himself, but he said aloud, "Senior, don't worry. Too many cultivators have been chasing me recently to ask about this. Even if only a small portion is willing to transfer their contribution points for you to handle, it will still be a considerable amount."

"Moreover, once Senior displays his divine abilities and returns the contribution points with interest, the results will speak louder than words. Afterward, there will definitely be more and more people willing to rely on Senior."

He Zhenghao was full of confidence.

Li Fan pondered for a moment, pretending to think it over.

Not long after, he slowly nodded, "It just so happens that I've been seeing many new and interesting techniques in the Tianxuan Mirror recently, and I'm itching to try them out. Moreover, in this era of cultivation, it's true that everything relies on contribution points."

"If you can really gather a significant amount of contribution points, I don't mind making it grow several times over."

Hearing Li Fan's casual words, He Zhenghao's eyes lit up.

He thought for a moment and quickly urged, "No need for so much, no need for so much!"

"You must know, if it can increase by half in a year, people will flock to hand over their contribution points to Senior!""As for the rest, Senior can keep it for yourself as a reward."

"Of course, if you could share some of the profits with me as a token of appreciation, that would be even better!"

He Zhenghao said happily.

"Satisfied with just a 50% return in a year?" Li Fan was initially surprised, then nodded, "That works too."

"Let's tentatively decide on this for now. You go and contact your friends."

"Remember, you must choose those who you know well. Contribution points from cultivators with unknown backgrounds should not be accepted."

After giving a few more instructions, He Zhenghao excitedly took out the sealed communication talisman and began replying to each person.

"Fellow Daoist Zhang, there's a great opportunity for wealth in front of you. Would you like to give it a try?"

...

"The first batch of contribution points probably won't be much, but that's okay."

"If they don't believe it the first time, they might hesitate the second time."

"By the third or fourth time, when they see others making a fortune while they miss out on the opportunity."

"By the fifth time, they'll be begging to hand over their contribution points."

Watching the busy He Zhenghao, Li Fan thought to himself.

Don't misunderstand.

Although what Li Fan is doing in this world looks very much like some kind of scam, in reality...

Li Fan really does have the ability to lead everyone to make big money.

Not to mention the huge profits he could easily gain by speculating on Lingwu grass.

Simply using the information he gathered during his endless cycles of reincarnation, buying low and selling high, making a 50% profit each year was child's play.

If certain gifted individuals can do it, there's no way Li Fan, an anomaly in this cycle of reincarnation, couldn't.

If that were the case, Li Fan might as well give up on seeking immortality and obediently return to Great Xuan to be a mortal Grandmaster for the rest of his life.

In short, increasing assets is not difficult at all for Li Fan, who holds so much advanced information.

Of course, there are certain limitations.

For example, the overall scale of assets he controls shouldn't be too large.

And he shouldn't attract the direct intervention of powers on the level of the Tianxuan Mirror.

But in reality, Li Fan never planned to make too much noise.

His goal was simply to gather a manageable group of followers while improving his cultivation through the [Mountain Sitting] technique.

And when the expansion became too overwhelming and was beyond Li Fan's control...

Crimson flames will engulf the ocean, and Ink-like darkness will consume the world.

That would be the end of it.

With all the creditors dead, naturally, there would be no debts to settle.

He could then rightfully claim all those contribution points as his own.

This is the preliminary plan.

As for the details, he'll take it step by step.

After contacting his friends, He Zhenghao went to Ten Thousand Immortal Island to meet with his fellow Daoists.

It wasn't until most of the day had passed that he returned with a beaming face.

He also brought back over 200,000 contribution points.

As expected, when He Zhenghao stated his request, most of the cultivators backed out.

After all, no one's contribution points are easy to come by.

It's one thing to receive guidance from an 'Ancient Heavenly Mechanism Sect Cultivator', but to actually hand over their contribution points...

Few were willing to do that.

The 200,000 contribution points gathered this time mainly came from a cultivator named Zhou Peng, who alone contributed 50,000, taking up the majority.

Excluding him, the rest of the contributors averaged less than 5,000 points each.

Even so, He Zhenghao was extremely excited at this moment.

He solemnly transferred the 230,000 contribution points to Li Fan through the small Tianxuan Mirror.

He also didn't forget to transfer another 100,000 contribution points from his own small vault.

"Senior..."

He Zhenghao opened his mouth to say something but eventually held back.

He simply looked at Li Fan with a burning gaze.

"50,000 contribution points in a year is no big deal. Rest assured!" Li Fan said as he tossed a communication talisman to He Zhenghao. "If there's anything urgent, I'll contact you. Otherwise, don't disturb me!"

He Zhenghao nodded repeatedly, excitedly holding onto the communication talisman.

Li Fan waved him off and returned to Ten Thousand Immortal Island.

"There shouldn't be any problems..."

He Zhenghao muttered to himself.

Now that the initial excitement had passed, a more rational He Zhenghao couldn't help but feel uneasy.

But now that the matter has been settled, he can only pray that this senior from the Heavenly Mechanism Sect won't make any mistakes.

Inside the Tianxuan Mirror.

Li Fan released several scrolls of Lan Xiao's posthumous works.

While procuring the necessary materials for the empire, he patiently waited.

Sure enough, three days later, the Oracle contacted Li Fan to express his gratitude.

"I still have some rare books here, but I need Senior to do me a small favor." Li Fan said with a smile.

"Oh?" The Oracle was slightly surprised but still listened with interest to Li Fan's request.

"Interesting." It seemed that this fellow was involved in something shady.

But the Oracle didn't care about that.

In this world, who doesn't have some secrets?

With a gentle wave of his dust whisk, the Oracle concealed his aura and quietly arrived at Ten Thousand Immortal Island.

After meeting with Li Fan, the two flew directly toward the island where the empire's people were located.

In a secret chamber, the Empire's imperial Saint Master, [Qing], who was concentrating on drawing something, suddenly stood up and looked in the direction where Li Fan was coming from, her expression serious.

When Li Fan and the Oracle landed on the island, her face changed slightly.

"The Federation Of All World's indeed has some weight."

Chapter 446


Before [Qing] could speak, the Oracle swung his dust whisk.

The sky darkened, and a talisman filled with golden characters appeared instantly above the island.

It blotted out the sky and the sun, as if it was about to suppress everyone in the Empire the next moment.

Qing's expression changed drastically. Two blue beams of light shot up into the sky like sharp blades.

They collided with the massive talisman.

The golden talisman was torn apart, revealing the sky once again.

However, the golden characters on the talisman didn't disappear.

Instead, they floated down, drifting towards the ground.

Blades of light continuously emerged from Qing's body.

Tianyang, however, firmly believed that his master and senior brothers would return. Afraid they wouldn't find him upon their return, Tianyang stayed in the cave mansion, refusing to leave.

But years later, outsiders broke into the cave mansion. Tianyang wanted to resist but was no match for them. He barely managed to survive thanks to the magical artifacts left behind by his senior brothers before they departed.

After that, young Tianyang began a wandering life in the world of immortal cultivation.

Tianyang estimated that without any extraordinary encounters, reaching the Golden Core stage would be his limit.

It wasn’t purely for enjoyment but rather to better align with the identity of the [Heavenly Mechanism Sect Cultivator] as an investment master.

Using the [Creation Furnace Art], he suddenly spat out a mouthful of blood and exclaimed, “The Tianxuan Lock of Spirit, the union of Xuan and Huang?!”

At that moment, the Heaven and Earth Divination Dice lost all its brilliance and stopped spinning, with all twenty facets now pitch black.

Li Fan collapsed weakly to the ground, looking utterly drained.

The crowd in the Martial Hall erupted in shock.

No one could remain calm after hearing the words "The Tianxuan Lock of Spirit, the union of Xuan and Huang." The implications were simply too terrifying.

At that moment, a figure dressed in black, whose face was obscured, appeared out of thin air. He ignored the gravely injured Li Fan and instead looked at Gongsun Qixuan.

“Daoist Gongsun…” The figure clearly sought Gongsun Qixuan’s opinion.

He suspected that this cultivator, Li Fan, might just be putting on a show. But, not being proficient in deduction arts himself, and with Li Fan allegedly being an ancient cultivator who had fallen into slumber in ancient times, there was a possibility that ancient methods differed from modern ones.

Moreover, the conclusion Li Fan had deduced was indeed alarming.

To be cautious, the figure decided to defer to an expert’s judgment.

Gongsun Qixuan’s lips moved as he silently repeated the words Li Fan had just deduced. His expression grew increasingly grim.

A painting appeared in front of him, slowly unfurling. The canvas was originally blank, but as Gongsun Qixuan waved his hand like a brush, colors began to fill the scene. Something seemed to be forming on the painting.

However, the act of creating this painting seemed to be a huge drain on Gongsun Qixuan’s strength. Already looking a bit sickly, his condition worsened as his back began to hunch under an invisible weight, slowing his movements.

Finally, as the image on the painting became clearer, Gongsun Qixuan’s hand trembled violently. He seemed to encounter an immense force, unable to complete the final stroke no matter how hard he tried.

A look of frustration crossed Gongsun Qixuan’s face. He bit his tongue and spat out a mouthful of blood. As the blood splattered into the air, he clenched his fists and forcefully completed the painting, using his blood as ink and his fists as brushes.

When everyone in the Martial Hall, including Gongsun Qixuan himself, turned to see the content of the painting, a brilliant green light burst from the canvas, flooding the hall and spreading in all directions.

The first to be hit was Gongsun Qixuan himself. Already exhausted from forcibly completing the deduction, he had no strength left to defend himself. Caught off guard, he was struck head-on.

"Ah!"

A scream of agony escaped from Gongsun Qixuan as his body dissolved into the green light. Only a trace of black mist remained, drifting away to an unknown destination.

“Damn it, a backlash from the Heavenly Mysteries?!”

“Elder Gongsun?!”

The sudden turn of events left the cultivators in the Martial Hall in utter shock.

But soon, they had their own problems to worry about.

The green light spread like a tide, and everything it touched—whether strange boulders or living creatures—disappeared without a trace, as if melting into water.

The black-robed cultivator’s face darkened as he tried to stop the green light’s spread, but to no avail. The source of this green energy was mysterious and impossible to resist. Left with no other choice, he was forced to retreat.

In mere moments, the public trial had turned into a race to see who could escape fastest.

Amidst the desperate screams of the cultivators, the scene grew more chaotic and terrifying.

The moment Li Fan saw the familiar green light from Gongsun Qixuan’s deduction painting, he knew something had gone terribly wrong.

Although he wasn’t sure what had triggered it, or why Gongsun Qixuan’s deduction had summoned the power of the [Mysterious Net], Li Fan didn’t hesitate to slip away unnoticed, blending in with the panicking crowd as they fled from the Martial Hall.

The strange phenomena at the Martial Hall on Ten Thousand Immortal Island quickly caught the attention of other cultivators on the island. The once magnificent building trembled before collapsing in a series of violent shakes.

Just as the green light threatened to continue spreading outward, a rainbow beam of light shot down from the sky, descending upon Ten Thousand Immortal Island.

Countless transparent runes surged from the rainbow light, forming a massive net that captured the dispersing green light.

The crisis was swiftly resolved.

Amidst the fleeing crowd, Li Fan bowed his head slightly, for the newcomer was none other than Lu Xichan, the chief formation master of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance’s Strategy Formation Hall!

Li Fan cooperated fully throughout.

Inside the isolated dark room, cut off from the outside world, he could not know what was happening on Ten Thousand Immortal Island.

So, Li Fan closed his eyes and began meditating.

Like a hungry wolf encountering prey, he sensed that there must be some earth-shattering secret involved in this event.

If they could uncover it...

"Boss, could this be a great opportunity for us to make a name for ourselves?" Li Fan asked, pretending to suddenly realize something.

"Indeed! We must find out the reason for her visit to Congyun Sea!" the stone-faced man said in a serious tone.

"What did he say?" the stone-faced man asked in a serious tone.

"One million contribution points, flat rate!" Li Fan hesitated for a moment, then said in a low voice.

As a result, many cultivators began to flock to Li Fan.

Unable to access the Tianxuan Mirror and seeking peace, Li Fan decided to hide at the Qianli Hall.

Chapter 466


Jiao Xiuyuan transformed himself into thousands of puppets, single-handedly supporting the vast commercial organization known as Qianli Hall, which spanned across various locations of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance.

In various ruins and desolate wildernesses with few people, one might catch a glimpse of his presence.

He even had the power to stir up great disturbances in the Xuanhuang Realm.

There was a certain flavor of "entering the Dao through business" about him.

However, his luck seemed to be somewhat unfortunate.

Though he claimed he never made a losing deal, from Li Fan's experience with him, it appeared Jiao Xiuyuan often lost money in business.

For instance, when Li Fan first met him, he had stockpiled a large number of Concealment Talismans, but due to the incident with Five Elements Grand Cave Heaven, the price of the talismans plummeted.

Later, he painstakingly unearthed a few Minor Medicine King Cauldrons, and if he had waited for the return of the "True Medicine King Cauldron", he would have surely made a fortune.

But it was as if he was destined not to be that lucky. He sold all of those minor cauldrons early on at a low price.

"Perhaps he truly never made a loss, but it seems he always missed the big opportunities to get rich.""Even in the previous life, when he partnered with me in the business of Spirit Mist Grass, a moment of greed caused him to hesitate too long, and the vast wealth he had in hand vanished in an instant."

"Only in this life has he truly profited. I wonder if something is going to change for him."

The items on the shelves were diverse: talismans, formation diagrams, pills, and more, all available.

Li Fan paid special attention to the older-looking items.

Most of them were badly damaged, filled with the marks of history.

Scrolls, various ornaments, and artifacts that had long lost their spiritual energy filled the shelves.

Li Fan's gaze swept across them one by one.

Suddenly, he stopped at an ancient painting.

His expression became slightly serious as he carefully removed the scroll and slowly unrolled it.

It wasn’t that the painting itself was special, but rather its content that caught Li Fan's attention.

The painting depicted a grand and magnificent sect entrance.

The sky and earth seemed boundless, with dozens of cultivators standing in the clouds, pointing into the distance.

Among the sea of clouds, the towering buildings at the mountain's peak were faintly visible.

"Luan Birds" and "Jiaolong Dragons", along with other exotic beasts, wandered among the mountains.

In the square at the foot of the mountain, hundreds of young disciples, still innocent in appearance, stood.

They looked up at the cultivators in the sky, their faces full of excitement and admiration.

It truly depicted a thriving scene of a flourishing sect!

But...

Li Fan had seen this sect before, and it was the complete opposite of the prosperity in the painting.

The ground was littered with corpses, rivers of blood flowed.

The sect's entrance was in ruins, reduced to rubble.

It was the very scene he saw at the bottom of the Void Abyss after the dense fog had cleared during his time in the Great Xuan.

The words "Immortal Dao is dead" carved on the cliff had deeply shaken Li Fan at the time.

Now, Li Fan knew that this was undoubtedly the aftermath of the great calamity that occurred when the disciples of the sect slaughtered each other after the arrival of the Disaster of incompatibility Of cultivating same technique.

"Which sect was this? Why did I see this place back then?"

It was known that the scene each person saw at the bottom of the Void Abyss was different.

The fact that Li Fan saw this ruined sect might have been a coincidence.

But Li Fan believed there might be some kind of guidance in it.

After carefully storing away the painting, Li Fan continued to browse the shelves but found nothing else of value.

It wasn’t due to any strange habit, but rather to take this rare opportunity to study Jiao Xiuyuan's Thousand Puppet Dao.

Although Profound True Spirit Transformation was already an astonishing divine art, it still had some small flaws.

Derived from the Stealing Sky and changing the Sun Technique, it could only maintain one clone at a time, which was a bit disappointing.

If he could combine it with the Thousand Puppet Dao and take it a step further...

"Thousands of avatars, indistinguishable from the real."

As Li Fan's imagination ran wild, his hands moved without hesitation.

"Completely identical to the real body, even using divine sense to penetrate and perceive would find no difference."

"The control core seems to be in the head, glowing with a blue light similar to the Dao Derivation Stone."

"I’ve seen the remains of puppets before—dry and yellow like decaying wood. Could it be that Jiao Xiuyuan’s puppet avatars are made from some special type of wood?"

Jiao Xiuyuan glanced at Li Fan and guessed the reason for his silence.

In a flash, he was at the shelves, checking things over, and exclaimed, "Why does it look like a painting is missing?"

Fortunately, it wasn’t flesh and blood flying everywhere, but just scattered wood shavings.

"Uh, Daoist Jiao, I forgot to mention earlier. When you lost consciousness, I noticed that the painting was quite nice, so I put it away." At this moment, Li Fan finally spoke.

"But conversely, for their next advancement, they must seek out even more dangerous calamities."

"However, disasters in this world are innumerable, and even heaven and earth may perish in a calamity. How can Du'e Sect cultivators guarantee they will always survive?"

"When they sense they may not survive their next catastrophe, they use a secret method to hide themselves from the world temporarily."

"They leave behind various means, waiting for someone capable of resolving the calamity to appear."

"That person is known as the 'One Destined for Calamity'!"

Jiao Xiuyuan slowly explained.

Upon hearing this, Li Fan frowned deeply. "Such a cultivation method exists? So, I’ve been marked by some Du'e Sect cultivator? Jiao Daoist, is there any way to break this?"

Jiao Xiuyuan waved his hand dismissively. "Don’t be so tense! Thousands of years have passed, who knows if the Du'e Sect cultivator who left this painting is even still alive?"

"Besides, even if he is, there’s no need for concern. To survive his calamity, he will have to rely on you completely. Until he has passed through it, he won’t harm you."

"And if you help him survive the disaster, he will owe you a great debt. The Du'e Sect has always adhered to this rule. Otherwise, who would ever help them play such a game?"

"Moreover, think about it. The disaster he couldn’t overcome, yet you can. By then, your strength will surpass his, and he’ll be too relieved to survive to even think of opposing you."

Jiao Xiuyuan dismissed Li Fan's worries, but began studying him with renewed interest.

"Li Fan Daoist, to be sensed as the 'One Destined for Calamity' by a Du'e Sect cultivator, your future must be boundless!"

Jiao Xiuyuan’s words brought some comfort to Li Fan, but a sense of unease still lingered in his heart.

Judging from the aid provided in the Abyss of Ruin, that Du'e Sect cultivator was likely still alive.

Though it was unlikely they were monitoring his every move, long-term observation might reveal something eventually.

"It seems I’ll need to find a way to resolve this hidden threat," Li Fan thought to himself.

"Daoist, your knowledge is truly vast, even understanding these ancient sect secrets so thoroughly. I am deeply impressed!"

"By the way, how many contribution points for this painting? I’ll buy it. I can’t let you make a losing deal!"

Though his mind was elsewhere, Li Fan's demeanor remained perfectly calm as he spoke to Jiao Xiuyuan.

Unlike the spiritual teas he usually drank, this one didn’t benefit his cultivation, spiritual power, or divine sense. Instead, he felt a warm current flow through his body, improving and strengthening his physique.

As someone who cultivated the "Creation Furnace Technique," Li Fan was naturally very familiar with such sensations.

It was strikingly similar to the hidden power of the human body.

"This is Supreme Dragon Whisker Tea. If Fellow Daoist likes it, I’ll send you some," Qing said with a smile.

But with so many similar bird species in the world, he couldn’t be sure.

He simply accepted it and began to inspect its contents.

Unexpectedly, his divine sense was blocked, and he failed to examine it.

Only when the Qingluan bird lazily glanced at Li Fan and flapped its wings did he manage to see inside.

Chapter 469


In a storage space ten zhang long, four zhang wide, and three zhang high, rows of redwood shelves were neatly arranged.

On the shelves, items resembling books were categorized and piled up.

Li Fan, with a thought, took one of them.

After observing it in his hand for a moment, Li Fan realized that these so-called “books” were alive.

Although they remained still, Li Fan keenly sensed the unique aura of a living being from them.

Li Fan instantly understood that while they were inside the storage ring, they were in a dormant state similar to death. But once they left the storage ring and came into contact with the outside world, they regained their vitality.

Opening the "book," rays of light shot out from the pages and gathered in the air.

In the light, there were dense characters and illustrations.

It was written in the common script of the Xuanhuang Realm. Li Fan carefully examined it and discovered that it contained information about the exotic beast "Dark Ancient Mantis". From its body structure, living habits, the value of each part of its body, to the methods of breeding and reproduction—everything was detailed. It was an all-encompassing encyclopedia.

Li Fan turned another page, and the light shifted and reformed.This time, it was information about the exotic beast Ink Spirit Fish.

Li Fan switched to another book and found that it also recorded information about different exotic beasts.

“In our world, there is a type of exotic beast called 'Bookworms'. They feed on words and images. Through special means, they can be made into books, which allow them to reproduce the texts and images they have consumed, achieving large-scale data storage,” Qing explained to Li Fan.

“This storage ring contains the empire’s millennia of research on exotic beasts. It includes all the information about the exotic beasts in our world—except for a few rare species, whose data will be supplemented during the final transaction.”

Li Fan nodded slowly and carefully examined a few more books before solemnly putting the storage ring away.

“Having data alone isn’t enough; it must be matched with physical entities. This is the second part of the empire’s transaction.” Qing took out a red square wooden box and handed it to Li Fan.

Slightly sensing it with his spiritual sense, Li Fan understood the function of the wooden box.

It appeared no bigger than the size of a palm, but inside it was divided into countless separate spaces.

In each space, there were ten exotic beasts of the same kind.

They seemed to be frozen, all motionless.

Li Fan could tell that these exotic beasts still retained their life signs.

Aside from the adult beasts, Li Fan also found many sleeping juveniles in the spaces.

There were embryos, eggs, or tiny young creatures.

“This is the Sealed Life Treasure Box, containing the exotic beasts corresponding to the data in the first storage ring.”

A trace of pride flashed across Qing's face. “With these two storage rings, as long as you find the right environment, large-scale cultivation of exotic beasts can be achieved again.”

“With enough resources invested, it wouldn’t be difficult to recreate the empire’s current grand scene.”

Li Fan stored the Sealed Life Treasure Box away, saying with satisfaction, “With the contents of these two storage rings, I can report back to the organization. However…”

Li Fan’s tone shifted. “Although these items are indeed valuable, they don’t contribute much to actual combat strength. Our Federation Of all Worlds still hopes you can provide some technical support that would be useful in the ongoing battle against the Xuanhuang Realm.”

“For example, the beast-like armor that this young brother demonstrated earlier.”

Li Fan pointed at Li Chenfeng, his eyes intense as he looked at Qing.

Qing smiled and said, “I figured that’s what you were after with such a generous exchange.”

“This just so happens to be the third part of our transaction, and the final portion for now.”

Qing extended her right hand, and a blood-red, pulsating round bead instantly floated above her palm.

“This is the Beast Soul Bead. Even an ordinary mortal, as long as they can withstand the beast soul sealed within, can absorb it and summon the Beast God Armor, unleashing combat power equivalent to that of the exotic beast.”

Qing handed over another storage ring.

This one, however, bore no special patterns—it was just an ordinary ring.

“This ring contains a thousand Beast Soul Beads. Five hundred of them contain exotic beasts with strength equivalent to the Foundation Establishment stage cultivators. Another four hundred and ninety Beads house beasts with Golden Core-level strength.”

“As for the remaining nine, they seal the souls of Scarlet Mystic Whales, beasts comparable to Nascent Soul cultivators.”

“And the last one…”

Qing hesitated for a moment before continuing, “It was made from the essence of the Nine-Headed Divine Bird.”

“In theory, it can unleash power equivalent to a Soul Transformation stage cultivator. But the Nine-Headed Bird is inherently ferocious. Even after thousands of years of death, its violent aura remains. Although the empire succeeded in using it to craft a few Beast Soul Beads, no one has survived the refining process so far. Those who tried either went mad or died.”

“If the Federation wants to attempt it, I suggest choosing someone with extraordinary willpower.”

“Oh, and one more thing. The power of the exotic beasts clashes with a cultivator’s spiritual energy. The stronger the cultivator, the more resistance they face when refining the Beast Soul Beads. To maximize its potential, it’s best used on ordinary mortals.”

Qing added.

“Excellent!” A hint of joy appeared on Li Fan's face.

“Our Federation Of all Worlds appreciates your sincerity! I’m sure once I report back, deeper cooperation will soon follow.”

“Haha, the organization is eager to learn the method of crafting Beast Soul Beads and the art of controlling beasts,” Li Fan said.

Qing’s expression remained unchanged as she replied solemnly, “Once the final transaction is complete, and the empire has fully withdrawn from the Xuanhuang Realm, all of that will be handed over to your Federation.”

“I can’t wait for that day!” Li Fan put away the storage ring containing the thousand Beast Soul Beads.

He left the secret chamber and flew into the sky.

“When I’ve found a suitable base for you, I’ll return for another transaction.”

“I hope that aside from technology, the empire can also provide some manpower support.”

“At that time, we will handle the personnel’s reception and transfer.”

Li Fan transmitted his voice as he looked down at the people of the empire.

“No problem,” Qing readily agreed.

Li Fan nodded and immediately soared into the sky.

Instead of returning to the Ten Thousand Immortal Island, he headed straight to Shenhua Island.

“Junior brother, please stand guard for me.”

The cultivating Tianyang, who was struggling to practice the Sky-Shrouding Palm Secret technique, immediately stopped when he heard Li Fan’s words.

He stood up and began scanning the surroundings with vigilance.

Chapter 470


"The Sealed Life Treasure Box... It seems that the empire indeed inherited the legacy of the Beast Taming Sect back in the day."

Now that Tianyang had reached Soul Transformation stage strength, Li Fan felt reassured enough to review the rewards from this trade with the empire.

Detailed information on various exotic beasts, along with the frozen beast entities in the Sealed Life Treasure Box, might not be of much use to other cultivators. However, for Li Fan, who practiced the Creation Furnace Technique, this was an undeniable treasure trove.

Li Fan could harness and transform the unique abilities of these exotic beasts, one by one, using his technique.

"The beauty of living creatures—nothing surpasses this!"

"The records in the Heavenly Doctor's immortal Codex probably don't capture the full essence of the living beings of this world either!"

With a light flick of his finger, Li Fan summoned all the bookworms from his storage ring.

His spiritual consciousness flipped through the books, and in an instant, countless rays of light and shadows projected into the air of his cave dwelling.

The Dao Derivation Stone in his mind emitted a deep blue glow it had never shown before. Li Fan narrowed his eyes, focusing on engraving the words and images into his memory.

A flood of information rushed in, organizing itself and being stored in the Dao Derivation Stone.Amid the continuous sound of flipping pages, the light and shadows constantly shifted.

After recording everything in a few pages, Li Fan felt a slight headache in his temples.

Taking a short rest and consuming a Dao Enlightenment Pill, he resumed his “reading.”

Over the course of several thousand years, the empire had birthed many unique species. Most of them were creatures that Li Fan had never encountered in the Heavenly Doctor's Codex—nor did they exist in the present Xuanhuang Realm.

Their various strange abilities amazed even the well-traveled Li Fan.

For example, the Wisdom Worm that resided in the human brain and could enhance cognitive abilities; the Mimic Beast, which could perfectly disguise itself after devouring other beings; and the Thousand Spirit Bird, which fed on human emotions.

Each of these creatures opened Li Fan’s eyes to new wonders.

"The All-Encompassing Furnace—this is the true myriad phenomena of living beings!"

Amid Li Fan's amazement, the pages of the books continued to flip.

In a short time, he absorbed the knowledge accumulated over thousands of years by the empire into his mind.

Ten days later.

Li Fan let out a long breath, massaged his aching forehead, and returned the bookworms to his storage ring.

Sensing the concerned gaze of Tianyang, Li Fan waved his hand, signaling that he was fine.

After resting for half a day and recovering some of his energy, Li Fan took out the red wooden box.

According to the information he'd previously seen in the Tianxuan Mirror, this Sealed Life Treasure Box was an exclusive artifact of the Beast Taming Sect from ancient times.

It was said to be crafted from Ten Thousand Transformation Spirit Wood, capable of sealing and preserving living demonic beasts.

With the passage of time over thousands of years, the Ten Thousand Transformation Spirit Tree had nearly gone extinct, making the Sealed Life Treasure Box an exceedingly rare item.

"It seems my intuition was correct."

"The familiar feeling I sensed from that woman in green must have come from the Azure Luan Bird that Xu Ke once encountered in the Fallen Immortal Realm."

"I wonder if that Red-Crowned Crane is still alive."

"Could it be that the founder of the empire, the first to comprehend the Beast Taming Technique, was Xu Ke?"

"According to Li Chenfeng's memories, he has long since passed away. But things may not be as simple as they seem."

Li Fan pondered silently.

"Based on the information currently known, it appears that Xu Ke was the only member of the Beast Taming Sect to enter that small world, thus establishing the empire’s legacy."

"But where did the other members of the Beast Taming Sect go? What about Lu Ya?"

"And why did Emperor Sang Mo come to the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance and become the curator of the Museum Of Divine Treasure?"

"How does all this relate to Mr. Bai's mission from back then?"

There were too many questions that remained unanswered for now.

"Perhaps the next trip to the Fallen Immortal Realm will resolve some of these doubts."

"Soon," Li Fan calculated the time in his heart.

After putting away the Sealing Life Treasure Box, Li Fan took out a Beast Soul Bead at the Foundation Establishment level.

One could say that the empire's generosity this time far exceeded Li Fan’s expectations.

Five hundred Foundation Establishment level, four hundred ninety Golden Core level, and nine Nascent Soul level Beast God Armor warriors—if used wisely, they could certainly cause quite a stir.

Although these were only theoretical combatants, in the current Xuanhuang Realm, the actual combat strength of cultivators was shockingly low.

Aside from a few rare cultivators who specialized in combat techniques, most people would already be considered exceptional if they could use a few offensive and defensive techniques.

The Beast God Armor, with its ability to influence spiritual consciousness, resist most spell attacks, and move with incredible speed, was definitely a deadly weapon to ordinary cultivators.

"The question now is how to use them for maximum benefit. I need to think this through carefully."

Li Fan temporarily set aside this thought, holding a Beast Soul Bead in his hand and pressing it against his forehead.

Suddenly, his vision turned blood-red. In a daze, Li Fan seemed to see a fierce one-eyed hunting leopard lunging toward him.

"Hmph!" Li Fan's mind sharpened like a needle, stabbing toward the leopard.

The leopard let out a mournful cry, and the illusion quickly vanished.

The Beast Soul Bead dissolved into a red liquid, which seemed to have a life of its own, flowing from his forehead toward his limbs and bones.

Li Fan sensed a strange energy trying to infiltrate his body, attempting to modify it.

Unlike the pure enhancement from his Creation Furnace Technique, the Beast God Armor felt more like grafting the power of an exotic beast onto a human.

Although it temporarily strengthened his abilities, his physical body became tainted by the beast’s power and lost its purity.

"Crooked paths, not of the true way."

Li Fan shook his head as the hidden power within his body surged like a flood, instantly expelling the invading beast energy.

The hunting leopard’s wail echoed in his ears again, and the red liquid from the Beast Soul Bead evaporated in an instant.

"It seems this armor is only suitable for mortals who cannot cultivate."

"Or perhaps..."

Li Fan's eyes gleamed with a peculiar light.

He thought of Ye Feipeng from his previous life, who had awakened the Kunpeng bloodline.

"If one already possesses a beast bloodline, they would naturally not fear this kind of contamination."

"In this life, He Zhenghao has been profiting handsomely by following me. He probably no longer cares about that smuggling business."

"As for Su Xiaomei and the others, they are still in the Outer Realm. Without me, they likely wouldn't have had a chance to come here."

Li Fan smiled faintly.

"This life’s grand show wouldn’t be complete without these little ones."

With that, Li Fan rose, bid farewell to Tianyang, concealed his aura, and quietly made his way to the Outer Realm.

First, he arrived at the central volcano of the Outer Realm and observed it for a while.

"Strange..." Li Fan shook his head.

Ever since he first came to the Outer Realm, he had felt something unusual about this volcano. However, each time he carefully investigated, he found nothing out of the ordinary.

As his cultivation grew deeper, his sense of foreboding became stronger.

But he still couldn't pinpoint the cause.

"Perhaps after I reach the Nascent Soul stage, I'll discover something."

Li Fan made a mental note of the matter and then headed straight for Dali Capital City.

Chapter 471


Early Morning, Ye Mansion.

The chubby Ye Feipeng was sound asleep, seemingly dreaming of something particularly pleasant, as his lips curled slightly. He was completely unaware of the black shadow that suddenly appeared beside him.

The shadow waved a hand gently, causing Ye Feipeng’s head to tilt as he instantly fell unconscious. The figure's right hand formed a claw and hovered above Ye Feipeng's head.

After a brief moment, the hand slowly withdrew.

A drop of thick, blackish-red blood appeared in the figure’s palm.

Ye Feipeng, who had looked healthy moments before, suddenly seemed as though he had contracted a severe illness, his face drained of energy.

The drop of blood in the shadow's palm seemed alive, possessing its own consciousness as it continuously squirmed, attempting to escape the figure's grasp.

As the shadow tightened its fingers, the space in which the blood could struggle grew smaller and smaller until, eventually, the blood was entirely absorbed into the figure's body.

The shadow stood still in the night for a long while.

“Pff!”Two menacing bone wings suddenly tore through the figure's back, stretching out behind him.

Threads of flesh clung to the wings, emitting a faint sizzling sound as the flesh grew along the bone spurs, swiftly covering the bare bones.

The bone wings became fuller.

However, under the moonlight, one could still clearly see the constantly writhing flesh on the edges of the wings, giving off a sinister and eerie aura.

“The Kunpeng bloodline…”

A low voice escaped from the shadow’s mouth. Moments later, the figure ripped the wings off from his back.

Surprisingly, there was no blood spurting from the wounds. The struggling flesh at the injury site was swiftly expelled by a surge of pure, vast vitality.

In an instant, the shadow was fully restored to its original state.

“Ancient demon beasts truly possess some mysteries.” The figure murmured as he looked at the still-twitching wings he had torn off.

This shadow was none other than Li Fan.

Upon arriving in the capital of the Da Li Kingdom, the first thing he did was extract a portion of the Kunpeng blood from Ye Feipeng’s body.

While he stored the majority of the blood in a storage ring, he absorbed a small part into his own body.

The power of this bloodline was far more domineering than the beastly forces Li Fan had encountered in the Beast Soul Bead.

If those beast forces were infectious and grafted, then the power of the Kunpeng bloodline was all about devouring and complete assimilation.

“No wonder in my previous life, Ye Feipeng’s behavior and even his thoughts gradually became more like those of a true demonic beast.”

“This is the inevitable consequence of using the power of the Kunpeng bloodline.”

“But…”

Li Fan smiled slightly. “By mimicking it with my Furnace of Creation technique, I don’t have such worries.”

“Kun Devour, Peng Soar, Peng Transformation…”

As Li Fan muttered quietly to himself, his figure in the night twisted and changed. Sometimes he transformed into a whale, other times into a peng, and occasionally into a human with peng wings.

After a long time, Li Fan returned to his original form.

“The Kunpeng blood I used for comprehension is too little. Right now, I can only mimic its form and cannot fully replicate the Kunpeng’s divine powers.”

“But no worries, I have a ready-made blood bank right here.”

Li Fan looked at Ye Feipeng, a peaceful smile spreading across his face.

He grabbed the chubby youth and shot into the sky, disappearing into the night.

The next day, chaos erupted in the capital.

Children from prominent families, such as the Su, Ye, and Han families, mysteriously went missing.

Even after these influential families searched the entire city, they couldn’t find any trace of the children.

Panic spread, and rumors began circulating.

The affected families gathered in secret to discuss the situation. They concluded that only two entities could be responsible: either the rumored immortals or the Da Li Emperor himself.

It was clear that immortals wouldn’t stoop to such stealthy actions. That left only one possibility—the emperor had acted.

The aristocrats and ministers couldn’t help but recall various rumors they’d heard before, and resentment began to grow in their hearts.

Thus, undercurrents began to stir within the capital.

Meanwhile, the instigator of all this, Li Fan, had already left the Realm.

After returning to the Xuanhuang Realm, he didn’t stop for a moment.

Instead of heading to any particular region of the Xuanhuang Realm, he passed through the Immortal Extinction Passage and returned to his homeland, the Great Xuan.

The Taiyan Boat sailed swiftly through the air, carrying sixteen frightened children huddled together in the cabin, trembling in fear.

Li Fan stood at the prow, gazing below.

Like the Outer Realm, the Great Xuan was a complete miniature world, but it was over ten times larger.

Since the Outer Realm could produce cultivation geniuses like Su Xiaomei and Xiao Heng, there was no reason the Great Xuan couldn't as well.

His first destination was Hangguang City, the wealthiest city in Great Xuan.

As his immense divine sense swept over the mortals below, Li Fan searched for suitable candidates.

Soon after, Li Fan frowned deeply.

“How is it that so few have better potential than I did?”

Shaking his head, the Taiyan Boat sped up and headed for the next city.

But the result was the same.

After spending nearly half a month, Li Fan had almost searched through all the citizens of Great Xuan, yet those suitable for cultivation were exceedingly rare.

“It seems that my difficulty in stepping onto the path of immortality wasn’t entirely coincidental.”

“People and Heaven…”

Soaring into the sky, Li Fan closed his eyes and sensed the very essence of the Xuan Realm.

“Humans are the spirits of all living beings, blessed by the heavens.”

“Those favored by the heavens can sense the Dao, cultivating in harmony with the Way, and step onto the path of immortality.”

“This is what should naturally occur.”

“Given the vast population of Great Xuan, there should theoretically be many so-called geniuses favored by the heavens.”

“But strangely enough…”

Li Fan recalled the void ripper whales that lingered outside Great Xuan, trying to sever the entire Xuan Realm from the Xuanhuang World.

“When the heavens offer no favor, who dares to tread the path of immortality?”

“But why is the (Li)-Outer Realm so unique?”

With doubts swirling in his mind, Li Fan sighed softly and temporarily gave up on his original plans.

He only made a detour to the area near Jieli Mountain, taking the two boys he had noticed with extraordinary potential.

He then left Great Xuan and returned to the world of cultivation.

“I knew it! Immortals do exist!” Sun Erlang exclaimed excitedly, pacing back and forth.

Beside him, the burly Wang Xuanba looked worried and uneasy.

“Erlang, what do you think the immortal wants with us? When do you think we’ll be able to go back? I miss home…” Wang Xuanba whispered to Sun Erlang.

“Have some ambition! How can you return home without mastering the ability to fly through the clouds and split mountains?” Sun Erlang scolded.

Wang Xuanba opened his mouth to say something, but suddenly noticed a figure appear beside them.

“Immortal Master!” Wang Xuanba was startled and hurriedly knelt down to kowtow.

“Immortal Master, please teach me how to cultivate!” Sun Erlang also knelt and bowed.

Li Fan’s gaze swept over the two but he didn’t reply.

Instead, he led them to the cabin where Su Changyu and the other sixteen children were.

The children, many of whom hadn’t seen their families, were lost in fear and confusion, crying uncontrollably.

“Keep them quiet. This will be your first test,” Li Fan said to Sun Erlang.

“Remember, you can’t hit them.”

Li Fan disappeared immediately after.

Sun Erlang, who prided himself on his martial prowess, stared at the group of snot-nosed brats before him, stumped.

Chapter 472


Sun Family's Second Young Master scratched his head in frustration, but after much effort, he finally managed to calm the restless children from the separated realm.

Li Fan then led them to the path of transformation into Dao. The cave dwelling he had previously opened wasn’t large, but it was more than enough to accommodate these children.

Li Fan made a trip back to the Ten Thousand Immortals Island and purchased the Spring of Spiritual Life and Scarlet Fruit Tree from the Tianxuan Mirror, solving their food problem.

Only then did he gather the children. They looked at Li Fan with innocent and bewildered eyes.

"Do you know what immortality is?" Li Fan asked.

Most of the children instinctively shook their heads, including Ye Feipeng, who was completely puzzled. Only Sun Erlang, who was slightly older, had a flash of desire and longing in his eyes.

He eagerly responded, "I know! Immortals can fly through the sky and burrow through the earth, move mountains and fill seas, summon wind and rain, and do anything!"

Sun Erlang's words seemed to embolden the previously timid children.

Another child quietly said, "I know too. My father taught me a song: 'To be like an immortal, riding a crane to the heavens, turning stone into gold, miraculous and beyond words!'"

Li Fan chuckled when he heard this. He recognized this child as the future father of Han Wu You. This time, Li Fan had also captured him along with Han Wu You’s mother, wanting to see whether Han Wu You would still be born under such drastic changes. The significance of the possible differences was crucial to Li Fan.

With a wave of his hand, the children, who were chattering away, immediately quieted down.

Li Fan solemnly taught, "The so-called immortals are merely people who are a bit more powerful."

"But for a mere mortal to become as powerful as an immortal, how easy could that be?"

"Some people are skilled in literature, others in martial arts. The most important thing is to find a method that suits you to become stronger."

Li Fan deliberately paused, waiting for the children to reflect. After they seemed to be deep in thought, he continued, "I have three methods that can make you as strong as immortals."

"First, the Rebelling Against Heaven Method. Mortals follow the natural order, while immortals go against it. By defying the laws of heaven and earth, you can attain the path to eternal life. This is the highest method."

The children, though not understanding much, grasped the basic idea, and their eyes widened in amazement.

"Second, the Hidden Furnace Method. The human body contains a hidden furnace, and by refining it, you can tap into your potential. At advanced stages, sheer physical strength alone can move mountains and fill seas! This is the mid-level method!"

Upon hearing this, only Sun Erlang and Wang Xuanba had a spark of interest in their eyes.

"If neither of the first two methods works, I still have a third!"

"Although it cannot compare to the other two, it is still one of the many paths to greatness."

"It is the Beast-Taming Method!"

"The world was once filled with various exotic beasts that possessed incredible powers. By harnessing their strength, you too can accomplish the feats of immortals with a mortal body!"

Li Fan spoke loudly.

The children grew excited with anticipation.

"Everyone is different. Only a few will be able to master the highest method. I will teach you according to your strengths."

"You may choose how to cultivate voluntarily."

"Think carefully. Three days later, I will return to this place!"

With a sweep of his hand, Li Fan activated a Memory Stone, which played a continuous loop explaining the three methods in the air. The children were captivated by the various dazzling scenes displayed and immersed themselves in them.

Three days passed quickly.

When Li Fan reappeared, they immediately fell silent from their discussions.

"Those who wish to cultivate the highest method, step forward!" Li Fan commanded.

Su Changyu, Sun Erlang, and three other children boldly stepped forward.

After scanning them, Li Fan solemnly said, "None of you have exceptional talent. If your cultivation becomes difficult in the future, don’t regret your choice!"

Su Changyu and the others showed no signs of hesitation.

Li Fan flicked his fingers, and several streams of light flew into their minds.

"Thus, I have passed on different methods to you. Remember, immortal cultivation is rare, and you must not practice multiple methods simultaneously. In the future, if you encounter difficulties, you must figure them out on your own and never reveal your cultivation method to others."

Upon hearing this, the children’s expressions changed slightly.

But Li Fan ignored them, summoning a gentle breeze to lead them to another room.

He then turned to the remaining children and said, "Those who wish to cultivate the Hidden Furnace Method, step forward!"

Wang Xuanba was the first to move.

Most of the other children, after some hesitation, also stepped forward.

Without saying much, Li Fan transmitted the Creation Furnace Technique into their minds.

After sending them away, Li Fan looked at the remaining three children, his eyelid twitching.

Among them were the nonchalant Xiao Heng and the cunning-eyed Ye Fei Peng.

"Why did you choose the lowest-level Beast-Taming Method?" Li Fan asked coldly, pointing at Xiao Heng. "You answer first!"

Startled, Xiao Heng scratched his head, embarrassed. "Master Immortal, I feel like I’m too dumb to learn the first two methods. So I’ll just honestly learn the Beast-Taming Method."

Li Fan sneered. "Are you sure? No regrets?"

Seeing that Li Fan wasn’t reprimanding him, Xiao Heng breathed a sigh of relief and nodded quickly, "No regrets!"

Li Fan didn’t say anything more and handed him a Nascent Soul Beast Soul Bead.

"This is a Beast God Bead, containing the soul of a powerful beast. It’s too strong for you now, so keep it by your side, day and night. When you feel ready, try to refine it." Li Fan instructed.

"Thank you, Master Immortal!" Xiao Heng happily accepted the Beast Soul Bead.

"Master Immortal, I think the same way as Xiao Heng!" The other child, Zhao Wen, who seemed simple and honest, also spoke up quickly.

Li Fan examined Zhao Wen’s body carefully, and after some thought, gave him another Nascent Soul Beast Soul Bead.

"Don’t push yourself," Li Fan advised.

Zhao Wen gratefully knelt and bowed.

"And you?" Li Fan looked at the last one, Ye Fei Peng.

Ye Fei Peng scratched his cheek, hesitating.

Finally, he gathered his courage and asked tentatively, "Master Immortal, why can we only choose one method?"

"I want all three. Is that possible?"

Li Fan paused, gazing at the eager Ye Fei Peng. Suddenly, he burst into laughter.

"Since you’ve asked, I shall grant your wish."

The Sea-Stabilizing Divine Sword, the Creation Furnace Technique, and a Beast Soul Bead made from the essence of the nine-headed divine bird flew toward Ye Fei Peng.

"Thank you, Master Immortal! Thank you!" Ye Fei Peng was overjoyed, bowing repeatedly.

Xiao Heng and Zhao Wen, stunned by the unexpected outcome, were left speechless.

Chapter 473


Xiao Heng opened his mouth, wanting to say something. However, his lips only moved slightly, and when he looked at the stern face of Li Fan, he ultimately remained silent.

On the other hand, Zhao Wen, who had a simple and honest nature, didn't think much. After his initial shock, his eyes were filled with pure admiration.

Thus, the cultivation path for this group of children was temporarily set, except for Su Xiaomei, who was still in swaddling clothes. Although Su Xiaomei had extraordinary talent, she was simply too young. Being at the stage of babbling, it was unrealistic to expect her to start cultivating yet. However, with the protection of numerous spiritual items purchased by Li Fan, along with the care of Xiao Heng and Su Changyu, there was no need to worry about her health. In fact, she was growing even faster than in her previous lives.

Seven days later, as the children's cultivation journeys were beginning to take shape, Li Fan gathered them together once again.

"Do you know where you are right now?" Li Fan asked.

After becoming more familiar over the past few days, the children were no longer as reserved as they had been. "It's the Immortal Realm!" they answered eagerly.

"Correct," Li Fan nodded. "But do you know that your ancestors originally came from this Immortal Realm?"

"Immortal Master, our ancestors were also immortals?" the children asked, wide-eyed and chattering in excitement.

Li Fan then told them the story of how, in ancient times, their ancestors had been forced to leave their homeland due to being afflicted by a curse that separated mortals from immortals.

"They were merely stronger humans who relied on their power to act recklessly, treating their former comrades cruelly.""Why should they monopolize this vast and beautiful world full of spiritual energy, while you are left to live in a small, desolate world with no spiritual energy and even the risk of total annihilation?"

Li Fan's gaze swept over them as he subtly used the power of his Seven Apertures Exquisite Heart to manipulate their thoughts.

"When you become strong enough, this world will respect and accept your opinions."

"Everything that was lost must be taken back by your own hands!"

In secret, Li Fan watched these future pillars of the Federation Of All World's and nodded in approval.

Of course, he didn’t truly expect to launch a counterattack against the Immortal Realm or overthrow the Ten Thousand Immortals Alliance. However, his recent profitable dealings with the Empire had given him some new ideas.

Using the banner of the Federation Of All Worlds, he could continue to make contact with small worlds that possessed unique power systems and profit greatly from these exchanges. The value of power at the same level was not equivalent between small worlds and the Xuanhuang Realm. Take, for example, the thousand beast soul beads—500 Foundation Establishment, 490 Golden Core, and even nine Nascent Souls. Assembling a team of this strength in the Xuanhuang Realm would cost more than ten million in contribution points.

But due to the Empire’s urgent need for contribution points to detach from the Xuanhuang Realm, Li Fan was able to easily secure significant gains.

The same applied to other small worlds. However, since these pocket dimensions and small worlds were all hidden away, to connect with them required a large number of personnel.

Therefore, raising these children was quite necessary. Besides, with the Mountain Sitting Technique in their possession, the stronger they became, the greater the benefits for Li Fan.

He quietly instructed Tian Yang not to hit them too hard, and as long as they reached the combat strength of Golden Core cultivators, he should let them win.

After leaving behind a Formless killing intent to monitor them, Li Fan quietly returned to Ten Thousand Immortals Island.

While he had been away, the Ten Thousand Immortals Alliance appeared peaceful on the surface, but hidden currents were already surging underneath. After deploying a large number of cultivators, they issued a Call for Recruitment.

Any cultivators with achievements in the field of formations were summoned. They didn't need to pass the usual entrance exams and could immediately receive the benefits of a formation master in the Strategy Formation Hall. Those who performed exceptionally well could even be rewarded with Dao Integration techniques.

In no time, talented formation masters from all over the world gathered at the Ten Thousand Immortals Alliance headquarters. Such a grand assembly naturally didn't go unnoticed by the Five Elders Association.

On the border, the Five Elders Association continued to provoke and probe the Alliance. From time to time, news of exposed and executed spies from the Five Elders Association would surface.

Both sides remained cautious about war. However, beneath the strange calm, a massive storm seemed to be brewing.

Li Fan sensed something unusual. If they only wanted to construct the Tianxuan Spirit Locking Formation, there was no need for so many formation masters. The deduction of the formation diagram wasn’t something Nascent Soul-level formation masters could even participate in.

"Chief Lu, what are you up to?" Li Fan muttered to himself, his eyes flashing as he quickly reviewed recent events in the Tianxuan Mirror, trying to find some clues.

After a long time, his eyes suddenly stopped on a seemingly ordinary piece of news.

Foundation Establishment cultivator Guo Yezhong died unexpectedly while attempting to break through to the Golden Core stage.

"Guo Yezhong? How did he die so early?"

Li Fan remembered this person clearly from his previous life. Guo Yezhong had relied on contribution points to win first place in the Spirit Locking Formation Competition, so Li Fan had a strong impression of him.

Now, his sudden and unexplained death seemed suspicious. Li Fan decided to investigate the events leading up to Guo Yezhong's death to see if he could uncover anything unusual.

After several days of effort and spending contribution points like water, Li Fan finally found a potential lead from one of Guo Yezhong's friends.

Accumulating contribution points was incredibly difficult! A 50% return in one year was irresistible!

This announcement caused many cultivators to curse silently.

However, a small number of people placed their trust in Li Fan and invested their contribution points.

With the introduction of this competitive system, the third round of contributions swelled to over 15 million.

An average of 30,000 per person.

And that was with everyone holding back and adopting a cautious approach.

He Zhenghao was overwhelmed with joy as he collected the funds.

Since Li Fan promised him 1% of the profit as a reward, he worked even harder.

He even encouraged the investors to dig deeper into their pockets.

While Li Fan was busy amassing wealth, the Empire's Foundation Establishment Masters were not idle either.

Ever since he started using the title of "Ancient Heavenly Mechanism Sect Cultivator" to stir up the world, Li Fan had been extra cautious and vigilant.

Whenever he went out, he would always use the secret technique "Shrouding Sky Palm" to hide his whereabouts.

The secret technique, which had once been able to block even the Tianxuan web's detection in his previous life, was truly extraordinary. Even in the vast Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance, many cultivators desired to see Li Fan, yet none had succeeded.

But today, it seemed that a few uninvited guests had finally arrived.

Not only was it's flight speed several times faster, but during the journey, a faint blue light radiated from it, enveloping both Xu Ke and Li Fan, blocking out the sound of the wind, making the ride more comfortable.

Xu Ke, who hadn’t rested in a long time, fell into a deep sleep on the bird’s back.

Xiao Qing continued to fly diligently.

After watching for a while, Li Fan slowly retracted his gaze.

As the Azure Luan Bird flew higher and higher, Li Fan stood atop Xu Ke’s head and looked down.

Only then did he realize that this small world wasn’t so much a canyon shaped like a thread of sky.

Rather, it looked more like a scar, forcibly carved by a sharp weapon.

Yet, this scar also brought life. Apart from the long fissure, the rest of the world was nothing but scorched earth.

Scarlet flames scorched the ground, and molten lava flowed savagely.

All of these destructive forces were held at bay, unable to cross the fissure.

The power that carved out the canyon lingered, preventing the flames from encroaching.

Thus, amidst this hellish small world, a lush and vibrant paradise had been created.

“Your perspective shapes your answers.”

Li Fan recalled the issue of mortals separating from the Xuanhuang Realm and had a moment of insight.

Passing through an invisible passage in the sky, they returned to the Xuanhuang Realm.

The pale white light slowly faded, and when Li Fan could finally see clearly, he was surprised.

Because they had just flown out of a painting.

Chapter 481


A somewhat worn ancient painting hung on the wall.

The scene depicted in the painting was exactly the canyon world where Xu Ke and Li Fan had previously been, capturing the Rift Whale.

In this room, there were over thirty other scrolls hanging on the walls.

What surprised Li Fan was that some of the paintings seemed to be enveloped in a layer of mysterious energy, preventing outsiders from peering into them.

Even with his powers as the "Heavenly Fate Mystical Bird," he could not discern the contents of these paintings.

A Azure luan bird flew out from one of the scrolls, gently placing Xu Ke on the ground. Afterward, it transformed into a streak of green light and disappeared into his embrace.

The noisy group instantly fell silent.

They even made way for him, allowing Lu Ya to walk in smoothly.

He glanced at Li Fan briefly before his eyes softened when they landed on Xu Ke’s face.

With a gentle wave of his hand, he lifted Xu Ke along with Li Fan.

Striding out of the room, a beast with the body of a tiger and the face of a man appeared in an instant.

“Tian Wu…” The aura emanating from the beast made Li Fan slightly uncomfortable, causing him to instinctively shrink deeper into Xu Ke’s hair.

“Forget it. With our Sect Leader in his current state, our Senior Brother is better off handling things.”

…

Before leaving, Li Fan faintly overheard some of their discussions.

Lu Ya, however, paid no attention and continued flying away with Xu Ke.

The landscape below constantly shifted as they traveled, passing through plains and mountains.

After more than twenty days of travel, the surroundings finally began to look familiar.

They had returned to the territory of the Beast Taming Sect.

“Without the White fog barrier, it was much easier for those in ancient times to travel freely.”

He patted Xu Ke’s head and began asking about his three years of searching for the Rift Whale.

After comforting and praising him, Lu Ya’s expression turned serious as he brought up an important matter.

“Next, I have a task of even greater importance for you.”

Hearing that he had to head out again right after returning, Xu Ke's face fell.

However, seeing Lu Ya’s solemn expression, Xu Ke nodded and agreed.

“I need you to go to Nanming and deliver something for me,” Lu Ya said gravely.

“Nanming? I think I’ve heard of that place…” Xu Ke scratched his head, pondering for a moment before realizing.

“Oh! It’s the place with lots of demonic beasts, right?”

Just as Li Fan was about to listen more closely, he suddenly noticed the surrounding scenery and sounds becoming blurry.

“This…”

Despite his reluctance, he could not defy the rules of the Fallen Immortal Realm.

In the next moment, after a dizzying sensation, Li Fan returned to the Tianxuan Mirror.

“Divine Brush Sect, Nanming…”

Li Fan reflected on his experiences in the Fallen Immortal Realm. After a brief pause, he began searching within the Tianxuan Mirror.

The Divine Brush Sect was a mid-tier sect during ancient times.

They practiced a unique path, using brushes as their primary tool. It was said that both their calligraphy and paintings could communicate with the divine.

The disciples of this sect were all highly skilled in calligraphy and painting, and there were even legends of them bringing creatures to life through their art.

Unfortunately, after several great calamities in the world, very few of their works survived.

Even when Li Fan had visited the Divine Relic Museum, he didn’t find any surviving works from the sect.

In today’s cultivation world, there are few records of Divine Brush Sect cultivators. Most of those mentioned were obscure figures with little fame.

The only notable figure in history was a former Sect Leader, Chu Youhong.

Chu Youhong, at the Nascent Soul stage, took over as Sect Leader on the deathbed order of his predecessor.

Due to his low cultivation level and weak strength, he was often looked down upon by the sect's disciples.

However, out of respect for the Sect Leader’s title, there was no open rebellion.

Chu Youhong didn’t seem to mind and treated the disciples kindly, never displaying the authority of a Sect Leader.

Despite this, he diligently fulfilled his duties as Sect Leader.

He managed all sect affairs personally, no matter how small.

Externally, he maintained good relations with many neighboring sects.

Thanks to his tireless efforts, the Divine Brush Sect gradually recovered from the leadership crisis that followed the sudden death of the previous Sect Leader.

Through these accomplishments, the disciples slowly began to recognize Chu Youhong’s leadership.

And when one of Chu Youhong’s mortal disciples surpassed him in cultivation, becoming incredibly powerful, Chu Youhong’s position as Sect Leader was finally secured.

Just as things were looking up for the Divine Brush Sect, a disaster struck.

The talented disciple, the Sect’s Senior Brother, was actually a spy sent by another sect—the “Pointillism Sect.”

His target was the Divine Brush Sect’s most prized artifact, the “Heavenly Painting Brush.”

One night, with inside help from the spy, the Pointillism Sect launched a surprise attack on the Divine Brush Sect.

The Divine Brush Sect suffered heavy casualties, nearly facing total annihilation.

Chapter 482


Just as the disciples of the Divine Brush Sect were falling into despair, an event occurred that filled them with even greater anger.

Sect Leader Chu Youhong, disregarding the lives of his disciples, fled with the treasured [Heavenly Painting Brush] and a significant portion of the sect's treasury, escaping into the void.

While his departure did divert some of the attention from the attacking Pointillism Sect, as the head of the sect, such a lack of responsibility was unforgivable.

Those who were still alive and desperately fighting for their lives felt immense hatred towards Chu Youhong.

Had the enemy not been so ruthless, leaving no survivors, many of them might have surrendered on the spot and switched sides to join the Pointillism Sect.

In this battle, almost the entire Divine Brush Sect was annihilated, with only Chu Youhong and a few lucky survivors escaping with their lives.

Although the Pointillism Sect failed to seize the Heavenly Painting Brush, they annexed much of the Divine Brush Sect's lands and resources, greatly strengthening their position. They quickly rose to become one of the most prominent sects in the region, their reputation growing significantly.

As for Chu Youhong, he disappeared from the world along with the Heavenly Painting Brush, seemingly vanishing without a trace.

Twenty years later, one of the surviving disciples from the Divine Brush Sect encountered Chu Youhong and furiously confronted him, demanding to know why he abandoned the sect and fled alone.

Chu Youhong, without any hint of remorse, spoke words that would be remembered throughout the history of the Xuanhuang Realm:"Even if all of you died, it wouldn't matter."

"As long as I'm alive, the Divine Brush Sect still exists."

"My master entrusted the Divine Brush Sect to me before his death, and I will not allow it to be destroyed in my hands."

Chu Youhong's expression was one of complete righteousness.

The disciple, hearing this, was left speechless. Though he wanted to argue, no words came out.

The disciple's earlier resolve for revenge was forgotten as he stood there in a daze, watching Chu Youhong leave gracefully.

Because of these shocking words, they quickly spread throughout the cultivation world at that time.

Some laughed at him, while others saw his statement as profound wisdom.

There were even those who couldn't stand Chu Youhong's actions and wanted to personally confront him.

But after this incident, Chu Youhong disappeared completely, as if he had evaporated from the world. No one ever saw him again.

It wasn't until much later, when a great calamity descended upon the world, and the Pointillism Sect mysteriously collapsed overnight, that people began to suspect that it might have been Chu Youhong's doing.

"To be so selfish for the sake of the greater good is indeed something beyond the understanding of ordinary people."

"Perhaps that's why the Pointillism Sect's spy, who had risen to the position of Senior Brother, chose to betray them and seize power."

"Once he recognized the true nature of his master, he realized that inheriting the Heavenly Painting Brush through normal means would be impossible. He had no choice but to take drastic measures."

"Dealing with such an eccentric individual, there really weren't many other options."

He managed to find some scattered details about "Nanming Demonic Mountain."

However, when he tried to dig deeper, he discovered that his access level wasn't high enough.

"Demonic Mountain..."

Time passed quickly, and soon, ten years had gone by.

This year, aside from occasional minor skirmishes between border states and the Five Elders Association, most regions remained peaceful.

The Congyun Sea was no exception.

As a special associate of the Martial Hall, Li Fan didn't have any specific duties to fulfill.

All he needed to do was drop by the Martial Hall occasionally, have some tea, and check in.

If he was too busy, he could even spend some of his contribution points to have another cultivator handle things for him.

As a result, he lived a fairly leisurely life.

For a brief moment, He Zhenghao entertained the thought of absconding with the points.

Unless he defected directly to the Five Elders Association, there was no way he'd live long enough to enjoy the wealth.

The cultivators, pleased with their profits, were ecstatic.

With a sigh, He Zhenghao explained, "Everyone, please return home. Once the situation settles and Master Li decides to reopen the plan, I will notify you all."

These vague words left much to interpretation.

Unforeseen circumstances? Waiting for things to calm down?

This Master Li had been able to defeat even Nascent Soul cultivators with sheer wealth.

Yet now, he was forced to halt the plan due to some external pressure.

"It must have threatened someone's interests. Hmm..."

The gathered cultivators exchanged knowing glances and then fell silent.

Though they were frustrated at missing the chance to get rich, they also felt sympathy for Li Fan.

"Once things return to normal, be sure to notify me first."

In private, each of them made this request to He Zhenghao.

Having received many gifts and made a small fortune, He Zhenghao naturally agreed.

Li Fan's decision to pause the collection of contribution points was partly due to the rapid growth of the points' total, which was becoming a bit overwhelming. He wanted to slow things down temporarily.

But he had also received a warning from within the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance.

"Very well, let's let them wait for a while. I'll resume the plan when it's closer to the Crimson Flame will Burn the Sea."

Li Fan didn't pay much attention to the matter.

As the cultivators who had profited from the fourth investment began spending their contribution points to strengthen themselves, a steady stream of feedback flowed back to Li Fan, enriching his cultivation like rivers flowing into the sea.

Even without actively cultivating, his cultivation level steadily increased each day.

Not to mention that Li Fan had almost never stopped using both Awakening Pills and Enlightenment Pills.

In just one short year, he had made as much progress as an ordinary cultivator would in decades of hard training.

Li Fan felt that his Golden Core was nearly perfected, and it wouldn't be long before he was ready to form a Nascent Soul.

This year, every three months, he made a trip to Shenhua Island to extract some Kunpeng blood essence from Ye Feipeng for his research.

His understanding of the power of Kunpeng bloodlines grew deeper with each visit.

During this time, Li Fan also made another trip to the Fallen Immortal Realm.

Xu Ke, acting on Lu Ya's behalf, needed to deliver a wooden box to the South Ming region.

This wooden box was of great importance, sealed with several different powers.

Li Fan even sensed the aura of the Longevity Beast Emperor, Sanmo, on it.

Thus, Li Fan accompanied Xu Ke throughout the journey, riding the Qingluan Bird.

It seemed that the South Ming region was extremely far from the Beast-Taming Sect.

Time ran out before they could reach their destination, so their journey to the Fallen Immortal Realm had to be cut short.

And so, time moved forward to the eleventh year.

This year, the long-sealed Cloud Water Heavenly Palace would reappear in the world.
