Chapter 483


Congyun Sea, on a deserted island.

Sikong Yi and Bai Li Chen cautiously surveyed their surroundings. After confirming that no one had followed them, they finally entered their hidden cave abode, which they had carefully constructed.

The interior was small and quite simple. Despite this, Sikong Yi felt unusually secure inside.

Bai Li Chen's clone stood at the entrance, vigilantly on guard. Meanwhile, Sikong Yi himself relaxed completely, lying on the bed and contemplating his future plans.

"If my guess is correct, the strange phenomenon at the center of Congyun Sea should be the precursor to the appearance of the Cloud Water Heavenly Palace."

"And the 'Cloud Water Atlas' should be located in these ruins."

"100,000 contribution points," Sikong Yi's eyes glimmered with a hint of desire.

However, a moment later, hesitation clouded his expression.

"The Cloud Water Heavenly Palace likely still has descendants in the world. If I impersonate a disciple and am discovered..."

Just thinking about this made Sikong Yi feel uneasy.Recently, while his clone was practicing the 'Sea-Stabilizing Divine Sword' technique, it had unexpectedly sensed that someone else in Congyun Sea was also cultivating the same technique. This was surprising, as he had obtained this Golden Core technique from the remains of a Cloud Water Heavenly Palace disciple many years ago. By all rights, no one else should know of it.

And yet, here it was.

His first reaction was that there must still be descendants of the Cloud Water Heavenly Palace alive. He had originally intended to investigate further, but the closer he got to the target location, the stronger the feeling of dread became.

If he had gone, he would have been walking into certain death!

Realizing this, Sikong Yi fled immediately in fear. After narrowly escaping, he found himself unable to eat or sleep peacefully, constantly worried that the person who shared his technique would track him down.

"The Golden Core technique may be precious, but compared to my life, it’s not worth the risk."

After much hesitation, he decided to temporarily suppress the 'Sea-Stabilizing Divine Sword' technique, leaving only his pure cultivation power in his dantian. As a result, the strength of his clone significantly weakened. During this time, he acted with extreme caution, rarely leaving the safety of either the Tianxuan Mirror or this secret cave abode.

But now, as the day of the Cloud Water Heavenly Palace’s opening approached, his thoughts began to stir again.

"100,000 contribution points, 100,000 contribution points..."

He muttered under his breath, a decisive glint flashing in his eyes.

"That old turtle Taiyi is not in his right mind. I'll hurry to him first, then re-cultivate the 'Sea-Stabilizing Divine Sword', disguise myself as a Cloud Water Heavenly Palace disciple, and steal the Cloud Water Atlas."

"Once I leave the Cloud Water Heavenly Palace, I'll quickly disperse my cultivation and head to the Tianxuan Mirror to claim my reward. By the time that descendant realizes something's wrong, it will be too late to find me."

"All I need to do is be faster than them."

"Fortune favors the bold!"

Having made up his mind, Sikong Yi let out a long breath and was just about to take a well-deserved rest before his adventure when he suddenly noticed movement at the entrance of the cave.

His face changed dramatically, and he quickly got up, rushing to the entrance, where he and his clone stood on high alert.

"Is Daoist Bai Li present?"

The voice caused Sikong Yi's heart to leap into his throat.

"Who is it? How do they know my identity? And how do they know about this cave abode?"

A flurry of faces flashed through his mind, but he quickly dismissed each one.

Narrowing his eyes, neither Sikong Yi nor Bai Li Chen responded. Instead, they took out their magical artifacts from their storage rings, secretly gathering their strength.

Seeing no reply, the voice outside spoke again, "Hehe, Daoist Bai Li, there's no need to worry. I mean no harm."

"I’ve come uninvited this time simply for the 100,000 contribution points related to the Cloud Water Atlas."

Sikong Yi was shaken to the core by these words. His hands trembled, nearly dropping his magical artifact.

His expression fluctuated wildly, and after thinking it over for a long time, he finally spoke. He controlled his clone to ask in a hoarse voice, "What do you mean?"

The person outside chuckled, "Daoist Bai Li, you don't need to play dumb. Did you really think that no one else besides you knows the origins of the 'Sea-Stabilizing Divine Sword'?"

Realizing that the person wasn’t bluffing, Sikong Yi fell silent for a long while before speaking in a low voice, "What do you want?"

"What do I want? That's a funny way to put it." The voice outside laughed, "Naturally, I want a share of the profits. Who wouldn't be tempted by 100,000 contribution points?"

Now that he knew the other person’s intentions, Sikong Yi actually felt somewhat relieved. After pondering it for a while, he finally disabled the entrance's restrictions and, with his clone at his back, stepped out cautiously.

Outside the cave stood a plain-looking middle-aged cultivator with a thin face and a small goatee.

"There's no need to be so tense. I mean no harm. I am Han Wuyou," the middle-aged cultivator said, cupping his hands with a faint smile.

"Say what you came here for!" Sikong Yi was no longer as tense upon seeing that the man only had Qi Condensation cultivation.

After some back-and-forth, Sikong Yi learned the truth of the situation. It turned out that Han Wuyou had accidentally witnessed the battle in which Sikong Yi's clone had used the 'Sea-Stabilizing Divine Sword.' Although Han Wuyou's cultivation wasn’t high, he was well-read and had recognized the technique as originating from the Cloud Water Heavenly Palace.

Recently, the strange phenomena at the center of Congyun Sea had caught his attention as well. After observing the scene briefly, he speculated that the Cloud Water Heavenly Palace was about to reappear. He connected this to the mission offering 100,000 contribution points and deduced that Bai Li Chen, having inherited the Cloud Water Heavenly Palace’s legacy, was certain to acquire the Cloud Water Atlas.

This was why he had followed them secretly and came to visit.

"Getting the Cloud Water Atlas is my own skill. Why should I share the profits with you?" Sikong Yi said angrily.

"Hehe, Daoist, you're joking. You wouldn’t want news of your obtaining the legacy of an ancient sect to spread across Congyun Sea, would you?" Han Wuyou stroked his goatee, his eyes flashing with a cold gleam.

Killing intent rose in Sikong Yi’s heart, but before he could act, Han Wuyou continued, "But I don’t intend to take your benefits for nothing."

"You have your path to wealth, and I have my way to the heavens."

"If you're willing to share some of the 100,000 contribution points with me, I also have a good opportunity to offer you."

"With the three of us working together, 100,000 contribution points will just be the beginning!"

Sikong Yi’s interest was piqued. "Explain yourself clearly!"

Han Wuyou smiled slightly and said, "Even if we earn 100,000 contribution points, we’re still small fish. We would burn through it quickly. Isn’t that true?"

Sikong Yi thought for a moment, then nodded. "The speed at which Qi Condensation cultivators can earn contribution points is indeed slow. But once I break through to Foundation Establishment..."

Han Wuyou waved a hand dismissively. "So what if you reach Foundation Establishment? Are there few Foundation Establishment cultivators in Congyun Sea? Aren’t they all still struggling for those meager contribution points? Even for a Foundation Establishment cultivator, earning 100,000 contribution points would take 10 or 20 years, even without eating or drinking."

"Then what brilliant plan do you have?" Sikong Yi asked skeptically.

Han Wuyou raised his head proudly, "Have you ever heard of Master Li Fan?"

Sikong Yi’s body shook as he exclaimed, "You mean, the ancient Heavenly Mechanism Sect cultivator, the one renowned for his divination skills and wealth, rivaling nations?"

Han Wuyou nodded, a hint of pride in his voice. "Indeed! I am acquainted with Master Li’s..."

He paused for effect, then added, "friend, Senior He Zhenghao!"

“The Protectorate institute...”

As an elite armed organization that only operates in a few states within the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance's core territory, it’s truly unusual for them to seal off and excavate the ruins of the Medicine King Sect.

Could it be that the phrase I mentioned back then, ‘The Tianxuan Lock union of Xuanhuang Realm,’ has caused the cultivators of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance to compete in deducing the future, thereby foreseeing the imminent return of the True Cauldron of Medicine King to the Xuanhuang Realm?

“What do you think, Fellow Daoist Jiao? Does this have anything to do with my earlier prediction and the possible opportunity related to the Small Medicine King Cauldron?” After pondering for a moment, Li Fan looked at Jiao Xiuyuan and asked.

To Li Fan's surprise, Jiao Xiuyuan shook his head in denial.“After returning, I made some inquiries. It’s not just the ruins of the Medicine King Sect. The same goes for the ruins of the Heavenly Sword Sect, the Taishang Sect, and other ancient sects within the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance’s territory. All of them have been sealed off by the Protectorate institute cultivators.”

“They’re not allowing anyone to approach, but they themselves are vigorously searching for something inside.”

Jiao Xiuyuan’s tone was filled with some resentment.

“I lost several puppets sneaking in, and discovered that they weren’t so much searching for objects as they were looking for someone!”

“Looking for someone?” Li Fan was stunned. “How can you tell?”

“All the cultivators inside the ruins are holding [Spirit-Sensing Beads]. This type of artifact is extremely sensitive to the breath of life. Even if a cultivator is in deep slumber with only a sliver of life remaining, it can still detect them.” Saying this, Jiao Xiuyuan couldn’t help but glance at Li Fan.

Li Fan’s expression grew thoughtful: “So, you’re saying they might be searching for an ancient cultivator who, like me, fell into deep slumber thousands of years ago?”

“There’s a ninety percent chance,” Jiao Xiuyuan asserted.

“That’s quite odd…” Li Fan narrowed his eyes slightly.

The Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance wouldn’t do something meaningless.

This large-scale operation clearly has a specific purpose.

“So, they’re certain that there’s such a dormant ancient cultivator, but they’re unsure of their exact location.”

“They’ve determined only that the person is within the ruins of various ancient sects, so they’re using this needle-in-a-haystack method to search.”

“This person must be extremely important to the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance, and…”

“The reason they’re looking for him is definitely related to my phrase, ‘The Tianxuan Lock.’”

Li Fan thought for a while but couldn’t figure out anything.

“Fellow Daoist Jiao, you really didn’t unearth a Small Medicine King Cauldron?” He glanced at Jiao Xiuyuan and abruptly asked.

Jiao Xiuyuan hesitated for a moment and then chuckled awkwardly: “It seems I can’t fool your discerning eyes, Fellow Daoist. It’s true that I didn’t come away empty-handed.”

“Unfortunately, my luck wasn’t great. Just as I unearthed one, the cultivators of the Protectorate institute showed up.”

“And due to this incident, all the items recently excavated from sect ruins have skyrocketed in price.”

“Quite a few cultivators have come to inquire about that Small Medicine King Cauldron, so…”

Jiao Xiuyuan looked at Li Fan, his eyes practically spelling out “higher price.”

However, Li Fan just waved his hand: “Since this item is so sought-after, let’s just forget about it. You, Fellow Daoist, can decide when to sell it!”

Without waiting for Li Fan to haggle, he directly gave up.

Jiao Xiuyuan was completely stunned by this response.

“Um, Fellow Daoist Li, aren’t you going to reconsider...”

“A gentleman helps others achieve their goals without coveting their treasures! It’s just a minor opportunity, how could I possibly be lacking?” Li Fan dismissively refused, clearly uninterested.

Seeing Jiao Xiuyuan’s dumbfounded expression, Li Fan added, “Instead, I’m much more interested in what you said about the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance searching for an ancient cultivator.”

“Maybe, this person is an old acquaintance of mine.”

“I know your information network is extensive, so please investigate this matter for me!” Li Fan’s gaze turned sharp as he looked at Jiao Xiuyuan.

“As for the small Medicine King Cauldron, forget about it. You won’t keep any secrets from me about this, will you?”

Li Fan’s gaze swept over the three characters “Qianli Hall” hanging outside the room as he spoke in an eerie tone.

“Rest assured, rest assured! I, Jiao Xiuyuan, would never ruin my own reputation!” Jiao Xiuyuan hurriedly promised, knowing he was in the wrong.

“Well then…”

Just as Li Fan was about to nod and continue speaking, a commotion suddenly erupted outside.

The two exchanged a glance, sensing that something unusual was happening, and tacitly stopped their conversation to step outside.

On Ten Thousand Immortal Island, the towering statue of the Immortal Venerable of Dao Transmission was emitting beams of light that shot straight into the sky.

The island’s protective formation had been activated at some point.

Beyond the protective barrier, a massive purple door stood tall.

Numerous cultivators were constantly flying out of the door.

“The Five Elders Association?”

Li Fan and Jiao Xiuyuan exclaimed in surprise simultaneously.

“Are they insane? Are they declaring an all-out war against the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance?” Jiao Xiuyuan’s voice was full of shock.

It was clear that this surprise attack by the Five Elders Association had been extremely secretive, catching even Jiao Xiuyuan, whose ears and eyes were spread throughout the entire cultivation world, off guard.

What has happened?

Why has the Five Elders Association suddenly initiated a war?

And the target isn’t the Grand Cave-Heaven of the Five Elements, but instead, this Ten Thousand Immortal Island?

Li Fan’s thoughts raced.

“Fellow Daoist Jiao, have other cities and states been attacked by the Five Elders Association as well?” After a moment, Li Fan asked in a deep voice.

“No. Only Ten Thousand Immortal Island in the Congyun Sea is the target of the Five Elders Association’s strike this time.” After pausing for a moment, Jiao Xiuyuan replied, still filled with confusion.

Li Fan frowned slightly, feeling somewhat puzzled as well.

The two fell silent, simply raising their heads to watch the battle in the sky.

The two True Monarch of the Soul Transformation stage on the island had been deployed to the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance’s headquarters, leaving the island’s defense forces clearly insufficient.

They didn’t dare engage in a direct confrontation, relying only on the formation to hold on bitterly, while hoping for reinforcements to arrive as soon as possible.

But it was clear that the Five Elders Association had come well-prepared. Not only had they rendered the teleportation formation useless, but even communication seemed to be blocked, making it impossible to send messages.

Ten Thousand Immortal Island was gradually losing ground, and the faces of the many cultivators watching the battle on the island turned pale.

Having lived in peace for so long, they had never seen such a scene.

As time slowly passed, to everyone’s surprise, when the Five Elders Association finally gained an absolute advantage and broke the protective barrier, they did not choose to attack the island directly.

Instead, they began setting up a formation in the sky above Ten Thousand Immortal Island.

Threads of light descended from the central formation above and shot towards the edges of the island.

“The Heaven and Earth Displacement Formation?”

Li Fan and Jiao Xiuyuan exclaimed in unison once more.

“Is the Five Elders Association planning to move the entire Ten Thousand Immortal Island away?”

The doubt in their eyes grew stronger.

The formation was completed in no time, and the threads emitted a faint white light.

The ground of Ten Thousand Immortal Island began to shake violently.

Chapter 490


The ground trembled more and more violently, to the point where it was nearly impossible to stand.

The vast Ten Thousand Immortal Island began to rise from the ground, slowly ascending towards the sky.

Some cultivators attempted to make a desperate escape, trying to break through the encirclement.

But they all met the same fate.

Anyone who left the Ten Thousand Immortal Island was immediately pierced and killed by beams of light descending from the sky.

Cries of alarm and agony from cultivators could be heard continuously.

The surrounding space seemed to be completely sealed off, and even the falling images of cultivators from the sky appeared strangely distorted, layered upon one another and squeezed into one place.

The fierce attacks from the Five Elders Association temporarily calmed down the cultivators who were panicking like headless flies.

They realized that as long as they stayed on the Ten Thousand Immortal Island, the Five Elders Association seemed to have no immediate intention to attack.

So, they could only tremble in fear, looking up at the purple gate that was getting closer and closer to them.“Could it be that the Five Elders Association made such a grand display just to come after me?” Li Fan, witnessing the scene, couldn't help but recall the earlier incident when several Nascent Soul cultivators came to capture him. This thought surfaced in his mind.

“That place is not easy to deal with. If I get captured and taken to the ‘Country of Truth,’ where lying is impossible, wouldn’t my secrets about traveling through time and the truth about my Identity be completely exposed?”

Li Fan had a clear understanding of his current strength; he knew he was not yet capable of resisting the principles of a Heavenly Sovereign.

“Should I use the truth…” A hint of hesitation flashed in Li Fan's heart.

After pondering for a moment, Li Fan decided to wait and see for the time being.

After all, the situation had not yet deteriorated to the point where his life was in danger.

The originally flat horizon in the distance had now disappeared from view.

The entire Ten Thousand Immortal Island was floating in mid-air, and the faces of the cultivators from the Five Elders Association above were clearly visible.

At that moment, a commotion suddenly broke out on the island.

Unexpectedly, a large number of cultivators appeared out of nowhere.

There were so many of them that they seemed to overflow the Ten Thousand Immortal Island, making the island itself almost unable to accommodate them all.

A clamor arose from among them.

“What’s going on? Where is this place?”

“I remember I was meditating in the Tianxuan Mirror! How did I suddenly end up here?”

“Look! The Tianxuan Mirror has turned into a stone!”

Hearing their exclamations, Jiao Xiuyuan muttered under his breath, “This is bad. Even the Tianxuan Mirror has been stripped of its power. It seems we can't count on these reinforcements anymore.”

Only then did Li Fan realize that these people were actually cultivators who had been meditating in the space within the Tianxuan Mirror on Ten Thousand Immortal Island.

Now that the island was about to be captured by the Five Elders Association, the Tianxuan Mirror, for its own safety, had canceled its so-called ‘empowerment.’

The wondrous sub-mirror on the island had been turned into an ordinary stone.

The cultivators who had awakened from their meditation looked at the overwhelming number of enemies and finally realized the precariousness of their situation.

“Fellow Daoists, I’ve heard that the Five Elders Association has something called a ‘Soul Contract.’ Once you sign it, your soul will be completely under their control. You’ll lose your freedom, and by then, living will be worse than death!”

“That’s right, they definitely want to capture us alive and force us to sign the Soul Contract!”

“If we’re going to be enslaved, we might as well risk everything in a fight. With so many of us, we might still have a slim chance of survival!”

After the initial shock, someone quickly rallied the others to break through the blockade of the Five Elders Association.

It is said that strength lies in numbers.

With the sudden addition of so many reinforcements, the cultivators of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance on the island grew bolder.

Soon, under the leadership of a few cultivators, they launched a desperate charge.

Li Fan, however, did not follow blindly. He pulled at the sleeve of Jiao Xiuyuan, who was darting his eyes around, and asked through voice transmission, “Daoist Jiao, is there any way to escape?”

Jiao Xiuyuan chuckled, held up his hand, and signaled with five fingers.

“Easy! Just fifty thousand contribution points, and I'll transfer them to you right now!” Li Fan nodded.

Jiao Xiuyuan's face darkened. “Is Master Li Fan's life worth so little to you?”

“Five hundred thousand contribution points! And that's because of our life-and-death friendship!”

Li Fan looked at Jiao Xiuyuan and smiled faintly.

He didn’t haggle with him and immediately made the transaction for five hundred thousand points.

“Brother, I’m not greedy for money. Fair is fair; even blood brothers have to settle accounts clearly.” Jiao Xiuyuan explained for himself.

Then he whispered, “Currently, the only possible way to escape from this Ten Thousand Immortal Island is through that ancient tree in the Qingfeng Hall.”

“Qingfeng Hall…” Li Fan’s eyes flickered.

In his 113th lifetime, he had once contacted Qingfeng Hall, a loan organization hidden on Ten Thousand Immortal Island, through He Zhenghao.

The ancient tree with a human face inside had left a deep impression on him.

The place where the ancient tree was located seemed to be a separate space.

Moreover, it could gather a significant amount of Spirit Mist Grass in an instant, indicating that, like the Tianxuan Mirror, it was connected to other spaces in the outside world.

“Thank you for the advice, Daoist Jiao!”

Li Fan cupped his hands in gratitude and was about to leave.

He suddenly thought of something and returned shortly after.

Li Fan stared closely at Jiao Xiuyuan, making him feel uncomfortable all over.

“Daoist Li Fan, why are you looking at me instead of running for your life?” Jiao Xiuyuan asked, feeling bewildered.

“Daoist Jiao, would you consider selling your current body?” Li Fan asked in a faint voice.

Jiao Xiuyuan was startled, and with a flicker, he widened the distance between himself and Li Fan.

“You…” Jiao Xiuyuan looked at Li Fan with disbelief, as if recognizing his true nature for the first time.

Ignoring Jiao Xiuyuan’s wild thoughts, Li Fan continued, “I’ve been awake for so long, and I’ve always stayed within the territory of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance.”

“Now, I have a basic understanding of the alliance as a whole, but I’ve never had the chance to see the Five Elders Association, which can rival the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance.”

“And the information about them within the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance is pitifully scarce. I’m really curious about the Five Elders Association.”

Li Fan’s gaze swept over Jiao Xiuyuan’s puppet body.

“My true body must escape, of course. But I’d like to take this opportunity to see the other side.”

“Daoist, is there any method that would allow me to temporarily control your puppet body?”

Li Fan asked slowly.

Jiao Xiuyuan finally understood Li Fan’s intentions.

After a moment of thought, he muttered in a low voice, “You should have said so earlier; you scared me.”

“As long as the price is right, it’s not impossible.”

Li Fan was overjoyed upon hearing this.

“Great! Name your price!”

Jiao Xiuyuan once again signaled with five fingers and, not giving Li Fan any room for misinterpretation, said, “This is my first time letting someone possess me!”

“Fifty thousand contribution points, no less!”

“Fifty thousand, it is. I, Li Fan, am not a stingy person.”

Chapter 491


“Hold your breath and focus. Split a strand of your consciousness and bring it to my hand!”

Outside, the sound of wailing grew louder. Jiao Xiuyuan, who had just received his contribution points, spoke to Li Fan in a deep voice.

As he spoke, a newly formed branch extended from his palm. A single green leaf stood proudly at the tip, solitary and independent.

Upon hearing this, Li Fan immediately split a small part of his consciousness and directed it towards the branch in Jiao Xiuyuan's hand.

As soon as he approached, he felt an inexplicable pull from the green leaf at the tip of the branch. Unable to control himself, he plunged straight into it.

His vision gradually became clear, and in an instant, Li Fan felt that apart from his true self and his clone, he now had an additional body.

Fortunately, he had the secret technique of Dao Transformation, which allowed him to be accustomed to multitasking over the years. Otherwise, it might have been difficult for him to adapt.

Controlling the puppet body felt almost the same as using his clone technique in terms of perception. However, he could clearly sense the separation between consciousness and the physical body, unlike the seamless unity of his clone.

It felt more like he was “driving” rather than inhabiting a living body.

“The transaction is complete. This body is now at your disposal,” Jiao Xiuyuan’s voice echoed in his mind. “As long as you don’t deliberately do anything disgusting, it’s fine even if you destroy it.”“Oh, and when the puppet body is damaged, a forced self-destruct mechanism will activate to prevent the consciousness from being captured. You might experience some shock to your soul…”

His voice gradually faded until it became barely audible.

As the split consciousness familiarized itself with the puppet body, Li Fan's true self rushed towards the location of Qingfeng Hall from his memory.

By this time, the entire Ten Thousand Immortal Island had already been drawn to the front of the purple door in the sky by the “Heaven and Earth Displacement Formation.” It was continuously being devoured by the teleportation Formation entering the territory of the Five Elders Association.

The cultivators who had just attempted to break through the blockade with their numbers were all reduced to ashes.

After this bloody lesson, the remaining cultivators, who were still alive, sat on the ground in despair, waiting for their unknown fate to unfold.

Meanwhile, Li Fan strode into the inconspicuous shop of Qingfeng Hall. It was now empty, with no sign of the sloppy old man.

He called out a few times, but no one responded.

After a moment of contemplation, Li Fan took out a pile of top-grade spirit stones from his storage ring and placed them on the floor of Qingfeng Hall.

“Are these enough to buy a way out?” Li Fan asked loudly.

There was no response for a long time. Li Fan then took out another pile of top-grade spirit stones and added them.

The total value was now close to a million contribution points.

This time, the seemingly empty Qingfeng Hall finally reacted. A wisp of green ripple spread through the air, forming a familiar green door.

Li Fan’s heart stirred, and he stepped through it.

After a brief blur of his vision, he found himself back in the space he had visited before. The ancient tree mentioned by Jiao Xiuyuan stood before him.

However, the human face on the tree had disappeared, making it look no different from an ordinary tree.

“What a generous move, Daoist friend,” a crisp female voice suddenly rang out just as Li Fan was about to speak.

“Ah Liu, since we’ve accepted his offering, let’s help him leave.”

“Yes, Miss,” the human face appeared on the ancient tree, glanced at Li Fan, and responded in a muffled voice.

“Honored guest, please step inside.” The ancient tree opened its giant mouth, revealing a passage.

“Thank you, young lady!” Li Fan cupped his hands in the direction of the voice and then stepped into the hole in the ancient tree.

As soon as Li Fan’s figure disappeared, the ancient tree closed its mouth and returned to its original appearance.

“Miss…”

“Hehe, the way ancient cultivators speak is quite interesting,” a silvery laugh echoed in the air as the branches and leaves of the ancient tree quivered in response.

…

The experience felt similar to using a long-distance teleportation formation. The surrounding scenery shifted from darkness to a kaleidoscope of colors, and then everything brightened.

After adjusting to the discomfort in his body, Li Fan looked around and found that he was still in Qingfeng Hall.

However, there were now one or two other cultivators present in the hall, and the distant sounds of the market, calm and unhurried, indicated that he was no longer in the dangerous territory of Congyun Sea.

After discreetly scouting the area, Li Fan finally figured out his current location.

He had already reached the heartland of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance, in Xuanwei Prefecture, near Tianyun Prefecture.

It seemed the news of the fall of Ten Thousand Immortal Island had not yet reached this place. For now, Li Fan redirected his attention back to the puppet body on the island.

Amid the desperate cries of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance cultivators, the island was finally completely engulfed by the purple teleportation formation.

After a long period of darkness, when the sky lit up again, what unfolded before their eyes was a strange scene.

It had been daytime moments ago, but after passing through the purple door and arriving at the territory of the Five Elders Association, it was now night.

There was no bright moon in the sky, but countless brilliant stars sparkled, competing with each other in radiance.

Rivers of stars flowed across the sky, with mesmerizing light and shadows, creating a breathtaking spectacle.

For most of the people present, it was the first time they had ever seen such a magnificent starry sky, and nine out of ten were so captivated by the sight that they lost themselves in it.

The once wailing Ten Thousand Immortal Island fell silent in an instant.

“Members of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance, welcome to the Humane Heavenly Land.”

A middle-aged cultivator in a white robe flew above the crowd and spoke loudly.

“I know you may have many misunderstandings about our Five Elders Association. But don’t worry, it won’t be long before you completely dispel these misunderstandings.”

“By then, I’m sure you will make the right choice to abandon the darkness and join our Five Elders Association.”

The white-robed cultivator said with a smile.

Seeing that the Five Elders Association didn’t seem as vicious as rumored, everyone breathed a sigh of relief. However, they didn’t believe a word of the “misunderstandings” he mentioned.

“First, I ask you all to leave this island.”

As the white-robed cultivator spoke, a group of burly cultivators flew out.

They were armed with sharp weapons and clad in heavy armor. They looked more like soldiers than cultivators.

Sensing their aura, each of them had a cultivation level of Nascent Soul.

All the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance cultivators present turned pale, not daring to resist, and allowed themselves to be escorted off Ten Thousand Immortal Island.

“It seems they’re not here specifically for me, but just for the island.”

“That’s strange. What’s so special about Ten Thousand Immortal Island?”

Blending into the crowd, Li Fan watched with a serious expression as the white-robed cultivator flew onto the island.

Then, dozens of other powerful cultivators appeared one after another and entered the island.

Explosive roars echoed as building after building on the island collapsed.

They seemed to be searching for something.

Chapter 492


“Move quickly! Stop looking around!”

Ten Thousand Immortal Island had almost been leveled to the ground, and the cultivators of the Five Elders Association began excavating the underground area.

Li Fan wanted to continue observing, but an armored cultivator rebuked him and forcibly relocated him from the area.

Several squads of armored cultivators formed a formation and drove the members of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance like a herd of sheep, forcing them to the entrance of a small cave at the bottom of a canyon.

At the entrance, there was a sinister wind blowing, exuding an eerie and terrifying atmosphere.

“Get in there! What are you waiting for?”

The leading armored cultivator struck the ground with his weapon, shouting like a thunderclap.

Among the group, there were some who looked resentful. They exchanged glances, seemingly plotting a resistance in secret.

However, the situation was against them, and after hesitating for a while, they ultimately yielded.

One by one, they entered the dark cave.Li Fan, using a puppet body, naturally felt little fear.

However, to avoid drawing attention and to survive a bit longer, he pretended to be extremely fearful, following the group inside.

As soon as he stepped into the cave, the light vanished from sight.

The next moment, a scene completely different from what they had expected appeared before everyone.

It wasn't a winding, dark passage inside the mountain; instead, they inexplicably found themselves in a lush, verdant valley.

In the distance, a wooden pavilion seemed visible.

Dozens of people were sitting cross-legged in front of the pavilion, listening to a scholar-like cultivator lecturing about something.

Seeing that it didn’t appear to be an interrogation or torture, the previously agitated cultivators of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance also calmed down.

They decided to observe the situation before taking further action.

Under the escort of the armored cultivators, the group slowly approached the pavilion.

Meanwhile, hidden among the group, Li Fan keenly noticed a peculiar change occurring to his body during the process, causing him to slightly change his expression.

As they continued to approach the scholar in the pavilion, their bodies seemed to be shrinking.

This change only affected the detained members of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance. The armored cultivators, the scholar, and even the surrounding scenery of the valley remained unchanged.

Although their speed of progress was not reduced, it felt as if they were getting farther away from their target.

This strange phenomenon caused a slight commotion among the members of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance, but it was quickly suppressed.

“Move faster!”

In their eyes, the armored cultivators had already swelled to the size of small mountains.

Without the slightest mercy, they continued to urge them on.

For the first time, experiencing what it was like to see people from the perspective of ants, the members of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance found it difficult to remain calm.

Their faces gradually turned pale, and they subconsciously followed the orders of the armored cultivators.

As they continued moving forward, their bodies kept shrinking.

After spending nearly ten days, they finally arrived in front of the pavilion.

In their eyes, the scholar now looked like a towering mountain, reaching up to the sky.

“Sit down,” the scholar said gently.

But in their ears, it sounded like a great bell, filling the heavens and earth.

It echoed continuously in their minds.

It seemed to resonate deep within their souls, and even though they tried to block their senses, they couldn’t help but hear the scholar’s words in their minds.

So, they all lost control of their bodies and obediently sat down on the ground.

“What kind of Divine power is this?”

Everyone was horrified.

The armored cultivators all saluted the scholar, and seeing that the members of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance had already sat down, they quietly left.

The scholar glanced at the crowd and sighed softly, “Another group of lost lambs.”

“However, since you are fated to be here, I will not let you stray further.”

The crowd, who considered themselves part of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance, naturally felt indignant upon hearing this.

“In your eyes, what do you think of our Five Elders Association?” At this moment, the scholar asked softly.

“Using soul contracts to control cultivators, absolutely evil!”

“Struggling on the brink of extinction. Within a thousand years, they will surely be destroyed by the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance.”

“Ignorant and backward!”

“Though not virtuous, they have managed to contend with our Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance for so long, so there must be something commendable.”

…

Under the scholar’s questioning, everyone spoke out, giving their own answers.

But the horrified expressions on their faces clearly showed that their responses were not voluntary.

However, not all the cultivators lost control and responded to the scholar’s question.

At least the puppet body Li Fan was inhabiting wasn’t affected.

Some Nascent Soul cultivators also furrowed their brows, resisting the scholar’s control.

“Isn’t this just a group version of the Heavenly Doctor’s ‘Interrogation’ technique?” Li Fan was also deeply shocked.

“Although its power seems inferior to the Heavenly Doctor’s personal execution, the number of targets is vast.”

Li Fan remained highly vigilant, ready to abandon the puppet body at any moment.

Fortunately, the scholar did not pay much attention to Li Fan.

The crowd continued answering one by one.

The scholar smiled, listening attentively.

After a long time, the voices subsided, and the area outside the pavilion gradually quieted down.

The scholar shook his head and said, “Utter nonsense!”

“Do you know where our Five Elders Association originated?”

Everyone shook their heads.

“After the Immortal Venerable of Dao Transmission created a new path, the terrifying cultivation speed of unaffiliated cultivators led them to launch an assault on the immortal sects.”

“Meanwhile, the sects themselves were divided into two factions, fighting and killing each other.”

“However, before we could reach a conclusion…”

The scholar didn’t directly answer but began to recount history.

“The great calamity of heaven and earth descended, making it impossible to practice the same Dao.”

“The immortal sects suffered devastating blows, with less than one percent surviving.”

“Yet, having ruled the Xuanhuang Realm for ten thousand years, they were deeply rooted.”

“Some surviving sects escaped this catastrophe. They secluded themselves, waiting for the storm of bloodshed to pass.”

“When the killing ended, and darkness faded, they united once again on the ruins.”

“This was the embryonic form of the current Five Elders Association.”

Disregarding the stunned reactions, the scholar continued to speak slowly.

“The struggle between the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance and the Five Elders Association is, in essence, still a battle between the old and new forces of cultivation.”

“All conflicts in this world largely stem from the oppression of the newcomers by the predecessors.”

“That’s why this battle has lasted for thousands of years and continues endlessly.”

“It will never stop until one side is completely defeated.”

“You are members of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance and have been deceived, so I do not blame you.”

The scholar showed a look of compassion.

The members of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance, who were seated and listening to the scholar's lecture, were all stunned.

Although they had long been accustomed to the existence of the Five Elders Association, it was their first time hearing about its origins.

Li Fan, however, was not as surprised as the others.

One of the Five Longevity Immortal Heavenly Sovereigns of the Five Elders Association, Senior Sister Zhao, was once the head of the Grand Dao Sect, one of the ten great immortal sects.

So the fact that the Five Elders Association was formed by the surviving members of the ancient sects was something Li Fan had already suspected.

Chapter 493


"It's nothing more than a struggle for interests, so why distinguish between good and evil?"

"If we were truly as evil as they say, how could we have withstood the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance's assaults for a thousand years without being defeated?"

The scholar raised a powerful question again.

Many of the cultivators from the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance looked thoughtful after hearing this.

However, more of them appeared confused, as if their values were being deeply challenged.

"Very well, let me first give you an introduction to the current situation of the Five Elders Association."

The scholar's enormous figure stood towering between heaven and earth, filling everyone's view as he began to speak.

"Now, the territory of the Five Elders Association is divided into five parts."

"Each of the five Heavenly Sovereigns governs their own domain."

"I can't casually comment on the other Heavenly Sovereigns' territories. If you have the chance in the future, you can explore them on your own.""Let me speak only of the current place you find yourselves in—the [Humane Heavenly Domain]."

The scholar's words drew the attention of all the cultivators present, including Li Fan.

"Each of the five Heavenly Sovereigns defies the natural order and creates their own unique region."

"In our [Humane Heavenly Domain], the most important principle is the way of the Heavenly Sovereign's Dao."

Thus, the Sima family had also mastered the technique of "Blood Splitting Clones" , which allowed them to split off parts of their blood to create clones.

These many clones traveled across the world, recording history as accurately and comprehensively as possible.

This explained why the Sima family members generally had short lifespans.

The river of blood recorded countless pieces of information from the Xuanhuang Realm's past.

To prevent unforeseen events from wiping out decades of accumulated knowledge, the Sima family's ancestors painstakingly devised a secret method called "One Is All".

As long as there was still a trace of Sima family bloodline in the world, the Bloodline History Archive would never be broken.

Li Fan then asked about the definition of the "Sima family bloodline."

Sima Changkong smiled proudly.

As long as there was even a trace of Sima blood in someone’s ancestry, no matter how diluted, the Bloodline History Archive could still be passed down.

After thousands of years, the descendants of the Sima family’s mortal lineage had spread throughout the Xuanhuang Realm.

In other words, unless all mortals in the Xuanhuang Realm were exterminated, the Bloodline History Archive could never be completely eradicated.

“Hehe, Island Master Li, your sharp eyes are truly impressive! There was indeed an error!”

Li Fan took the new list and saw that the amount of resources was indeed over 50% more than the previous one.

Although there had been some corruption and embezzlement within the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance recently, everyone at least made an effort to cover it up—putting on a facade to conceal their actions.

There could only be one explanation: the people behind this were targeting Li Fan directly.

Up until now, everything Li Fan had done—from trading rare Samantabhadra True Leaves to gathering and reinvesting the contributions of other cultivators—had been in the open, not intentionally concealed.

Except for his dealings with the empire, every transaction he had made was traceable.

It didn’t take precise calculations; even a rough estimate would reveal the staggering amount of contribution points currently in Li Fan’s possession.

With so much at stake, it was no wonder someone had taken notice of him.

Wang Linlang loved beauty and swore, "No one in the world shall see white hair." As a result, in the Humane Heavenly Domain, even the elderly mortals had shiny black hair.

Yue Chengjin, abandoned by his lover, grew resentful and cursed, "All lovers shall become siblings." This led to decades of tragic, forbidden love stories. Fortunately, the rule was reversed through the sincere wishes of a truly loving couple.

Qu Su loved fishing but often returned empty-handed, so he made a grand vow: all fish in the world would bite the bait upon seeing it. Thus, everyone became a master angler.

Chapter 504


The known territories of the Five Elders Association include the four major regions: "Carefree Paradise", "Realm of Reality", "One Heart Immortal Sect", and "Humane Heavenly Domain".

As for the last location, it remains unknown for now.

The scholar who teaches classes has never mentioned it, adding to its mystery.

Currently, it seems that exploring the "Realm of Reality" and "One Heart Immortal Sect" carries the greatest risk. Meanwhile, "Humane Heavenly Domain" and "Carefree Paradise" pose no significant threats.

Li Fan, knowing the danger ahead, deliberately chose to venture into the perilous terrain. Naturally, his actions were influenced by his longstanding admiration for Senior Sister Zhao…

Well, the truth is that the real reason was Li Fan wanted to take advantage of this rare opportunity to control a puppet with a strand of his consciousness and explore the territory of One Heart Heavenly Sovereign.

From his experiences in his previous life, Li Fan learned that under Senior Sister Zhao’s control, individual entities were connected into a unified whole.

This is known as "One Mind, Many as One".

Undoubtedly, when an individual is absorbed or consumed and joins Senior Sister Zhao, their past experiences and memories are shared with the entire collective.

For Li Fan, who possesses the power of the [Truth], this was completely unacceptable.Thus, from the perspective of his true self, the 'One Heart Immortal Sect' was even more dangerous than the 'Realm of Reality'.

This decision was based on several considerations: according to the scholar’s teachings, not all cultivators within the One Heart Immortal Sect had become part of Senior Sister Zhao. As one of the most formidable hunters in the world, Senior Sister Zhao was quite “picky.” Only the most elite cultivators, selected through rigorous processes, were eligible to enter the so-called 'Immortal Sect'. Even ordinary cultivators were not easily accepted, let alone a puppet body made of wood. Thus, the likelihood of Li Fan being targeted was very low.

Secondly, this puppet was one of Jiao Xiuyuan’s avatars and had a self-destruct mechanism. Apart from the towns, various mountain caves and sects built by cultivators could be found scattered in the wilderness.

The overall structure was quite similar to the ancient cultivation world.

Most cultivators opted to exchange their soul points for higher-level cultivation methods to strengthen themselves and earn even more soul points.

In the Five Elders Association, contracts governed not just trade but every aspect of life.

Chapter 505


In ancient times, cultivators acted without restrictions.

They slaughtered entire regions of living beings to refine magical tools; they destroyed mountains, boiled seas, burned forests, and sank lands; they broke promises, acted deceitfully, robbed, and killed purely for profit...

Such behaviors were commonplace.

The reason for this lay in the fact that as a cultivator's realm increased and their strength grew, the fewer restrictions they faced.

For instance, a Soul Transformation cultivator might covet a rare treasure that a Foundation Establishment cultivator had obtained by chance. It would be incredibly easy for them to kill the Foundation Establishment cultivator and claim the treasure for themselves. In such cases, how many would opt to obtain the treasure through "trade"?

Similarly, when a Foundation Establishment cultivator is confronted by a Soul Transformation cultivator, who is exponentially stronger than them, would they dare refuse a "trade"? If the Soul Transformation cultivator were to break their promise, there would be nothing the weaker party could do except swallow their anger, and perhaps even be thankful that their life was spared.

When the two parties are so unequal, fairness in trade cannot even be discussed.

However, within the Five Elders Association, and throughout the entire Xuanhuang Realm, this dynamic has changed completely.

This is due to the existence of various contracts.

The 'Soul Contracts' signed by cultivators of the Five Elders Association, the 'Trade Contracts' that Li Fan has used many times, and the special golden contracts for buying and selling cultivation methods...These omnipresent mysterious powers truly restrain cultivators.

Even cultivators at the Dao Integration stage cannot defy the power of these contracts. Once signed, they must be obeyed.

Under the drive of these contracts, order has been established.

Now, let's talk about 'Soul Points'. Soul Points are essentially a special form of energy hidden deep within the soul, sustained by the power of contracts.

Besides being used for everyday transactions, Soul Points have a special purpose: they can be spent to access the "Immortal Sect's Martial Vault".

In this vault, you can exchange for a vast array of ancient cultivation methods, texts, and treasures, which originated from ancient immortal sects.

What's even more noteworthy is that within the vault, there are authentic recreations of ancient sects from the distant past.

These real-life recreations are created by a force similar to the "Fallen Immortal Realm". Here, cultivators can explore and visit many ancient sects that have long since perished. In the 'Immortal Sect's Martial Vault', any injuries sustained will not affect the physical body in reality, only causing minor soul injuries. The beauty of it is that these soul injuries can also be healed by spending Soul Points.

In theory, if someone had enough Soul Points, even a mortal who has just started cultivating could become incredibly powerful after participating in many such battles.

Thanks to the binding power of the Soul Contracts, the Five Elders Association doesn't need to suppress the combat strength of ordinary cultivators, unlike the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance.

Of course, none of this comes for free—it’s up to the cultivator to earn it.

"But for me, it doesn't matter. As a true businessman, I need a fair amount of these spirit stones for transactions," Gu Binliang explained.

"If you need anything in the future, feel free to find me," Gu Binliang said with a cheerful smile, handing over a communication talisman.

In this One Heart Immortal Sect, things seemed strangely…

Harmonious?

There was only one thing they firmly believed in.

As long as one's heart was sincere and they were exceptional enough, they could catch the attention of the great "Heavenly Sovereign" and be chosen to join the "Great Immortal Sect".

This belief was somewhat abstract.

After leaving Wangyue Prefecture, they had been traveling through various other states within the One Heart Immortal Sect for over a month. They discovered that everyone's statements were shockingly consistent.

Although Li Fan was merely a remnant thought, he had noticed the subtle changes in Lu Fan’s mentality along the journey. Lu Fan seemed to be losing his way.

At the beginning, Lu Fan had a casual attitude, merely deciding to follow Li Fan on this journey.

When it came to the stunning and peerless 'Senior Sister Zhao', Lu Fan mostly jested about her, not genuinely admiring her.

After all, to a cultivator, beauty was far less important than one's cultivation level and realm.

He grew increasingly fascinated with the existence of 'Senior Sister Zhao' and the Great Immortal Sect.

The more he learned, the more he became consumed by a desire to obtain something he couldn’t have, making him restless and obsessed.

Now, his thoughts had turned almost mad, nearly losing himself.

In contrast, the puppet body that only held the obsession of entering the One Heart Immortal Sect was less affected.

However, Li Fan did not awaken Lu Fan.

It wasn’t because he didn’t care about their bond, but because Li Fan knew that the subtle influence of the Heavenly Sovereign’s power wasn’t something that could be changed with a few words.

Even if he told Lu Fan about his changes, Lu Fan might just feel prideful about it.

Seeing how Li Fan resolved a potentially difficult situation without causing her any trouble, Senior Sister Zhao was pleasantly surprised.

Her worries dissipated, and she looked at Li Fan with increasing warmth.

Time flew by, and in the blink of an eye, three years had passed.

With no lingering concerns in her heart, Senior Sister Zhao’s cultivation advanced rapidly. She had already reached the late Golden Core stage and was preparing for Formation of the Nascent Soul.

With Senior Sister Zhao’s assistance, Li Fan lacked nothing in terms of cultivation techniques or elixirs, so his progress wasn’t slow either.

He had perfected his Foundation Establishment and was now on the verge of forming his Golden Core.

As the saying goes, "Swallowing a single Golden Core can change one’s fate; my destiny is in my own hands, not the heavens." The gap between the Golden Core and Foundation Establishment stages was immense. Once crossed, it was like defying the heavens, forever altering one’s life.

Knowing that his own aptitude was limited, Li Fan anticipated that forming his Golden Core might not be easy. To be fully prepared, he decided to enter seclusion, solidifying his foundation and waiting for the right moment.

Two months later, when he finally sensed the right opportunity to form his Golden Core, a piece of news forced him to leave seclusion early.

Senior Sister Zhao’s junior apprentice brother, Jiang Ningjun, the youngest disciple of Zhang Wangshuang, secretly sent him a message.

Recently, Senior Brother Qin Shou from the 'Lianshan Lineage' had been aggressively pursuing Senior Sister Zhao.

At a young age, Qin Shou had already reached the Nascent Soul stage, and his master, Qu Hanfeng, had a close relationship with Zhang Wangshuang.

Zhang Wangshuang was also happy to see Qin Shou and Senior Sister Zhao form a Dao companion relationship.

Qin Shou was handsome and dashing, seemingly a perfect match for Senior Sister Zhao.

In just a few months of Li Fan’s absence, Qin Shou’s popularity and support within the 'Yuehua Lineage' had far surpassed Li Fan’s.

Only Jiang Ningjun, who had always had a good relationship with Li Fan, was displeased with Qin Shou’s pretentious demeanor.

That’s why, at this critical moment, he sent Li Fan a warning, informing him of the situation.

Upon hearing the news, Li Fan immediately decided to postpone forming his Golden Core.

The Golden Core could be formed at any time.

But if Senior Sister Zhao were to be stolen away, she’d be gone forever!

Even though Li Fan had great faith in Senior Sister Zhao, he knew life was unpredictable.

And he was well aware that his smooth journey in cultivation thus far was thanks to her help.

"Anyone who dares to take away my soft meal is blocking my path to the Dao!" [1]

"I don’t care who you are, we will fight to the death!" A cold glint flashed in Li Fan’s eyes.

1. Soft meal/rice (chī ruǎn fàn) also has another meaning of, man who lives off a woman.

That night.

At that moment, a small, inconspicuous insect quietly trailed after Li Fan into the ruins.

He spewed vulgar words and stared lecherously at Senior Sister Zhao, no longer bothering to hide his lustful intent.

When they woke, they hesitated before deciding to abandon the 'Heaven and Earth Converging Manual'.

There were many other dual cultivation techniques; they didn’t need to stick to this one.

However, after a few attempts, they exchanged glances, their expressions slightly uneasy.

Chapter 513


In less than a day, the power of the Heaven and Earth Converging Manual had already become as if it were innate, deeply ingrained in the marrow.

It fused completely with his cultivation power, becoming inseparable.

It felt like the original technique that his cultivation had always drawn from. If it were forcibly removed, losing several realms of power would be a mild consequence. There was a great possibility it would damage his Dao Foundation, leaving him forever cut off from the path of cultivation.

“This…” Li Fan sat cross-legged on the ground, trying for a long time, but in the end, he gave up dejectedly, his expression dark.

Senior Sister Zhao furrowed her brows slightly and said, “The demonic arts of the Xuantian Sect are indeed strange. It seems that we cannot easily rid ourselves of it right now.”

“It is said that the 'Original Scripture of the Taishang Sect' allows cultivators to freely change their cultivation methods. If we are fortunate enough to view it, we might be able to abolish this Heaven and Earth Converging Manual.”

“The 'Original Scripture of the Taishang Sect'?” Li Fan frowned slightly. Although he had never heard of this technique before, for some reason, he felt a vague sense of familiarity.

Senior Sister Zhao shook her head, abandoning this unrealistic fantasy, “Unfortunately, like our sect's 'Heaven-Slaying Dao Scripture', it’s a sect-guarding secret, a mystery not passed down.”

“Only the direct line of the sect leader can cultivate it within our sect. As for us outsiders, there's no chance at all.”

Seeing Senior Sister Zhao looking troubled, Li Fan pulled her into his arms and gently comforted her, “Things have come to this; we can only take one step at a time.”“The Xuantian Sect has been extinct for a long time, and the 'Heaven and Earth Dual Converging Manual' is merely a dual cultivation method. I doubt the elders of the sect will notice anything strange.”

Although Senior Sister Zhao nodded in agreement, the worry in her eyes remained.

The two of them rested in the secret chamber of the ruins for half a month. During this time, they used the power of dual cultivation to fully stabilize their cultivation realms.

Only then did they set off to return to the Grand Dao Sect.

Before leaving, Senior Sister Zhao destroyed the ruins with her sword light, completely obliterating the site.

Upon returning to the sect, the shattering of Qin Shou’s life lamp had already caused a great uproar.

After a secret discussion, Senior Sister Zhao and Li Fan concluded that they couldn’t hide the truth.

They decided to face their master together and confessed that Qin Shou had secretly followed them with malicious intent, and they had ultimately joined forces to kill him.

They left out certain details, avoiding any mention of the Xuantian Sect.

They only said that they had made a breakthrough in the face of life and death, which allowed them to successfully counterattack and kill him.

Master Zhang Wanshuang, however, seemed to have known this all along and was not too surprised.

The two of them got punished with ten years of confinement, placing them under protective custody in the back mountain.

Ten years passed in a flash.

The storms of the Grand Dao Sect had nothing to do with the two confined in the seclusion chamber.

In the beginning, they were somewhat apprehensive about practicing dual cultivation within the sect.

But by the third year, both of them hit bottlenecks. Summoning their courage, they resumed practicing the Heaven and Earth Converging Manual together.

Perhaps it was due to long drought meeting a timely rain, or perhaps their cultivation had improved, but this time, the effect of dual cultivation was even better than three years ago.

Senior Sister Zhao broke through to the mid-stage Nascent Soul, and Li Fan's cultivation reached the mid-stage Golden Core.

The speed of their cultivation left both of them secretly astonished.

Unavoidably, their concerns also grew.

They knew that an occasional breakthrough could be explained as a stroke of fortune, but advancing so quickly, beyond the scope of their natural talents, would surely arouse suspicion.

If it were discovered that they were practicing the demonic arts of the Xuantian Sect, their fate would be miserable beyond imagination. Being stripped of their cultivation would be the least of their worries.

After a difficult discussion, they agreed that unless absolutely necessary, they would never engage in dual cultivation again.

The plan was ideal, but…

Another five years passed, and the strange bottleneck reappeared within them.

No matter how they cultivated, they couldn’t advance a step.

They struggled for a year.

For an entire year, they rested not a moment, dedicating all their energy to breaking through the bottleneck.

But it was all in vain.

The despair of their cultivation remaining stagnant tormented them.

Both Li Fan and Senior Sister Zhao were wholeheartedly devoted to the Dao and could not tolerate being stuck at their current levels forever.

Thus, in the ninth year of their confinement, they could no longer resist and engaged in dual cultivation for the third time.

Like dry wood catching fire, the blissful experience was even more intense than before.

As expected, after dual cultivation, the bottleneck disappeared, and their cultivation advanced once more.

Although they didn’t immediately break through, they were very close.

After the passion subsided, the two of them felt fear.

First, they feared their secret practice of Xuantian Sect’s arts would be discovered.

Second, they feared that the Heaven and Earth Converging Manual was so strange that they might be controlled by it for the rest of their lives.

Both of them were proud individuals, unable to bear such a fate.

In the final period, they ceased cultivation altogether, choosing instead to live simply, like a mortal couple, and devoted their time to researching a way to break free from the technique.

“The heavens give birth to all things, and so there is the concept of the Heavenly Father and Earthly Mother in the world. Every living being in this world is born with a 'Mark' left by Heaven and Earth.”

“It is said that the Xuantian Sect stole the authority of Heaven, controlling the power to bestow and change such 'Marks'.”

“Even an ordinary person, once bestowed by the Xuantian Sect, could become like us cultivators.”

“Furthermore, it is rumored that the Kings of the Xuantian Sect possessed a 'Longevity accomplished Position'. Whoever obtained it could achieve eternal life and live as long as Heaven and Earth.”

Senior Sister Zhao shared with Li Fan the secrets she had heard from various places.

“Achieving eternal life…” A strange glint flickered in Li Fan’s eyes.

“Senior Sister, are you suggesting that the Xuantian Sect’s techniques also carry this 'Mark' ability?”

Senior Sister Zhao sighed softly, “It’s just my speculation. The remnants of the Xuantian Sect’s teachings are scattered fragments, but even from those, one can sense how terrifying the sect was in its prime. Its laws were strict like divine edicts, suppressing all beneath Heaven, with none daring to defy them.”

“Though it is now but a ghost of its former self, breaking free from it won’t be easy.”

Li Fan held Senior Sister Zhao’s hand, his gaze firm. “Don’t worry, we will definitely overcome this.”

Time flew by, and soon their ten-year confinement was over.

The sealed doors opened with a rumble, and with nervous hearts, they walked out of the confinement chamber.

They had been worried that their rapid progress over the ten years would arouse suspicion.

However, upon returning to the sect, they were shocked to find that their progress now paled in comparison to others.

It turned out that in the second year of their confinement, a so-called "New Method" had quietly begun to spread.

Absorbing the spirit of Heaven and Earth, borrowing the wonders of Heaven, peering into the laws of Heaven…

Even defying the principles of Heaven.

Unlike the current method of sensing the Heavenly Dao and cultivating in harmony with it, this method involved seizing from Heaven and Earth, using any means necessary.

But its actual results far surpassed the current cultivation methods.

Chapter 514


At the very beginning, the elders of the sect regarded the "new method" as a shortcut, a lesser path, and dismissed it with disdain.

However, as some disciples secretly practiced it in the shadows, their progress accelerated rapidly.

Soon, disciples began to surpass their masters in cultivation in a very short period.

As a result, the situation started to change.

Seeing the disciples below them making tremendous strides in their cultivation, the elders of the Grand Dao Sect started to feel uneasy.

Even though the Grand Dao Sect still placed great importance on the hierarchy of positions and seniority, the rule of the cultivation world since time immemorial—survival of the fittest—was hard to change.

In the past, the elders relied on their cultivation and status to firmly control the power of the sect. But now, they were still in their prime, yet they could see their disciples catching up with them in cultivation, or even surpassing them.

With their ruling positions under threat, how could they remain indifferent?

Thus, the upper echelons of the elders split into two factions.

One faction believed that the "new method" was a force that seized from heaven and earth, progressing rapidly but deviating from the true path. Over time, it would cause irreversible damage to the world and must be completely banned.The other faction argued that the heavens and earth were vast and boundless, essentially inexhaustible. Although cultivators might endlessly plunder the world for their own cultivation during their lifetime, not everyone could reach the realm of eternal life. Once they perished, everything they had taken would return to the world.

Therefore, there was no need to worry excessively about this.

At present, the "new method" was spreading across the world, and many scattered rogue cultivators had risen because of it. Even disciples from other sects had been practicing it, gaining significant strength in the process.

If the Grand Dao Sect refused to adopt the new method, it would inevitably fall behind.

Both factions had their reasons, and neither was willing to yield. However, as those supporting the new method secretly cultivated and improved their strength, they gradually gained the upper hand in this internal struggle.

...

When Li Fan and Senior Sister Zhao emerged from their retreat, they witnessed this chaotic scene.

"Defying the laws of heaven and earth?" Senior Sister Zhao muttered under her breath, a strange light flickering in her eyes.

As for Li Fan, while he felt an intense longing for the new method, he was also inexplicably filled with dread.

It was as if this new method contained some great catastrophe.

"No matter what, the peculiarities in our cultivation of the 'Heaven and Earth Converging Manual' should go unnoticed," Li Fan said.

"Senior Sister, what do you think of this so-called 'new method'?"

Senior Sister Zhao chuckled softly. "Just a trick. No matter how fast it is, can it be faster than our dual cultivation method?"

"Still, it might serve as a good cover."

After pondering for a moment, Li Fan nodded in agreement.

Thus, on the surface, they also adopted the new method, while secretly continuing to use the power of dual cultivation to seize this rare opportunity and rapidly improve their own cultivation realms.

Another ten years passed.

The struggle between the old and new methods became increasingly intense.

It was no longer just internal conflict; outside the sect, the rogue cultivators across the world formed the 'Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance', attempting to challenge the authority of the Ten Great Immortal Sects.

Internal power struggles were one thing, but when outsiders tried to take a share of their power, it became another matter entirely.

To maintain their rule, the Ten Great Immortal Sects—despite their claim of unity—were in fact full of internal scheming and competition. Yet, after many years, they joined forces once again.

They formed an allied army to suppress and eradicate the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance.

Initially, it was believed that these scattered rogue cultivators, lacking any deep foundation, would quickly collapse under the combined might of the Ten Great Immortal Sects.

But the outcome was rather unexpected.

At first, the so-called Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance was easily defeated by the sects' cultivators, suffering heavy casualties.

However, there were simply too many of them.

Even after wiping out one group, a new batch of cultivators soon emerged.

Moreover, in every battle, some of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance's cultivators managed to escape by luck. After surviving one blood-soaked battle after another, their combat prowess gradually transformed. Even the elite cultivators from the Ten Great Immortal Sects found it increasingly difficult to kill them.

There were countless mortals in the world. With the support of the new method, they could quickly be transformed into fresh forces for the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance.

In contrast, the Ten Great Immortal Sects, with their pride and strict standards for selecting disciples, found it difficult to replenish their losses after each defeat. It often took years, even over a decade, to recover from a fallen disciple.

As a result, the balance of power between the two sides gradually leveled.

The battle reached a stalemate.

Moreover, with the varying degrees of casualties among the sects, cracks began to form within the previously unified coalition of the Ten Great Immortal Sects.

Some sects even deliberately avoided participating in battles to preserve their strength.

Everyone knew that by this point, the rise of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance was unstoppable.

Yet the leaders of the Ten Great Immortal Sects remained unwilling to accept this. They were not ready to hand over the world they had worked so hard to control to these mortals whom they had once dismissed.

Thus, a plan was born: "Capture the leader first."

The rapid rise of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance was largely thanks to the so-called "Dao transmitters". These individuals were fiercely loyal to the Dao Transmission Immortal Ancestor, following his lead without question.

If the 'Immortal Ancestor' could be killed, the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance would lose its spiritual leader and collapse from within.

The Immortal Ancestor was merely at the Dao Integration stage, while the Ten Great Immortal Sects had several Longevity-stage experts among them.

As long as they could find him, the decapitation plan could be executed, ending the stalemate.

The Ten Great Immortal Sects reached an agreement and dispatched their strongest experts to form a small task force, vowing to assassinate the Immortal Ancestor.

However, because the Immortal Ancestor was as elusive as a dragon, constantly moving, the sects also sent elite disciples to scour the world for any trace of him.

Naturally, Li Fan and Senior Sister Zhao were among those sent on this mission.

This search took over twenty years.

Thanks to the aid of dual cultivation, Senior Sister Zhao had successfully advanced to the Soul Transformation stage, while Li Fan, though slightly slower, had also reached the Nascent Soul stage.

They traveled all across the Xuanhuang Realm, slaying countless rogue cultivators.

But they still hadn't found any trace of the Immortal Ancestor.

"Senior Sister, what do you think of this Dao Transmission Immortal Ancestor?" Li Fan asked.

"The Dao Transmission Immortal Ancestor…" Senior Sister Zhao pondered for a moment before shaking her head slightly.

"I don't know."

This pill was a secret treasure of the Grand Dao Sect, usually crafted only by longevity realm experts. No matter how severe the injury, as long as one wasn’t already dead, consuming it would instantly restore the body to its peak. It was practically a second life.

It was incredibly rare, and the sect had very few in reserve.

Yet now, Sister Zhao had unhesitatingly given him one…

Li Fan immediately realized the gravity of the situation and swallowed the Creation Purple-Gold Pill.

“Don’t waste it. Wrap it in your spiritual energy and slowly absorb its medicinal power,” Sister Zhao instructed while simultaneously casting spells, constructing layers of protective barriers around them.

“Could the cause of that disciple’s death still be contagious? What kind of curse is this powerful? Is it targeting our Grand Dao Sect?” Li Fan couldn’t help but feel alarmed.

“Rather than a curse, it seems more like a disease. A deadly disease that even cultivators cannot escape or avoid,” Sister Zhao’s expression was more serious than ever.

Even during the great upheaval when the laws of heaven could no longer be practiced, she hadn’t been this worried.

“Its target is not just our Grand Dao Sect but the extermination of all cultivators in the world… This must be reported immediately!”

Li Fan was stunned. “Could this be another backlash from the heavens? Damn it, is the treacherous heavens really trying to wipe us out completely?”

“Cough… cough…” As the two flew toward the sect’s main hall, Sister Zhao’s face suddenly turned an eerie pale color.

Then, uncontrollably, she began to cough softly.

But soon, a purple-golden light appeared, suppressing the paleness. The coughing stopped, and her complexion regained its rosy hue.

“How could it manifest so quickly? Sister, you’re at the Dao Integration stage!” Li Fan’s heart filled with a terrifying disbelief.

If even a Dao Integration expert was affected, what hope was there for him, a mere Soul Transformation cultivator?

Not daring to wait for the symptoms to show, he quickly circulated a sliver of the Creation Purple-Gold Pill’s medicinal power from his dantian, spreading it throughout his body as a defense.

Sure enough, not long after he finished, a wave of exhaustion swept over him.

It felt as if he had battled Sister Zhao for seven days and nights straight, his entire body aching as though his bones were about to break.

His throat burned as if cut by a blade, but his body, like a drowning mortal, desperately yearned for air, struggling to surface and take a deep breath.

Fortunately, the Creation Purple-Gold Pill’s reputation was well-deserved.

As its power circulated, the abnormal symptoms disappeared in an instant.

“Hiss… This disease is truly ferocious!” It felt as though he had brushed against death, and Li Fan looked at Sister Zhao with lingering fear. “Thankfully, I had your pill. Otherwise, I’d have ended up just like that junior brother!”

“Don’t let your guard down. This only suppressed the symptoms temporarily. The true culprit causing all this still remains inside us,” Sister Zhao reminded him at the right moment.

As if to validate her words, she quickly coughed again, though softly.

Even though the Creation Purple-Gold Pill soon neutralized the illness, it made Li Fan’s heart sink further.

They had miraculous pills to protect them, yet they still couldn’t shake off this mysterious disease. How much worse would it be for the ordinary disciples of the Grand Dao Sect, not to mention unaffiliated cultivators?

It was unimaginable.

The two fought off the illness as they swiftly arrived at the sect’s main hall.

There, the sect leader, Ji Changxi, having received Sister Zhao’s message in advance, had already gathered all the elders.

Though Sister Zhao had done her best to explain the severity of the disease, Ji Changxi and the elders gave it proper attention.

But…

It wasn’t enough.

In their eyes, although Sister Zhao had recently broken through to the Dao Integration stage thanks to a new cultivation method, she couldn’t be compared to them, who had been at the Dao Integration stage for centuries.

They possessed countless secret techniques and methods. What could harm this young Dao child might not necessarily harm them.

Besides, they believed they were fully prepared.

The space within the main hall was surrounded by numerous restrictive spells, layers upon layers of sealing barriers.

They had even activated the [Profound Abyss Dao Breakthrough Formation], which seemed close but was actually separated by several worlds.

It was absolutely secure, and they were completely confident.

“You two, stop suppressing the disease and each release a drop of your own blood,” Ji Changxi instructed.

Li Fan and Sister Zhao obeyed.

With soft coughs, two droplets of blood, each exuding an ominous aura, floated before the crowd.

Everyone observed from a distance, and the hall fell into silence.

Suddenly, a fleeting, almost imperceptible look of surprise crossed Ji Changxi’s face.

She had also briefly cultivated this divine technique! But now…

The Ten Great Immortal Sects had countless heroes.

But despite decades of attempts, no so-called genius had succeeded.

This showed just how difficult it was to defy Heaven’s will!

However, according to Sect Master Ji, a cultivator had silently succeeded in attaining Longevity?

Who was it?

The Ten Great Immortal Sects, though full of intrigue, still maintained communication. If someone had broken through to the Longevity realm, even if there was no prior announcement, once the breakthrough was made, news would have been shared with the other sects.

Moreover, this new Longevity Immortal seemed to defy conventional law that the 'cultivators are immune to diseases'.

This kind of action, which essentially made enemies of all cultivators, could not possibly have come from one of the Ten Great Immortal Sects.

Who would dig their own grave?

So, who was this person that had not only reached the Longevity realm but also sought to eradicate all cultivators?

This was an outright provocation and declaration of war.

It wasn't just Li Fan and Senior Sister Zhao who were stunned.

"We’ll send someone to inform them as well and gauge their response."

"The strongest forces in the Xuanhuang Realm must unite. I refuse to believe that this individual can continue to roam free!"

"While tracking down the culprit, we must also take precautions against this illness. From today on, the medicine hall will operate at full capacity, ensuring the Grand Dao Sect has an adequate supply of medicinal pills."

"As for those outside the Grand Dao Sect…"

Ji Changxi hesitated for a moment.

"After numerous calamities, our Grand Dao Sect has suffered greatly. We may barely have the strength to protect ourselves…"

"So, let them fend for themselves."

"I will also try to find a way to alleviate the symptoms of this strange disease," Mo Zhiren said, his eyes gleaming with desire.

"If I can completely neutralize its harm to cultivators, it would mean defying the laws of Heaven once again."

"In that case, perhaps 'Longevity' might still be within my reach."

He muttered to himself.
