Chapter 556


Back to the present moment, the people of Kang Village have suffered heavy casualties.

In the shadows, Si watched with bloodshot eyes, barely containing his rage.

He could hardly believe that Han Yi was truly capable of summoning heavenly starfire like some kind of god.

Not only had the plan to ambush Han Yi failed, but his childhood home and beloved Zhu Village were nearly destroyed in the calamity.

Familiar faces had become nothing more than burnt corpses, fragmented and broken.

Anger, jealousy, resentment...

All these emotions surged in Si’s heart, finally converging into a single thought.

"Kill him! Kill him!"

In the dim night, Han Yi's figure had completely vanished.

But Si, who had served as the High Priest for decades, possessed methods of communion with the gods that were not mere illusions.Although the energy surrounding Han Yi was different from that of the deity Si worshipped, he was still able to follow the faint residual traces in the air and ultimately catch up to Han Yi.

"Die! Such so-called deities should never have set foot on this land!"

With a twisted expression, Si voiced the suppressed words that had been buried in his heart.

As he chanted, Han Yi suddenly realized with shock that the wind around them was gathering in Si's hands.

Compressed to the extreme, it shot towards Han Yi.

"So, the heavenly fate can be used in this way?"

Han Yi was both surprised and delighted.

Though another wound was carved into his body, his eyes grew brighter.

He dodged while simultaneously sensing and studying Si’s method of controlling the wind blades.

Until, at the brink of collapse, covered in blood, he finally succeeded.

When he summoned his first wind blade, its color was deeper than Si’s, and the momentum far more imposing.

It tore through the air with a sharp whistle, crushing Si’s wind blade and continuing forward.

In Si’s stunned, unwilling gaze, it pierced through his body, reversing the situation and ending his life.

Han Yi, wounded all over, let out a relieved breath and collapsed into a deep sleep.

When he awoke, he found that all his injuries had healed in just a single night.

Unable to determine the reason, Han Yi didn’t dwell on it and instead continued his escape into the wilderness.

But soon, he noticed that small search parties were scouring the land for him everywhere.

The falling stars that night had been such a grand spectacle.

The destruction of one village and the severe damage to another could hardly be kept a secret.

Rumors of a "god descending" quickly spread throughout the wildlands.

Regardless of whether Han Yi’s claim to being god was true or not, his ability to summon storms and stars was beyond doubt.

If he could be controlled, unifying the wastelands under both law and strength would no longer be just a dream.

With ambitions to seize the title of “Emperor,” nearly every tribe began to pursue Han Yi.

In the wilderness filled with monstrous beasts, his human appearance was also far too conspicuous.

He had no choice but to constantly flee in disgrace to save his life.

Fortunately, he was protected by Heavenly Fate, which sharpened his senses to danger.

And ever since the battle with Si, besides wind blades, Han Yi had also mastered the technique of wind manipulation.

While not as swift as a cultivator's flight technique, it was much faster than simply walking.

Thus, although constantly hunted, Han Yi managed to avoid capture.

---

"Wind, water, fire, lightning..."

"They are all part of the world. By harnessing Heavenly Fate, I can control these elements to kill enemies without any problem."

"According to the Heavenly Fate Sutra, the earliest cultivators seemed to wield power in this way—petitioning the heavens for authority and manipulating all things."

"Back then, they apparently called themselves ‘Warlocks’."

Having grown accustomed to a life of hiding, wandering in the wilds for what seemed like ages, Han Yi lay in a freshly dug earthen cave, murmuring to himself.

A faint flame danced on his fingertips, illuminating the dark space around him.

Even in this world without spiritual energy, he managed to perform feats that only cultivators could typically achieve.

"If I fully integrate with this world’s fragmented Heavenly Fate, then my powers here may rival even the Longevity Immortal of the Xuanhuang Realm."

As hope rekindled in Han Yi’s eyes and he began to look forward to the future again, he suddenly felt the ground trembling slightly.

"Boom!"

"Boom!"

Thunderous footsteps echoed from a distance, growing louder as they drew closer.

Han Yi's expression shifted as an overwhelming sense of danger flooded his mind.

Cursing under his breath, he broke through the earth, quickly oriented himself, and used the wind to flee.

Behind him, a colossal white elephant the size of a mountain was in hot pursuit.

The massive creature ignored all obstacles in its path, charging toward Han Yi with its four powerful legs.

Even with his wind manipulation pushed to the limit, Han Yi couldn’t shake off the white elephant.

The chase attracted the attention of nearby beasts, who soon spotted Han Yi and joined in the hunt.

With more and more beasts surrounding him, Han Yi's escape routes were rapidly narrowing.

Feeling cornered, a fierce light flashed in Han Yi’s eyes.

Over time, he had absorbed a substantial amount of Heavenly Fate.

If he unleashed it all at once, he could trigger a disaster on the scale of a mountain collapse, burying all these beasts.

But doing so would nullify all his efforts, subject him to backlash, and leave him gravely injured.

Just as Han Yi hesitated, he suddenly sensed a faint trace of spiritual energy around him.

Though weak, Han Yi, who hadn’t felt the nourishment of spiritual energy in a long time, knew he wasn’t mistaken.

Where there is spiritual energy, there is the possibility of performing spells.

Even the weakest spells from the Qi Condensation stage would be beyond the capabilities of these beasts, who relied solely on their physical might.

Overjoyed, Han Yi immediately followed the spiritual energy’s direction and ran.

He finally stopped at a deep ravine.

"Could this be..."

Sensing the faint flow of spiritual energy, which halted just outside the ravine’s bounds, Han Yi was overjoyed.

"This seems to be a pathway back to the Xuanhuang Realm!"

Since arriving in this small world, Han Yi had relentlessly searched for a way back to the Xuanhuang Realm.

He had scoured the area around Zhu Village but had not found the entrance.

This small world was vast, and for him to find a way back alone was akin to searching for a needle in a haystack.

But by a stroke of fate, today, while at the edge of despair, he had stumbled upon the path home.

"Indeed, heaven hasn’t forsaken me!"

Han Yi cast a cold glance back at the horde of beasts hot on his heels.

A sneer crossed his face: "Once I return, master my skills, and make all the necessary preparations, I’ll come back here to settle accounts with you all!"

With this thought, Han Yi dove into the depths of the ravine.

Chapter 557


Han Yi thought he had finally escaped from danger, but he had no idea that deep in the valley below, where spiritual energy flowed, there were still some demonic beasts living!

These creatures, unlike those in the smaller realms, could absorb and cultivate with spiritual energy.

White snakes, flying falcons, and two-headed monkeys…

They resembled the traditional images of ancient demonic beasts.

Caught completely off guard, Han Yi plunged right into the midst of this demonic beast horde.

Fortunately, these beasts had lived in this secluded valley, cut off from the world, and had never seen humans.

While Han Yi was terrified out of his wits, more than half of the beasts, equally frightened, scattered and fled.

As for the rest, well, they weren't so easily deterred.

Seeing an unknown intruder in their territory, their innate ferocity was triggered, and they attacked Han Yi without hesitation.

Han Yi took a deep breath of spiritual energy, casting a protective spell on himself while condensing energy into a sword to slash at the beasts.Blood sprayed like mist, and in an instant, more than a dozen beasts were decapitated.

However, the scent of blood only drove the beasts into an even greater frenzy.

Fearless, they charged forward like a tidal wave.

And in the distance, it seemed like an endless number of demonic beasts were rushing toward him.

Han Yi knew he couldn't linger here, so he fought while retreating, moving deeper into the valley.

The closer he got to the valley's depths, the richer the spiritual energy became.

The denser energy allowed Han Yi to wield his full strength, the culmination of his Qi Condensation cultivation.

But correspondingly, the demonic beasts inhabiting this area also grew stronger.

Gritting his teeth, Han Yi used every ounce of his strength and finally carved out a path through the beasts.

He found an obscure, chaotic-looking cave at the very bottom of the valley and escaped back to the Xuanhuang Realm.

Taking a deep breath of the familiar, sweet air, Han Yi was still rattled and hadn’t even had a moment to rest.

Yet, he felt an inexplicable sense of danger creeping over him, as if someone were watching, his heart racing uncontrollably.

Already as jumpy as a frightened bird, Han Yi ignored his injuries and hurriedly took flight again.

It was only after a long time that the lingering unease in his heart slowly faded.

Physically and mentally exhausted to the extreme, Han Yi found a nearby deserted island.

Barely managing to land, he collapsed, fainting on the spot.

Back to the present.

Through the Cloud Water Illusion Technique, Li Fan had observed all of Han Yi’s experiences over the past few years, a look of interest flickering in his eyes. Ŗ

"This kid’s experiences are truly colorful."

"But somehow, he narrowly escaped death every single time."

“‘Misfortune hides in fortune, and fortune lies in misfortune.’ No wonder in your last life you managed to win the fish-head prize, obtained the lost treasure of the Blue Feather, and acquired the Heavenly Blue Feather Pill. With such incredible luck, yet when exploring ruins with my clone, you often met setbacks.”

"You’re not wrong, though. With perfect Qi Condensation cultivation, you’ve managed to break through to the Golden Core stage within a decade. Then you even found a Dao-complementing skill at the Derivation Law Jade suited to your path..."

“It’s truly worthy of being called ‘Soaring Dragon in the Sky, Unstoppable Momentum.’”

“Too bad you encountered me.”

"In this life, your path of fate will still follow my design."

After making Han Yi experience certain scenarios in his dreams, Li Fan finally withdrew his supernatural powers.

"The Heavenly Fate Sutra, interesting."

After a while, the pain subsided, and Han Yi let out a gentle sigh.

"I really don’t know if I’m lucky or cursed!"

Lying on the ground, he recalled his experiences in that small world and couldn't help but laugh with a mix of anger.

"It must be because my 'Heavenly Fate Sutra' has yet to reach perfection, causing backlash."

"..."

"Blessings and misfortunes go hand in hand, indistinguishable from one another."

With his thoughts fully aligned, a surge of spiritual power suddenly emanated from Han Yi’s body.

The spiritual energy from all directions was drawn toward him.

Above the deserted island, a faint tornado seemed to form.

And within Han Yi’s dantian, the black feather of the mystic black bird began to disintegrate, completely merging into his dantian.

This scene marked Han Yi's successful enlightenment upon returning to the Xuanhuang Realm after facing life and death ordeals.

He had directly succeeded in establishing his Foundation.

After years of bitter striving with no success, today he finally achieved his long-cherished wish.

Han Yi felt all the resentment in his chest swept away.

He let out a long howl to vent the frustration pent up inside.

However, his howl lasted only a moment before he abruptly stopped.

He instinctively scanned his surroundings and, seeing no immediate danger lurking nearby, finally relaxed a little.

"Forget it, there’s no need to be too arrogant."

"It’s only the Foundation Establishment stage; my future path, Dao Integration is set, and Longevity is within reach!"

A hint of self-satisfaction filled Han Yi’s heart.

After a while, he began to contemplate: "Now that I've established my Foundation, but all my possessions were consumed by that Foundation Establishment master."

"Truly, I’m left with nothing. I need to find a way to earn some contribution points."

Narrowing his eyes, he quickly came up with an idea.

"I heard that in the Congyun Sea, there’s a trick called the 'Fish Gambling'. Those with good fortune could get rich overnight."

"This is just made for me!"

"Hmph, watch my skill!"

With this thought, Han Yi rose into the air and flew towards the location of Fish Gambling Island he recalled from memory.

Unbeknownst to Han Yi, in the sky, a gaze was constantly watching him.

Chapter 558


After watching Han Yi leave, Li Fan shifted his gaze southwest.

Looking into the distance, his sight seemed to cross thousands of miles, reaching a deep trench at the bottom of the sea.

This was the location where Han Yi appeared after fleeing from the small world in a panic.

"A small world devoid of mortals, populated entirely by Beastkind…" Li Fan frowned slightly.

Based on Han Yi’s memories, Li Fan thought that the creatures in that small world resembled Beastkind he had encountered several times before—existences that were half-human, half-beast.

Yet, there were subtle differences.

While both combined human and demonic beast characteristics, Beastkind leaned more toward the "human" aspect.

On the other hand, the creatures in the small world Han Li experienced were closer to "demonic beasts."

This distinction could be discerned from whether their heads resembled humans or beasts.

Even more interesting was a legend that Han Yi heard about this world.At the dawn of recorded history, most inhabitants of the wilderness were half-human, half-beast. There were even some pure "humans."

But over time, highly beastified mutants occasionally began to appear among the descendants of these residents.

Initially, these mutants were viewed as deviants, abandoned, or even hunted.

However, when some of these mutants tenaciously survived and displayed immense power, things began to change.

They slaughtered the original villages and migrated deeper into the wilderness, establishing a new order.

In this new order, the more beastified an individual was, the higher their status and respect.

The stark difference in ideologies inevitably led to war.

In the wilderness, the strong commanded respect. The beastified, atavistic mutants were clearly stronger as individuals than the ordinary Beastkind.

Although they initially had fewer numbers and could only fight evenly with the other side, over time, their numbers grew, and they began to display overwhelming power in the war.

After the bloodshed, the opposition naturally disappeared.

Thus, the wilderness transformed into the scene that Han Yi witnessed, where "the beast is revered, and humans are the deviants."

"Perhaps this is related to the backup plan that Emperor One prepared for the demonic beast race. But from the looks of it, his plan seems to have failed."

"The bloodline of demonic beasts, once activated, is vastly superior to ordinary humans."

Li Fan then thought of the deity of that world—the "Mystic Fate Black bird."

Although there were other beings within the Mystic Black Bird clan, Li Fan felt an inexplicable sensation when he saw the deity’s statue.

This Heavenly Fate Mystic Blackbird was, in fact, "Little Black," the creature he had once possessed in the Fallen Immortal Realm and who had once accompanied Xu Ke.

There was no concrete evidence, just a mysterious feeling possibly due to his previous possession.

"Did it really fall?"

"Strange."

"Even a mere Azure Luan bird is still alive. It doesn’t make sense that the Black Bird, fused with the fate of an entire small world, fell first."

Li Fan’s brow furrowed, puzzled.

After pondering for a while, he felt relieved.

Among humans, strength often corresponds to longevity.

However, among demonic beasts, this principle doesn’t necessarily apply.

Although he was very interested in that small world, Li Fan also knew that now was not the right time to explore it.

Just because Han Yi was only at the peak of Qi Condensation and unable to use spiritual energy, yet could still stir up storms there, didn’t mean that small world was devoid of danger.

It’s important to understand that Han Yi, by using the 'Heavenly Fate Sutra' to control ambient fate, essentially acted as a half-destined child of fate.

Naturally, this allowed him to turn misfortunes into blessings and avert disasters.

If Li Fan recklessly barged in without using similar fate-manipulating techniques, who knows what sort of bad luck he might encounter?

He could very well run into a thousand-year-old demon lurking in the wilderness the moment he stepped in.

After all, the sense of impending danger he had when he wanted to follow Han Yi into the undersea cave that day was no illusion.

Without mastering fate-control techniques, Li Fan wasn’t willing to take on unknown risks.

“No matter; soon enough, I’ll learn what exactly happened back then in the Fallen Immortal Realm,” he thought, as he withdrew his gaze and headed to the nearest outpost island.

Before long, he arrived at Chongwu Island.

The guard of Chongwu Island, named Huang Ranqi, was at the late Foundation Establishment stage.

As his nominal subordinate, Li Fan knew a bit about him.

He was petty about minor issues, but clueless in major ones—constantly making small mistakes and insatiably greedy.

He was, in fact, the perfect candidate.

Li Fan concealed his true cultivation, displaying only the aura of peak Foundation Establishment as he went to pay his respects.

“What’s your name, fellow Daoist?” Huang Ranqi asked warmly, handing him a cup of tea with a friendly smile.

At the moment, Li Fan looked like his real self, not the “Ancient Heavenly Mechanism Cultivator” appearance, so naturally, Huang Ranqi didn’t recognize him.

Li Fan cupped his hands and said, “I am Li Fan.”

Cough, cough... Huang Ranqi, who had been sipping his tea with a relaxed look, almost spat it out upon hearing that.

He coughed a few times, trying to ease his embarrassment.

After a moment, he asked in surprise, “You’re also named Li Fan?”

Li Fan was taken aback and asked curiously, “Why would you say that, Daoist Huang? What do you mean, ‘also’?”

“Could it be, you know another cultivator named Li Fan?” He quickly realized and seemed genuinely surprised.

“Heh, fellow Daoist, have you been in closed-door cultivation for many years? Do you not even know the name of the Secret Envoy?” Huang Ranqi squinted his eyes, scrutinizing Li Fan closely.

“You’ve guessed right! I used to be a wandering cultivator in the Congyun Sea. A few years ago, I ventured out to find a breakthrough opportunity. Who would’ve thought I’d accidentally stumble into a dangerous small world and only recently manage to escape by pure luck,” Li Fan shook his head with a look of deep emotion.

As he spoke, he vividly described his experiences in the small world to Huang Ranqi.

“No spiritual energy, but filled with strange beasts?” Huang Ranqi was indeed captivated by the strange scenes Li Fan described.

“It’s quite impressive that you made it out of such a dangerous place alive,” he remarked with a sigh.

Li Fan nodded in agreement and replied, “You’re absolutely right, Daoist. Near-death experiences often bring insight. Not long after I returned, I broke through my bottleneck and reached peak Foundation Establishment.”

“As I mentioned, I used to be just a wandering cultivator. For the sake of so-called ‘freedom,’ I didn’t want to join the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance and endure endless toil. But after this life-threatening ordeal, I’ve come to understand—if you’re alive, freedom doesn’t mean a thing!”

Li Fan spoke sincerely, “So, I humbly ask for your introduction, Daoist!”

Based on his past-life experience of merging with objects and traversing countless eras, Li Fan knew that the Sky-Shrouding Hand Technique, which had been refined repeatedly in the struggle between the Covering Heaven Alliance and the Mysterious Net, could evade the Tianxuan Mirror's perception.

In addition, the 'Mysterious Transformation of True Spirit'—derived from the Derivation Law Jade—was a mystical technique capable of altering one's aura, fate, blood, spiritual consciousness, and soul essence.

Thus, the Tianxuan Mirror shouldn't detect that he and the Secret Envoy Li Fan of Congyun Immortal City were actually the same person.

After some brief conversation, Huang Ranqi took his leave, and Li Fan was able to rejoin the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance under his true identity.

"It seems my guess was correct: the mirrored version of the Tianxuan Mirror, created by the 'Empowerment' process, is far weaker than the original."

"While part of this is due to my Sky-Shrouding Hand Technique being ahead of its time, infiltrating was still surprisingly easy."

"No wonder the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance is filled with spies from the Five Elders Association."

Li Fan felt a sense of irony.

On the day the Five Elders Association attacked the Ten Thousand Immortal Island, the Tianxuan Mirror inexplicably ceased to function, turning into a mere stone. This had inspired Li Fan to make this bold attempt, which ended as he had anticipated.

Not lingering in the Tianxuan Mirror, he used his contribution points to purchase a storage ring. Then, he traveled through the teleportation formation to Tianling Prefecture.

Without leaving Tianling City, Li Fan quietly waited there. If the Five Elders Association did indeed assault the Five Elements Great

Cave Heaven, his past-life experience indicated that a Dao Integration cultivator would fall in the brutal battle.

And the spectacle of a Dao Integration cultivator’s death would encompass the entire region.

"Heavenly Spirit Flowers? Yes, yes, please take a look at these," the shopkeeper said eagerly, displaying several potted flowers for Li Fan.

The Heavenly Spirit Flower was a unique product of Tianling Prefecture. Each flower bloomed with a different number of petals, and each petal would display a unique scene—whether a lush green mountain, a mighty river, or a snow-covered landscape. One flower could encapsulate the beauty of various places in the world, as if blessed by heaven itself.

If you were to ask the flower’s purpose... the answer would be, none.

Its only use was ornamental. Unfortunately, the flower had a short lifespan; once in bloom, it only lasted seven days, or about a month if stored in a specially crafted wooden box.

Moreover, it was extremely sensitive to any form of energy. Exposure to spiritual energy fluctuations or spatial teleportation could blur or even erase the scenes on its petals, rendering it worthless.

Thus, cultivators who wished to admire the Heavenly Spirit Flower had no choice but to come to Tianling Prefecture to see it in its prime.

This rarity made the Heavenly Spirit Flower even more precious outside of Tianling Prefecture.

In his past life, during the great battle in Tianling Prefecture, the Heavenly Spirit Flower almost went extinct. But with everyone’s attention on the unprecedented conflict, no one cared to speculate about its price. Once the war ended and Tianling Prefecture began to recover, the flower gradually returned.

However, cultivators later discovered that due to the lingering bloodshed in its growth environment, the scenes on the flower’s petals no longer depicted natural beauty but rather horrifying images of cultivators slaughtering one another—a truly tragic sight.

People longed for the once-beautiful Heavenly Spirit Flower, but the scenes on the petals were beyond control. Attempts to transplant the flower to other regions failed, as it would instantly wither.

Thus, the Heavenly Spirit Flower, once a unique spectacle of Tianling, vanished from the world.

Recalling this past-life anecdote, Li Fan carefully selected a seventeen-petaled Heavenly Spirit Flower in the shop.

"This one."

"Just one? Won’t you choose more?" The shopkeeper seemed disappointed.

"One is enough," Li Fan said with a smile.

"Three hundred contribution points," the shopkeeper replied, quoting the price.

Li Fan paid gladly and carefully took the sealed wooden box containing the Heavenly Spirit Flower.

In the box, the Heavenly Spirit Flower bloomed vibrantly. With special treatment, it would stay in bloom for about thirty days.

Chapter 560


However, Li Fan knew of a way to completely seal it in ice.

Since the extinction of the Heavenly Spirit Flower, many formerly secret techniques have gradually spread.

One such technique, named Collection of Flowers, uses painting to permanently seal the Heavenly Spirit Flower within a canvas.

Originally, the Collection of Flowers wasn't intended specifically for the Heavenly Spirit Flower; rather, it was meant to immortalize every beautiful flower in the world.

The author of the Collection of Flowers, Zhao Chong, was deeply passionate about flowers. He vowed to see every flower under heaven.

So, he set out to record all flowers using brush and ink. Unfortunately, his talent for painting was mediocre, and his depictions were so far from reality they bordered on sacrilege.

After racking his brains, Zhao Chong eventually pioneered a unique approach—a "painting" technique that directly sealed real flowers onto paper. Though it lacked artistic spirit, it was lifelike and extraordinarily realistic.

In his previous life, Zhao Chong’s Collection of Flowers did not include the Heavenly Spirit Flower. Although he had long heard of its legendary beauty, he had intended to save the best for last. Consequently, he hesitated too long to capture it.

After the war that ravaged Tianling Prefecture, its natural wonders were no more. Zhao Chong deeply regretted his delay, crying his lament to anyone who would listen.

---At this moment, Li Fan put the box containing the Heavenly Spirit Flower into his pocket and continued wandering around the shop, feigning casual interest. Only after receiving a hostile glare from the shopkeeper did he reluctantly leave.

After exiting the shop, he made his way to the City Discourse Tower Hall in the city and rented a room. Using the Tianxuan Mirror, he purchased three items: [Ice Dew], [Image Capture Seal], and [Thousand Colors Silk]. Though not particularly valuable, they cost nearly all his contribution points.

Taking out the Tianling Flower’s seventeen petals, he placed them onto the [Thousand Colors Silk] and then soaked them in [Ice Dew]. As cold air gradually spread across the petals, he pressed down with the [Image Capture Seal].

Following the process Zhao Chong had described in his previous life, Li Fan carefully executed each step. The [Thousand Colors Silk] emitted a rainbow of lights, reflecting through the Tianling Flower and onto the [Image Capture Seal]. Like threads being woven together, the sealed Tianling Flower fused with the [Thousand Colors Silk] and [Image Capture Seal].

The light slowly faded, and soon a thin, transparent “paper” appeared in Li Fan’s hands. Although it felt flat, the flower on it looked just like a real, blooming flower. Every petal’s detail was vivid, and it seemed even to tremble slightly.

“That’s it,” Li Fan breathed a sigh of relief.

“All that remains is to add a protective layer of spiritual consciousness to prevent anyone from maliciously damaging it. But there’s no rush.”

Li Fan looked at the “artwork” in his hand, knowing it would soon become one of a kind in the Xuanhuang Realm. Its value would be incalculable, far beyond mere wealth; its unique appeal could accomplish tasks contribution points alone couldn’t.

With a smile, he admired it a bit longer before carefully storing it away.

He left the City Central Tower and wandered around Tianling City for three more days.

He offered the Spirit of the Black Marsh and united with the Dao in body and spirit. In Tianling Prefecture, he was gravely injured by the cultivator Xu Huating. His spirit perished, and he returned his Dao to the heavens.”

“...It really is him.” A sharp glint appeared in Li Fan’s eyes.

The fall of a Dao Integration cultivator meant an unavoidable battle was imminent. Soon, the Ten Thousand Immortals Alliance would issue a war preparation announcement, and all provincial borders would be sealed.

Li Fan had to leave this perilous place before then and return to the relative calm of Congyun Sea which had been relatively calm during the battle of Tianling Prefecture.

As other cultivators stood frozen, Li Fan had already slipped into the teleportation formation. Only after he vanished did murmurs fill Tianling City.

Shortly after:

In Congyun Sea.

"Starting from this moment, the Ten Thousand Immortals Alliance enters a Class B state of readiness."

"Once any foreign cultivators are detected, they are to be killed on the spot, regardless of life or death."

The announcement repeated three times before ending.

He Zhenghao was initially stunned, then his eyes widened in shock as he jumped to his feet.

The Ten Thousand Immortals Alliance was preparing for war with the Five Elders Association?

Speculative traders are astonishingly quick to react.

The Heavenly Healing Pill, standardized Big Dipper Armor, Divine Martial Thunder, and Hundred Battle Formation Diagram—all the materials Li Fan had ordered He Zhenghao to stockpile—were rising in price at breakneck speed.

Not only these items, but anything related to survival and combat in the Tianxuan Mirror had surged in price.

Everyone knew that the current supply couldn’t possibly meet the cultivators’ demand.

With war looming, who could guarantee they wouldn’t end up on the battlefield? The more protection and preparation one had, the better one’s chances of survival.

Compared to one’s life, contribution points were inconsequential. Even at double the price, cultivators would pay willingly.

In a flash of insight, He Zhenghao realized, “The Lord’s foresight is truly uncanny!”

Looking at the soaring prices of his stockpile, He Zhenghao was both delighted and terrified.

The joy came from seeing his 100 million contribution points' worth of goods increase by a third in such a short time. But he feared that hoarding goods might lead to punishment by the Immortal alliance.

Chapter 562


“Counterattack against the Immortal Cultivation World, huh…”

Sima Changkong squinted slightly, as if recalling something.

After a moment, he slowly spoke: “Mentioning this now, most cultivators refer to it as a farce. But in reality, the coalition of the small worlds was far more than just a trivial spectacle.”

“Otherwise, why would the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance and the Five Elders Association, which have always been adversaries, be forced to join forces?”

A faint gleam flashed in Li Fan’s eyes. Moving closer, he asked in an uncertain tone, “Alliance? You mean they united just to deal with the coalition of the small worlds?”

“Sima, could it be that you’re mistaken? Wasn’t it said that the people of these small worlds are mere exiled mortals?”

“Why would we cultivators struggle so much against this bunch of ants? Besides, we have the Longevity Immortal Heavenly Sovereign overseeing everything. Could they really have defeated us?”

Sima Changkong was unperturbed by Li Fan’s disbelief.

Instead, he smiled faintly and flicked his finger, sending a drop of blood between them.

The blood drop hovered mid-air, pulsing as if alive, then spread outwards to form a canvas of misty blood.On this blood canvas, scene after scene of thrilling battles appeared.

One side of the battle seemed to be the cultivators of the Xuanhuang Realm.

But the other side, capable of flight and other supernatural feats, clearly wasn’t mortal either.

Their fighting techniques varied, yet they could go toe-to-toe with the cultivators.

Some relied purely on physical strength, enduring attacks from flying swords and spells with their bodies. They would approach swiftly, tearing cultivators apart with their bare hands.

Others stayed in the distance, manipulating strange energy from afar, striking down from the heavens, targeting cultivators with pinpoint accuracy.

Most disturbingly, some were not even humanoid, appearing as transparent, white, human-like skins. They drifted through the battlefield, and whenever they encountered a severely wounded cultivator, they attached themselves to them.

To the amazement of all, those who had been near death would spring back to life as soon as these white skins adhered to them.

Even those missing limbs would experience regeneration and recover their combat strength once possessed.

Li Fan stared intently at the constantly shifting scenes in the blood screen, his expression growing graver.

“Where are our higher-ranking cultivators from the Xuanhuang Realm? Did the Dao Integration and Longevity Immortal stage experts just sit back and watch this slaughter unfold?” Li Fan asked, his voice tinged with frustration.

Sima Changkong shook his head slightly. “Not at all. Naturally, they had their own adversaries.”

“Although our ancestors couldn’t witness the battles of the stronger cultivators firsthand due to their limited cultivation level, it’s said that we in the Xuanhuang Realm suffered devastating losses as well.”

With a sigh, Sima Changkong continued, “For nearly 500 years, neither side has been willing to reignite the conflict. They both chose to focus on recuperation.”

Li Fan was astonished. “Were they really that strong? Were these people truly from the small worlds?”

“Yes, and no.” Sima Changkong summoned a fish-like spirit beast, poured another drink for the two of them, and continued.

“They were nothing more than pawns under someone else’s control.”

“The true mastermind behind them lies elsewhere.”

Li Fan perked up, intrigued. “What do you mean by that?”

“It seems their origins trace back to the time just after the ancient calamity descended. The details are sparse, even in the records of our ancestors.”

“However, from scattered post-war accounts, we know that they appeared to be a group of those who had ‘left and returned.’”

Sima Changkong looked puzzled as he spoke slowly.

“Not only did the Dao Integration cultivators of our Xuanhuang Realm refer to them as traitors, but even cultivators who didn’t know their identities would feel a deep-seated hatred at the sight of them.”

“During the battles, bolts of lightning would even descend from the heavens, striking these people directly.”

“It’s as if the entire Xuanhuang Realm despised them.”

“Left and returned…traitors…” Li Fan murmured, sinking into contemplation.

Sima Changkong’s descriptions, combined with his previous experiences in Senior Sister Zhao’s illusion, stirred some guesses within him.

In the past, when various calamities like the incompatibility of different cultivation methods and the immortal-mortal miasma descended, the ten great sects initially planned to unite and face these crises together.

But as the situation deteriorated too quickly, each sect had to fend for itself, let alone assist each other.

When disaster loomed, each sect made its own choice.

Some vanished completely in the annals of history due to internal strife.

Others sealed themselves off, hiding from the world, clinging to life.

But some, like the Nanming Demon Beast Mountain and the Heavenly Sword Sect, chose to flee from the Xuanhuang Realm altogether.

“As Emperer One once said, within any group, individuals will make their own choices. Without an absolute leader, it’s impossible to act with a unified will.”

“Each cultivator chose differently, which is only natural.”

“When they left, they may have taken something with them. Perhaps that’s why even the Xuanhuang Realm itself holds a grudge against them.”

“It’s uncertain why they returned, but for them to return unharmed despite the immense pull of the ‘Immortal Ruins,’ they must be extremely powerful.”

Li Fan’s mind gradually settled as he turned to Sima Changkong with even greater admiration.

As expected of the Xuanhuang Realm’s historian.

Over the past millennium, countless forgotten or hidden stories could be traced back to Sima Changkong.

Ever since Li Fan returned from the Tianling Prefecture, he had come to Sima Changkong’s underwater crystal residence to avoid the war’s impact.

Thanks to his previous interactions with Sima’s projection, coupled with his extensive knowledge of obscure facts, he quickly earned Sima’s favor.

The two enjoyed daily banquets, freely discussing the Xuanhuang Realm’s history, thoroughly enjoying each other's company.

To prevent outside disturbances and gather more information, Li Fan even volunteered to help set up stealth and protective formations for Sima Changkong’s crystal abode.

Impressed by Li Fan’s enthusiasm, Sima felt he’d found a kindred spirit, and their bond deepened.

“Peace is temporary, while war is the eternal theme of history.” After a long silence, Sima Changkong sighed, setting down his raised cup, his enthusiasm waning.

“Why do you say that…” Li Fan trailed off in sudden realization.

“Has the war between the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance and the Five Elders Association begun?”

Sima Changkong nodded heavily. “Who knows how many cultivators will perish on the battlefield.”

“This is the way of the heavens; we are not the Longevity Immortal Heavenly Sovereigns. How could we resist? Drink, let’s drink!” Li Fan poured another drink for Sima, consoling him.

“You’re right.” Sima Changkong drained his cup, swallowing both the fine wine and his sorrow.

Li Fan then smoothly shifted the topic elsewhere.

…

Time flew by, and a year passed in the blink of an eye.

The war between the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance and the Five Elders Association had reached a fever pitch, and Li Fan had fully settled in Sima Changkong’s residence, not leaving once in the entire year.

Chapter 563


“Out of wine?”

“But before I go, please let me know the ingredients used to make that wine. I’ll collect some for you…”

Though he hadn’t gone out all year, Li Fan wasn’t entirely unaware of the outside world.

His clone, Zhou Qingang, had been running himself ragged.

Setting aside numerous trivial matters, the most urgent task was the 'Monthly List of Recruited Cultivators'.

Even though the Congyun Sea’s forces were severely weakened, the Immortal Alliance Headquarters continued to issue conscription orders.

However, given the Congyun Sea’s current state, most recruited cultivators were spared from direct combat.

They were primarily assigned to logistics and support roles.

Still, no one could guarantee that the war wouldn’t expand, eventually involving them in the crossfire.

As a result, no one wanted to be sent to the Tianling Prefecture.

Compiling the recruitment list had become a challenging task.

Initially, it was Li Fan’s duty as a Secret Envoy to finalize this list.

But with Li Fan in “seclusion,” the task technically fell to his trusted associates He Zhenghao and Gao Yuan, who had been authorized to make decisions in his absence.

Yet, He Zhenghao was known as an easygoing person, while Gao Yuan was skilled at diplomacy and careful to avoid offending anyone.

Neither wanted to be responsible for sending people to possible death.

If the individuals sent to battle perished, that was one thing. But if they survived and returned with accolades, it could create lasting enmity.

Therefore, they secretly approached the more reclusive “Zhou Qingang” to ask for help.

Naturally, “Zhou Qingang” declined.

There was no reason for him to take on such a troublesome task.

If you don’t buy, someone else will!” Unlike his hesitant demeanor from a year ago, He Zhenghao now appeared quite nonchalant in the face of “Zhou Qingang” reaction.

Only when He Zhenghao started feeling uncomfortable did he look away.

“Alright, I’ll take care of it,” Li Fan agreed.

He Zhenghao and Gao Yuan exchanged a look, their faces lighting up with joy.

A soft glow emitted from it, and before long, a replica of Sima Changkong stood before them.

After dressing his clone, the replica clasped his hands in respect to the two of them before departing toward Tianling Prefecture.

Only then did Sima Changkong exhale, though now visibly weaker, his face ashen, barely able to stand.

“No problem. Just need to rest a bit,” Sima Changkong replied weakly, shaking his head.

“That’s good. I initially thought this was merely a 'Blood Split Clone' rather than your original form.”

“After cultivating the 'Bloodline Historical Archive', there’s hardly such a thing as an original form anymore,” Sima Changkong said with a bitter smile. “The Congyun Sea is the only place that has enough blood essence left for me to immediately craft a new clone.”

Hearing this, Li Fan nodded in understanding.

Soon, he frowned. “Brother Sima, crafting these clones seems to drain your energy substantially?”

“You’re correct, Daoist Friend. I need to drink Heavenly Green Brew regularly to replenish my lost vitality,” Sima Changkong admitted.

“Oh no! I've been drinking so much of Brother Sima’s brew without realizing…” Li Fan exclaimed with exaggerated regret.

“Haha, Brother Li, there’s no need to feel bad!” Sima Changkong reassured him.

“As I’ve said before, cultivating our Sima family’s 'Bloodline Historical Archive' makes our lifespans similar to mortals.”

“Life is fleeting, just a few short decades, gone in the blink of an eye.”

“In such a short existence, having a true friend like you is worth it. So live for today! I’m grateful you drink with me daily; how could I blame you?” Sima Changkong chuckled in reply.

Chapter 565

Sima Changkong sighed deeply. “You flatter me, my friend. However, your latter statement is indeed correct.”“The Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance has deployed a truly devastating weapon this time.”

As he spoke, he activated a drop of his blood, attempting to create a blood screen to show Li Fan what had transpired, as he had done before.

Images indeed began to appear on the blood screen.

But then, Sima Changkong’s expression abruptly changed.

“How can this be?!” he exclaimed in shock, his face full of disbelief.

Li Fan fixed his gaze on the blood screen.

It showed the overwhelming Five Elders Association cultivators forming a formation and encircling a group of Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance cultivators.

The Alliance’s side, despite being surrounded and numbering only about a hundred, showed no trace of fear. Each was incredibly valiant, as if empowered by some mysterious force.

They charged fearlessly toward an enemy outnumbering them a hundredfold.

This seemingly one-sided battle with a foregone conclusion suddenly shifted dramatically.

At the center of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance cultivators, one individual raised something high.

And then…

Without warning, swathes of Five Elders Association cultivators fell from the sky.

They crashed to the ground, bloody and immobile, groaning in agony.

The Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance cultivators appeared to have anticipated this. They swiftly and mercilessly harvested the lives of their enemies.

For a moment, the sky was filled with a strange, overlapping phenomenon of falling bodies, forming a bizarre and grim tableau.

“How could this happen?” Sima Changkong murmured in disbelief as he stared at the recorded scene on the blood screen, his expression dazed.

Seeing Sima Changkong’s strange reaction, Li Fan suddenly thought of something and asked, “Brother, does the scene on this blood screen differ from what you witnessed with your own eyes?”

“Precisely!” Sima Changkong nodded immediately.

“What I saw was a cultivator holding a small, square mirror aloft.”

“From the heavens, countless green threads descended.”

“It was precisely these inexplicable green threads that instantly disabled the Five Elders Association cultivators.”

“But why…”

Even after explaining, Sima Changkong remained unsettled, clearly struggling to accept what had happened.

For someone like Sima Changkong, whose purpose was to faithfully record historical events, this inability to document the truth was a significant blow.

“Unrecordable… green energy…” Li Fan narrowed his eyes.

“So, it’s really the Mysterious Net. I had speculated before that the net had descended upon the world. Indeed, once the war escalated, the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance couldn’t resist using it.”

“However, the current Mysterious Net differs from the Tianxuan Spirit Locking Formation I encountered in my previous life.”

“It’s surprising that a single handheld mirror can summon it.”

“Is it an incomplete prototype, or…”

Li Fan fell into deep thought.

“No, I must find a way to document it,” Sima Changkong muttered, still visibly shaken, seemingly on the verge of obsession.

“You’re overthinking this, Brother Sima. Even if you can’t directly record it through images or language, you can still indirectly describe its existence,” Li Fan reminded him.

Sima Changkong froze momentarily.

Then he lit up with joy. “How foolish of me!”

He smacked his forehead, forced out a few drops of blood, and fused them into the blood screen.

The blood merged into distorted text that became part of the screen.

> “The Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance and the Five Elders Association clashed in the northeast of the Tianling Prefecture…”

> “Threads of green light descended from the heavens…”

> “Those affected lost their spiritual powers and fell to the ground.”

...

As the characters on the surface gradually stabilized, they seemed about to merge completely with the blood curtain.

Suddenly, a faint green line emerged from the distorted blood characters.

"Not good!"

Sima Changkong’s face turned pale instantly as he cried out in alarm.

Before he could finish his sentence, the green line had already transformed into a torrent of green light.

The green light wreaked havoc, distorting the scenes recorded within the blood curtain beyond recognition. Then, it abruptly withdrew and condensed into a single point of light.

For a moment, there was silence.

The green point suddenly erupted.

"Retreat—"

The moment the green line appeared, even before Sima Changkong could shout his warning, Li Fan had already pushed the Purple Cloud Divine Thunder Escape to its limit.

At the same time, two bony wings emerged from his back, augmented by the 'Soaring Peng' technique.

Using the fastest speed he had ever achieved since stepping into the world of cultivation, Li Fan fled into the distance.

However, Li Fan hadn’t anticipated that the Mysterious Net’s reaction would be this intense—more violent than the uproar it caused previously in the Ten Thousand Immortal Island's Martial Hall.

The green point exploded, and the shockwaves swept out in all directions in an instant.

As the green light neared his body, Li Fan felt a pang of unwillingness but still prepared to invoke his protective technique, [Truth].

However, he quickly swallowed the remaining "Truth" part of the chant.

Because he realized that the charging energy of [Truth] for body protection hadn't changed at all.

"Hmm? Was it just a false alarm?"

Li Fan stopped fleeing immediately and hovered in mid-air.

After waiting for a while and finding nothing unusual, with the surroundings as calm as before, he hesitated briefly but decided to return and investigate.

Inside the Crystal Palace, everything appeared as it was before.

But an eerie silence pervaded the space.

Sima Changkong remained in his spot, the expression of terror frozen on his face, his body utterly motionless.

"Brother Sima?"

Li Fan called out from a distance.

There was no response.

After a moment, Li Fan cautiously approached. "Brother Sima?"

Although he could still faintly sense the vitality within Sima Changkong, for some reason, there was no reaction from him whatsoever.

Moreover...

That trace of vitality seemed as though it had solidified.

Feeling that something was amiss, Li Fan began to back away slowly.

"Pop!"

At that instant, Sima Changkong’s entire body suddenly burst from within.

What sprayed out was not fresh blood and flesh but pools of viscous green liquid.

The green fluid splattered all over the floor of the 'Crystal Palace'.

Li Fan narrowly avoided the green liquid's assault.

Staring at the obliterated remains of Sima Changkong, his face twitched slightly.

Chapter 566


The green slime covering the ground seemed to retain some form of self-awareness even after Sima Changkong's death.

Like a writhing worm, it crawled slowly toward the surrounding area.

“What a domineering Mysterious Net!”

He pulled out a blood-red talisman from his storage ring and concentrated his mind on it. “Daoist Sima, are you alright?”

He waited for a long time but received no response.

“This is bad. Even all his clones are gone,” Li Fan muttered, his face twitching.The Mysterious Net’s pursuit ability was frighteningly powerful.

Initially, Li Fan thought only the clone in the Congyun Sea was destroyed. But now, it seemed...

Sima Changkong’s fate was sealed.

The blood-red communication talisman was crafted with Sima Changkong’s own blood essence, a unique refinement.

As long as any of Sima Changkong's Blood-Split Clones existed in the world, Li Fan could contact him through it.

But now, all his attempts to communicate were met with silence.

The outcome was clear.

The image of Sima Changkong's laughter, discussions over wine, and philosophical debates with Li Fan remained vivid in his mind.

But life is unpredictable—here one moment, gone the next.

“Sima Changkong, farewell! I’ll find you in the next life for a drink!”

Li Fan didn’t feel overwhelming sadness; instead, he shook his head lightly, wielded the 'Five Elements Annihilation Sword', and destroyed the underwater Crystal Palace, creating a makeshift tomb for Sima Changkong.

“To achieve this level of destruction…”

“The Mysterious Net's offensive power is even stronger than I remember from my previous life.”

“This is no half-finished product,” Li Fan said grimly.

Since the anchor point nine years ago, many Nascent Soul and higher-level cultivators from various states’ Tianji and Formation Halls were summoned to the Ten Thousand Immortals Alliance headquarters.

After that, there had been no news from them.

Later, the Ten Thousand Immortals Alliance issued a 'Recruitment Order', gathering the most talented formation masters from across the land.

Four years had passed since then, and now it seemed they had produced results.

“The Ten Thousand Immortals Alliance has revealed their trump card. Let’s see how the Five Elders Association responds next.”

“With my earlier warning, they shouldn’t be entirely unprepared.”

“Unfortunately, the battlefield in Tianling Prefecture is too dangerous. The only one capable of live updates, Daoist Sima, has perished.”

“The detailed battle situation is still unclear,” Li Fan thought with a trace of regret.

However, one thing was certain: with a weapon like the Mysterious Net, the war in Tianling Prefecture was nearing its conclusion.

“It’s progressing faster than expected.”

“But for me, this is good news. I’ve already achieved Golden Core perfection. Everything is ready.”

“Once the war ends and the Ten Thousand Immortals Alliance relocates the Five Elements Great Cave Heaven to their stronghold, I’ll explore Tianling Prefecture Void.”

Feedback from his many subordinates in the Congyun Sea continued to flow steadily into Li Fan’s dantian, stored within his 'Calamity Body.'

The first Calamity Body was nearly complete.

At his current cultivation speed, Li Fan estimated, “If I break through to the Nascent Soul stage, I’ll likely reach mid-stage Nascent Soul shortly after.”

Shaking his head, he put aside his fantasies.

Before the war ended, caution was still the priority.

Li Fan decided not to seek a new location. Instead, he used the 'Five Elements Annihilation Sword' to carve out a cave dwelling deep in an ocean trench.

With formations and the 'Sky-Shrouding Hand' secret technique sealing the area, he finally felt secure.

Over the past year, Li Fan had also visited the Fallen Immortal Realm.

However, returning to the Beast Taming Sect from the Nanming Beast Mountain was a long journey.

Most of his time during that trip was spent on the road.

While cultivating the improved 'Creation Furnace Technique' taught by Mr.Bai, Li Fan, inhabiting Little Black, felt calm and focused.

But when he returned to the sect on Xiao Qing with Xu Ke, he discovered that Lu Ya and Emperor Sanmo were nowhere to be found.

Even when Li Fan left, they still hadn’t reappeared.

“There’s still half a year before the next entry.”

“Let’s prepare for forming my Nascent Soul first.”

As Dao Deviation Stone’s brilliance flickered in his mind, insights from countless Nascent Soul manuals resurfaced.

Revisiting them, comparing, and validating, Li Fan felt he gained even more.

Time flew in cultivation.

In the blink of an eye, three months passed.

While Li Fan’s true body immersed itself in meditation, one of his clones, Zhou Qingang, suddenly received an invitation card.

“Liu Yihang?” Li Fan's expression shifted.

The 'True Cauldron of Medicine King' hadn’t returned.

Clearly, this Liu Yihang wasn’t the adopted son of the Medicine King Sect’s Master Liu Ruchen.

“In that case, he must be from the Five Elders Association,” Li Fan deduced.

In their previous transaction, Li Fan had asked the Five Elders Association to donate ten million contribution points under Liu Yihang’s alias to He Zhenghao.

Sure enough, Liu Yihang’s name appeared in the fundraising records.

“Something urgent must have happened.”

“They didn’t leave contact details before, yet now they risk exposure to seek me out.”

Li Fan opened the invitation card, memorized the meeting location, and then destroyed it with spiritual energy.

Late at night, he quietly set out alone.

The meeting point was on a mortal island 500 miles northwest of Congyun Immortal City.

At the island’s center stood a bamboo forest.

Within the forest was a humble hut.

Li Fan stepped inside and, upon seeing the figure within, his eyes narrowed.

“It’s him.”

Though the man concealed his appearance with secret techniques, Li Fan instantly recognized him as the Five Elders Association’s contact from their previous transaction regarding the 'Ten Thousand Immortals Alliance Entrance Exam'.

“What should I call you?”

“During our last meeting, I didn’t even notice you weren’t the real Zhou Qingang.”

“Heh, when my boss told me, I was truly shocked,” the man said sarcastically.

“Did you risk so much to find me just to ask that?”

“Ridiculous!” Li Fan snorted, turning to leave.

The Five Elders cultivator’s expression changed instantly. “Wait!”

He hurried to block Li Fan, softening his tone. “Fellow Daoist, let’s talk things through…”

Li Fan gave him a sidelong glance before returning to his seat.

The Five Elders cultivator heaved a sigh of relief and explained his purpose for the meeting.

“The Xuantian Spirit-Sealing Formation Diagram?”

Li Fan squinted and immediately refused. “I don’t have it!”

Instead of being disappointed, the Five Elders cultivator seemed encouraged. “Daoist, you didn’t ask what the formation was but declined outright.”

“That only proves you know of it.”

“Please, you must help us!”

His tone was sincere and pleading.

Chapter 567


Although Li Fan wasn’t entirely sure what the opponent meant by the so-called “Xuantian Spirit-Sealing Formation”.

However, it wasn’t hard to infer that the term referred to the Mysterious Net, which had begun to demonstrate its extraordinary potential on the battlefield of Tianling Prefecture.

Without betraying any emotion, Li Fan probed, “Based on our calculations, even with the assistance of the Xuantian Spirit-Sealing Formation, the Five Elders Association shouldn’t be losing ground so rapidly or finding itself in such a dire position, correct?”

The other party sighed and admitted, “We truly underestimated them this time. Who could have imagined that the Ten Thousand Immortals Alliance would be able to recreate this ancient formation so quickly?”

“And it seems to be even more formidable than the recorded descriptions.”

The Five Elders Association cultivator spoke with frustration: “Our countermeasures haven’t been fully prepared yet. That’s why the situation on the Tianling Prefecture battlefield has become rather precarious for now.”

“That’s why we urgently need a method to weaken their formation.”

Li Fan remained silent, rhythmically tapping his fingers on the table as if deep in thought.

“To acquire the formation diagram for the Xuantian Spirit-Sealing Formation, even for us, would come at an enormous cost. Some comrades who have infiltrated the Ten Thousand Immortals Alliance would likely need to sacrifice their lives.”

“And even then, success is far from guaranteed…”After a long pause, Li Fan finally spoke, his tone hesitant. “This matter is of great significance. I cannot make a decision on my own. Let’s do this—give me three days, and I’ll return here with an answer.”

Although the Five Elders Association cultivator was anxious, he recognized the validity of Li Fan’s reasoning and reluctantly nodded in agreement.

“By the way, let’s meet at a different location next time. These are turbulent times, and it’s better to err on the side of caution.” With that, he gave Li Fan the coordinates of another island.

Li Fan clasped his hands in farewell and left swiftly, returning to the Congyun Immortal City.

“Tianxuan Spirit Locking, Xuantian Sealing Spirit.”

“Ancient times, Tianxuan Mirror…”

“Xuantian Sect, huh?”

In his secluded chamber, Li Fan’s gaze flickered as he sank into contemplation.

“That scene on the battlefield, where countless cultivators plummeted from the sky to the ground in an instant—it felt oddly familiar…”

“That’s right—Nine Mountains Prefecture!”

Within Nine Mountains Prefecture, the nine mountain ranges had the peculiar property of preventing cultivators from flying over them.

In his previous life, Li Fan had traveled to the Ten Thousand Laws Chamber of Commerce in Nine Mountains Prefecture for procurement. There, he had witnessed the tragic fate of several defiant cultivators who fell to their deaths.

“Could there be some connection here?”

Li Fan sifted through his memories, recalling various documents he had read in the past.

According to legend, the nine great mountains of Nine Mountains Prefecture were formed from the meridians of a 'beast of immense size' that had perished in ancient times.

The nine mountains were named: Tianchang (Heavenly Length), Tianduan (Heavenly Shortness), Tianxu (Heavenly Void), Tiancu (Heavenly Promptness), Tianjie (Heavenly Knot), Tiandai (Heavenly Substitution), Tianlao (Heavenly Prison), Tiandong (Heavenly Movement), and Tianxi (Heavenly Fineness).

These mountains were said to secretly form a formation, destabilizing the space in Nine Mountains Prefecture and making even teleportation formation ineffective.

---

This information was something Li Fan had known for some time.

Back then, he dismissed the idea of a beast’s meridians transforming into mountain ranges as a fanciful ancient tale befitting mythology.

However, after personally visiting Nanming Mountain, the sacred ground of ancient beasts within the Fallen Immortal Realm, and witnessing many fearsome creatures from ancient times, Li Fan began to notice certain discrepancies in the legend.

The issue was simple: if the legend were true, the size of this beast was 'unfathomable'.

Nine Mountains Prefecture spanned an area that had taken Li Fan half a year to traverse. A beast large enough to have its meridians cover an entire prefecture—what kind of terrifying existence could that have been?

Compared to it, beings like the Scarlet Nine-Head, Purple Headless, and Azure Divine Dragon were mere ants.

While size doesn’t necessarily correlate with power, Li Fan couldn’t believe that a beast capable of forming the Nine Mountains would be weak.

“Perhaps, this unknown beast holds clues to the origins of the Xuantian Spirit-Sealing Formation.”

Although the name alone suggested a connection to the ancient 'Xuantian Sect', Li Fan couldn’t rule out the possibility of mere coincidence. Being meticulous wouldn’t hurt.

Thus, Li Fan began searching the Tianxuan Mirror for information about the “beast that formed Nine Mountains Prefecture.”

Given the passage of time, records were fragmented and unverifiable. Opinions varied, and no definitive answer could be found.

Li Fan combed through all the records but found nothing credible.

Just when he was reluctantly preparing to give up, a painting titled "Dream Encounter with Ancient Beasts" caught Li Fan's attention.

This painting was not created by anyone in modern times but was a casual sketch by a disciple of the ancient 'Divine Brush Sect'.

After the Divine Brush Sect was annexed by the Pointillism Sect, its artifacts were scattered far and wide.

This particular painting was accidentally obtained by a wandering cultivator. However, during a catastrophic heavenly disaster, the wandering cultivator perished, and the contents of his storage ring were looted.

Only the seemingly worthless items, too cumbersome to carry, were left behind, quietly lying in place.

The abandoned storage ring, deemed useless, was discarded by the roadside like old trash.

After being buried in dust for thousands of years, it was rediscovered by a passing cultivator.

According to this cultivator, named Tang Bowen, he understood the past events through a lingering thousand-year-old resentment within the storage ring.

Of course, this claim might have been fabricated by Tang Bowen to inflate the value of "Dream Encounter with Ancient Beasts."

Regardless, the painting indeed dates back thousands of years.

It depicts over a hundred beasts in various forms, some of which Li Fan had encountered in the Fallen Immortal Realm.

What truly captivated Li Fan about the painting, beyond these obvious beasts, was the hidden presence of another creature.

At the very edge of the painting, it appeared that these hundred beasts were all standing on the body of a colossal being.

However, due to its immense size, it could not be fully depicted.

A sharp light flashed in Li Fan's eyes.

Chapter 568


The exact appearance of the Heavenly Beast, whether it truly resembles a tortoise, is now impossible to verify.

However, with a specific name, it becomes much easier to search for related information.

Though most of the records are fragmented, it can generally be confirmed that the Heavenly Beast was a "totemic" existence in the distant ancient era, seemingly tied closely to a certain form of faith.

"During the war in which the Ten Great Sects of the Immortal Dao annihilated the Xuantian Sect, the Heavenly Beast fell and transformed into Nine Mountains."

"Senior Sister Zhao once mentioned that the Xuantian Sect usurped heavenly authority and could grant mortals [marks], enabling them to wield supernatural powers that only cultivators possess."

"And if they could grant such powers, naturally, they could also revoke them."

"The network was far more focused on monitoring and bestowing than on stripping away powers." After a moment's thought, Li Fan frowned to himself. "The Tianxuan Spirit Locking Formation and the Xuantian Spirit-Sealing Formation might just be two facets of the Xuantian Sect's divine power."

"The so-called [Bestowment] and [Revocation] are essentially wielding heavenly authority, acting in place of the heavens."

With this thought in mind, Li Fan took out a blank encrypted jade slip. The Dao Deviation Stone in his mind hummed faintly as it activated.

The complete formation diagram for the Tianxuan Spirit Locking Formation, deeply etched in his memory from his past life, was imprinted onto the jade slip.

However, Li Fan made a few deliberate omissions, concealing the fine details of the central core formation.

It took him half a day to complete engraving the formation diagram.

Holding the jade slip, Li Fan's expression fluctuated. "While the Tianling Prefecture has achieved a great victory, and the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance appears to have the upper hand, all of this perceived advantage is but an illusion."

"The Longevity Immortal Heavenly Sovereigns of the Five Elders Association have refrained from taking action solely because of the agreement made with the Dharma Transmission Immortal Ancestor in the past."

Previously, he believed that the Immortal Ancestor had left the Xuanhuang Realm. If this became known, with the Five Elders Association boasting the strength of five Longevity Heavenly Sovereigns, the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance would be nearly defenseless. If he were to leak the 'Spirit-Locking Formation Diagram' to the Five Elders Association, it might accelerate the collapse of the alliance, exposing his own fragile position.

But soon, Li Fan realized a flaw in his assumptions.

In his past life, it was only in the 41st year, when Senior Sister Zhao tested the waters, that they confirmed the Immortal Ancestor had indeed departed.

However, no one knew exactly when the immortal ancestor had left.

The only hint lay in the 24th year, when the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance decided to universally implement the Tianxuan Spirit Locking Formation, which might reveal some clues.

Still, Li Fan recalled that in the initial stages of training talents in formation techniques, the alliance showed no urgency.

Perhaps this was because they were unaware of the Immortal Ancestor's departure, or perhaps the Ancestor had genuinely not yet left at that time.

"Should I add fuel to the fire and test the situation?"

For a moment, Li Fan hesitated.

After pondering for a long while, he ultimately chose to set aside the idea for now.

In this life, his main goal was still to achieve Nascent Soul.

Only if the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance triumphed in the Tianling Prefecture War and successfully relocated the Five Elements Great Cave -Heaven would Li Fan have the opportunity to explore the mysterious void continuously birthing these cave-heavens.

If the alliance were to fall, everything would crumble, and he would lose his freedom of action.

"Still, the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance cannot be allowed to feel entirely unpressured. Otherwise, if the Five Elders Association faces defeat after defeat, and the alliance grows complacent, feeling no need to relocate the cave-heavens, it would be problematic."

After a long contemplation, Li Fan crushed the encrypted jade slip in his hand.

He took out another blank slip and began engraving once more.

This time, he omitted even more details, leaving only the outermost formation structures.

"Even a fragment speaks volumes. The Five Elders Association surely has its share of geniuses in formation techniques. With the portion of the formation I reveal, they may not fully dismantle the 'Spirit-Locking Formation', but countering it should not be an issue."

After completing his intricate work, Li Fan’s eyes gleamed as he stored the encrypted jade slip in a separate storage ring.

Three days later.

Li Fan met again with the Five Elders Association's spy.

Hearing this, the spy’s initial excitement dimmed, but he soon regained his composure.

Acquiring even the original formation’s outer structure was a major breakthrough.

The spy fell silent.

"Wait a moment."

Turning his back, he closed his eyes as if consulting with higher-ups.

After a long while, he turned back, drenched in sweat.

"We agree to this deal."

"How long will it take for you to acquire the formation diagram?" the spy from the Five Elders Association impatiently asked, not even waiting for Li Fan to speak.

Using his finger as a pen, he scribbled a few small characters on the stone table and continued, "Forget about contribution points. Some of the Five Elders Association's specialties are very popular in our circles and can serve as bargaining chips."

The spy leaned in to see items listed on the table: Enlightenment Pills, Samantabhadra True Boat, Carefree Crystals, Human Dao Stardust, and Truth-Defying Fruit...

His eyelid twitched uncontrollably.

'Enlightenment Pills' and 'Samantabhadra True Boat' needed no further explanation.

In the Humane Dao Heavenly Domain, the transformation of the heavens and earth followed a framework created by the 'Human Dao Heavenly Sovereign', albeit on a lower tier than the mystical principles of the Xuanhuang Realm. Nevertheless, it was highly valuable for cultivators seeking enlightenment, regardless of their level.

As for the 'Truth-Defying Fruit', it was a unique item from the Realm of Reality.

The fruit could be pre-programmed with specific information, which, once consumed, would warp the consumer's thoughts. They would believe even the most implausible notions as absolute truth.

This ability to turn falsehood into reality made it incredibly potent.

Even Dao Integration cultivators below the Longevity Immortal Realm couldn’t resist its influence.

At that moment, something unexpected occurred.

Radiant golden light erupted from the spy's body, engulfing him completely and coalescing into a golden 'contract scroll', which hovered silently before Li Fan.

The spy himself dissolved into the light, vanishing entirely.

The text was written in faint dark-gold characters.

The terms of the agreement matched what had been negotiated, with no discrepancies.

On the third confirmation, a golden light shot into the depths of Li Fan's soul, while the rest disappeared into the void.

"The contract is sealed. No one bound by it may break its terms," Li Fan murmured with narrowed eyes.

"Not even the Longevity Immortal Heavenly Sovereigns..."

"Can defy it."

"The only power capable of subduing someone as inscrutable as Senior Sister Zhao must be a similarly formidable Longevity Immortal Sovereign."

"Perhaps even stronger."

With this, Li Fan’s speculations about the Five Elders Association’s final, unknown Longevity Sovereign were finally validated.

It was the binding power of this Sovereign’s contracts that maintained the organization’s stability.

Far away, Li Fan’s main body meditated silently, monitoring his soul for any anomalies after his clone, Zhou Qingang, signed the contract.

Nothing seemed amiss.

Yet deep down, he had a strong premonition:

Should he violate the agreement, the repercussions would reverberate through his entire being, reaching even his main body.

Chapter 570


Up until now, Li Fan still hadn’t figured out the exact consequences of violating the contract with the Five Elders Association.

However, he had no intention of testing it out personally.

Every deal he had made with the Five Elders Association had brought him immense profit. Why would he ever willingly break the agreement? On the contrary, he wished for more opportunities like these.

The Five Elders Association’s spy was now reduced to nothing but bones. At the transaction site, only Li Fan remained.

Casually destroying the stone table with engraved characters, “Zhou Qingang” leaped and returned to Congyun City.

On the way back, Li Fan reflected on some oddities during the negotiation process.

Treasures like the 'Truth-Defying Fruit' and 'Human Dao Stardust', valuable even to cultivators in the Dao Integration realm, were offered sparingly by the Five Elders Association. This was understandable to Li Fan.

However, regarding the 'Samantabhadra True Boat', the Five Elders Association was overly stingy, refusing to provide more even when offered compensation with even more precious resources.

This puzzled Li Fan.

After all, the Samantabhadra True Boat was something his puppet body had casually encountered during its travels within the Five Elders Association. It was readily available not too long ago. How had it suddenly become so valuable?

What had changed?

Li Fan couldn’t make sense of it until “Zhou Qingang” returned to the Administration Hall and happened to glance at the map of the Congyun Sea and its surrounding regions on the wall. Suddenly, inspiration struck.

He stared intently at the natural boundaries marked on the map—the place labeled as the 'White Mist Barrier'—and seemed to have an epiphany.

“The so-called law of supply and demand,” he murmured.

“Although the Samantabhadra True Boat’s actual value isn’t high, if the Five Elders Association is now requisitioning them on a massive scale and experiencing severe shortages...”

“This would explain everything.”

Li Fan’s thoughts raced.

“The Five Elders Association is planning a campaign within the White Mist?”

“Are they using the White Mist Barrier to launch an attack into the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance, or are they venturing deeper into the White Mist itself?”

Even Li Fan himself was startled by this sudden hypothesis.

For countless years, cultivators had avoided the White Mist because of its life-draining properties.

Who would have thought of utilizing the White Mist Barriers as natural pathways?

Although the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance had long known that Samantabhadra True Leaf could somewhat mitigate the effects of the life-draining mist, this knowledge hadn’t been widely implemented.

This oversight was a major blind spot in the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance’s thinking.

What seemed like an impenetrable and safe White Mist Barrier could, in the next instant, erupt with countless enemy cultivators pouring forth.

This was an utterly terrifying prospect.

“I hope I’m just overthinking things. With the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance’s many brilliant minds, they must have already prepared for such a possibility…”

“Right?”

In the days that followed, “Zhou Qingang” deliberately kept himself busy.

Requests for meetings that he would have usually rejected outright were now all accepted.

Whenever he had free time, he patrolled the islands across the Congyun Sea.

In just three to four days, he had interacted with hundreds of individuals from various backgrounds and ranks.

This strategy made it nearly impossible for the Five Elders Association to trace his sources of intelligence or uncover traces of the so-called "Heaven-Suppressing Society".

Even if the Five Elders Association had the means to interrogate every person he met through soul-searching techniques, they wouldn’t find anything.

They would never guess that all of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance’s top secrets originated from Li Fan himself.

On the fifth day, Li Fan, carrying a fragmented formation diagram, ventured alone to the Ten Thousand Treasure Pavilion on Yulan Island.

In a hidden chamber deep within, he met the contact for this transaction.

The person was dressed in black, their face concealed, but Li Fan could tell they weren’t the same individual as the last contact.

“Excellent! Fellow Daoist Zhou is trustworthy, and we won’t disappoint you either,” the black-clad cultivator praised upon seeing Li Fan arrive as promised.

Li Fan asked about the previous Five Elders Association spy.

The black-clad cultivator replied solemnly, “To complete the mission, he chose self-sacrifice. It is our fate and our honor.”

It was clear that the person Li Fan had witnessed dissolving in golden light had truly perished. They had given their life to secure a contract bearing the marks of five Heavenly Sovereigns.

Curiously, there had been no celestial anomaly marking the spy’s death—a mystery Li Fan couldn’t unravel.

Nodding silently, Li Fan handed over a storage ring containing encrypted jade slips.

The black-clad cultivator accepted it with care and said, “Please wait here for a moment, Fellow Daoist Zhou.”

With that, he left the chamber with the ring, destination unknown.

Li Fan closed his eyes and waited patiently.

He wasn’t concerned about the safety of this puppet body.

First, the golden contract prohibited either side from harming the other.

Second, “Zhou Qingang” presented himself as a member of the massive covert organization 'Heaven-Suppressing Society', hidden deep within the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance.

Moreover, he was the only link between the Heaven-Suppressing Society and the Five Elders Association.

Unless the Five Elders Association was prepared to sever ties with the Heaven-Suppressing Society entirely, they wouldn’t dare harm him.

Especially when their war with the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance left no room for creating additional enemies.

Still, Li Fan remained vigilant, ready to abandon this puppet body if needed.

The Five Elders Association’s efficiency was remarkable.

In less than the time it took to brew a cup of tea, the black-clad cultivator returned to the chamber.

Although he tried to mask his emotions, the faint excitement in his demeanor was evident.

“Your methods are truly extraordinary. I am impressed!”

“This is what we promised. Please check it.”

The black-clad cultivator handed over a white stone.

“This is…” Li Fan’s eyes flashed.

Fortunately, after searching through the memories stored in the Dao Deviation Stone, he instantly knew what this white stone was.

It was the 'Primordial Void Stone Mother'—a rare, natural storage material.

Compared to ordinary storage rings, it offered significantly larger space. It could also be refined and stored within a cultivator’s body.

An essential material for crafting spatial artifacts, it was both priceless and scarcely available.

This item wasn’t on Li Fan’s list of requested goods. It was clearly provided as a dedicated storage vessel.

Li Fan nodded slightly, opened his mouth, and swallowed the stone directly.

He didn’t immediately refine it but first inspected its contents.

The Five Elders Association had fulfilled their side of the agreement without any shortages: 10,000 Enlightenment Pills, 300 Samantabhadra True Boat, three fragments of Human Dao Stardust—all matched the contract.

Li Fan’s attention focused on a five-colored glowing statue floating amidst the items.

Chapter 571


The statue's design was remarkably peculiar.

It had five faces and ten hands, yet shared a single body. Each face displayed a distinct expression:

- One lowered its eyes with compassion, seemingly sorrowful for the world's plight.

- Another bore a stern countenance, glaring with righteous anger.

- One face was slightly furrowed, appearing fragile and pitiful. Yet upon closer inspection, hints of alluring charm and coquettish seduction emerged.

This last face bore a striking resemblance to Senior Sister Zhao.

Li Fan's heart warmed, and a rush of emotions blossomed in his mind, his thoughts veering toward indulgent fantasies.

For a fleeting moment, he could even hear the gentle whispers of Senior Sister Zhao in his ears.

“Something's wrong!”

Alarmed, Li Fan snapped back to reality, breaking free from the illusion, and cold sweat drenched his back.Looking again, the vivid expressions vanished. What remained were five indistinct and featureless faces on the ten-handed statue.

The black-robed cultivator, upon seeing the multicolored statue in Li Fan's hands, lit up with fervent enthusiasm and explained:

“This is an Manifestation of Heavenly Sovereign Statue, and it is one of the highest-grade types.”

“Mundane matters are typically beneath the attention of the Heavenly Sovereigns and are managed by the Five Elders Pavilion.”
