Chapter 612


The 'Valley of Longevity' was a secret realm accidentally discovered by the Medicine King Sect in ancient times.

Named after its abundant production of the ingredients required to refine the [Longevity Pill], the name speaks for itself: the Longevity Pill is a type of elixir capable of extending the lifespan of cultivators.

This pill was a closely guarded secret of the Medicine King Sect and the key to its immense wealth and power. Depending on the quality of the pill, the lifespan it could extend varied. The highest-quality Longevity Pill even surpassed the [Heavenly Transformation Feather Pill], capable of granting an additional thousand years of life.

To refine the Longevity Pill, one needed not only extremely high-quality medicinal materials but also the Medicine King Cauldron as the core, supplemented by 81 smaller Medicine King Cauldrons, forming the [Great World-Saving Longevity Formation]. During the process, the elixir had to be constantly infused with ‘Longevity Green Energy’.

This process took 49 days to complete one batch of refined pills. Though complex, the results were well worth the effort.

Compared to other longevity-extending treasures, the Longevity Pill had a significant advantage: it could be consumed repeatedly.

Although each subsequent pill's effect diminished significantly until it eventually became ineffective, it was still far superior to other treasures that lost their effectiveness entirely after a single use.

The Sea of Void was vast and boundless, requiring immense courage to traverse. The Longevity Pill and the [Great Dream Spring and Autumn Formation], which allowed an entire sect to enter a state of suspended animation, were the two great lifelines of the Medicine King Sect.

“This Longevity Pill is truly a treasure. Unfortunately, before the Medicine King Sect departed, most of the pills were sold off in exchange for reserved resources,” Li Fan lamented.

“The remaining ones are now in the hands of those elders,” he noted after examining the inventory of resources stored in the Medicine King Cauldron, feeling a hint of regret.

However, he consoled himself with the realization that most of the Medicine King Sect’s cultivators were now under his control. There would be plenty of opportunities to have them refine more pills for him.

Feeling somewhat at ease, Li Fan remarked, “Let’s check on the current state of the Valley of Longevity. If it remains undiscovered, that would be ideal. After thousands of years, it’s hard to imagine what kind of herbs might have grown there.”

“But if it has already been found and developed by the Ten Thousand Immortals Alliance...”

“Well, that’s fine too.”

After reviewing the materials needed to refine the Longevity Pill, Li Fan realized they were still available for purchase in the Tianxuan Mirror, though they were rather expensive. However, refining the pills and selling them again would undoubtedly yield a profit.

Moreover, he currently wasn’t short on contribution points.

“Jiarong Territory in Southern Fuzhou…”

“What kind of place is this?”

When Li Fan tried to locate the Valley of Longevity based on the coordinates from Linghu Chang’s memories, he encountered difficulties.

That location no longer existed within the territory of the Ten Thousand Immortals Alliance.

“Could it be within the region of the Five Elders Association?” Li Fan felt a twinge of unease.

“Or maybe not. After so many years, and with the severance of traditions, it might have simply been renamed,” he thought.

With narrowed eyes, Li Fan began comparing the surrounding terrain of the Valley of Longevity to the current geography within the Ten Thousand Immortals Alliance’s borders, hoping to pinpoint its exact location.

After a painstaking search, he was ultimately forced to give up.

“Although I know that the geography of the Xuanhuang World changes over time, I didn’t expect it to reach such an absurd extent,” Li Fan muttered, taking a deep breath.

According to Linghu Chang’s memories, the Valley of Longevity was near a Wormtail Mountain Range

, but now, there were several Wormtail Mountains within the Ten Thousand Immortals Alliance’s territory.

Compared to thousands of years ago, the Wormtail Mountain Range seemed as though it had been cut into dozens of segments, then scattered chaotically across various locations.

This was only true for the parts that still retained their original names. As for those that had lost their names, they were even harder to locate.

Finding the exact location of the Longevity Valley solely by personal effort would be akin to searching for a needle in a haystack.

If one tried to search location by location, it would indeed be possible to eventually find it, but...

It wasn’t necessary.

Li Fan’s time was extremely valuable.

After pondering for a long while, he decided to leave it to the professionals.

Storing Medicine King True Cauldron in his personal cave heaven domain, Li Fan silently returned to the Congyun Sea.

He then used the Tianxuan Mirror to conduct research and eventually contacted a cultivator named Ximen Yu, who specialized in studying ancient and modern geographical changes.

Ximen Yu’s work, An Examination of Ancient and Modern Mountains and Rivers, was widely circulated.

By using ancient sect ruins as reference points and recalculating directional changes, the book offered results that had been verified by many cultivators with minimal error.

Of course, the Xuanhuang Realm was vast, and the examples in the book merely demonstrated Ximen Yu’s capability in such calculations.

If someone wanted to determine the exact location of places mentioned in ancient texts, they just needed to pay a contribution fee, and the problem would be resolved immediately!

Ximen Yu’s intent was clear: he aimed to earn contribution points with his unique skill.

Li Fan admired such practicality and efficiency.

Thus, unlike his previous life where he was a chubby figure, this time Ye Feipeng was rather slender.

Referring to him as a refined gentleman would be perfectly accurate.

Chapter 613


Li Fan suspended a jar of blood in midair and crushed it with a flick of his fingers.

The fierce aura of Kunpeng essence blood gushed out, writhing as if alive, inching outward with an unsettling vitality.

With a wave of his hand, Li Fan encapsulated the blood within the boundaries of his cave heaven domain and began to analyze and comprehend its properties carefully.

The purpose of this study was clear: to replicate the three divine abilities that Ye Feipeng had demonstrated in his previous life—Kun Devour, Peng Flight, and Bloodline Transmission.

Among these, Kun Devour had become almost irrelevant to Li Fan since he acquired the Five Elements Cave Heaven. Peng Flight, however, offered a form of escape technique worth adapting.

The most critical ability, and the one Li Fan urgently sought to master, was undoubtedly Bloodline Transmission.

This ancient beast-originated technique allowed the wielder to imbue their own essence blood into others, subtly influencing and eventually altering their thoughts.

Over time, this transformation would turn the recipient into a loyal subordinate who would unwaveringly serve the master of the essence blood.

In his previous life, Ye Feipeng, who initially loathed his demonic beast bloodline, had eventually grown proud of his Kunpeng heritage. His disdainful term “demonic beast” had gradually morphed into the reverent “sacred beast.”

Such a technique was ideal for controlling the disciples of the Medicine King Sect and others.For now, Li Fan had managed to temporarily subdue individuals like He Zhenghao and Gao Yuan through coercion and persuasion. But managing a large number of people this way posed significant risks.

The disciples of the Medicine King Sect, who were familiar with each other, would be even harder to control without direct measures. Li Fan needed them primarily for refining pills and occasionally as combatants. Watching them constantly wasn’t feasible.

Without a method to enforce his control, he couldn’t fully trust them.

Thus, mastering ‘Bloodline Transmission’ became a necessity.

Under his meticulous observation, every particle of Kunpeng essence blood seemed to possess its own consciousness, emitting sharp, unsettling cries that made Li Fan frown.

Extracting a single droplet, he absorbed it into his body through his fingertip, closely monitoring how it transformed his physical being.

As soon as the Kunpeng essence blood made contact with his flesh, the sharp sounds abruptly ceased.

The blood became eerily silent as tiny tendrils extended deep into his tissues, anchoring themselves like parasites.

Scarlet flashes of light pulsed along the tendrils, siphoning energy from his flesh into the essence blood.

Moments later, the essence blood began to bubble as though boiling, undergoing a self-evolution.

In no time, it mimicked Li Fan’s own flesh so precisely that even he, the host, could barely discern the difference without close scrutiny.

Despite completing its transformation, the Kunpeng blood didn’t release its grip. Instead, it transmitted streams of dark red energy back into the attached flesh, initiating an enigmatic transformation.

To Li Fan’s astonishment, the altered tissues sprouted their own tendrils, attacking adjacent unaltered flesh like predators.

“So, this is homomorphic evolution…”

After recovering, he absorbed another batch of Kunpeng essence blood and consumed a comprehension pill to delve deeper into the Bloodline Transmission process.

Time after time, he purged the corrupted flesh, then resumed his analysis, repeating the cycle.

Li Fan, however, remained unfazed, focusing intently on manipulating his drop of essence blood.

At first, the infiltration process went smoothly.

The essence blood expanded its influence, quickly occupying most of the space within the cultivator's body.

The cultivator’s body began rejecting the parts controlled by Li Fan's blood, causing violent convulsions and uncontrollable spasms. They coughed up mouthfuls of fresh blood before succumbing to death in a short time.

This experiment was notably longer than the previous ones.

Li Fan also exhausted a great deal of mental energy.

The "lucky subject" remained entirely unaware of the changes happening within their body, sleeping soundly and peacefully.

Yet Li Fan could sense a subtle, wondrous connection between himself and the subject.

It wasn’t as controllable as a clone, which could act as an extension of one’s limbs.

Instead, he could clearly perceive the state of the subject’s body and even vaguely sense fleeting thoughts crossing their mind.

Sure enough, a new divine ability called "Bloodline Transmission" had appeared on the list.

Thousands of years ago, the Dharma-Transmitting Immortal Ancestor appeared out of nowhere, teaching the masses a new method to seize the heavens and plunder the earth.

"I don’t think I’ll be able to complete this task. I’ll refund the extra contribution points," he sighed.

Upon hearing this, Li Fan's gaze flickered slightly.

"Completely vanished? Fellow Daoist Ximen, do you know the reason?" Li Fan asked.

"There could be many reasons. First, a great upheaval in heaven and earth—rivers shift, seas turn into mulberry fields, and such places naturally disappear.

"Second, it could be the existence of the White Mist Barrier. The locations of these places in ancient times might coincide with where the White Mist Barrier is now, making them inaccessible."

"The third possibility…"

Ximen Yu stopped speaking here, falling silent.

"What’s wrong? Does Fellow Daoist have something difficult to explain?" Li Fan asked, puzzled.

"Not exactly, but my conjecture is rather bold and without evidence, so I didn’t want to speak and make a fool of myself," Ximen Yu hesitated.

Now Li Fan was even more intrigued. "No problem. Your vast knowledge is rare in this world. Sharing it would broaden my horizons."

Perhaps it had been a long time since someone acknowledged Ximen Yu so earnestly. Hearing Li Fan’s words, he became excited.

He immediately explained, "You may not believe it, but based on my years of comparing ancient and modern terrains, I’ve discovered that a significant portion of the ancient regions of the Xuanhuang Realm is missing."

"It’s as if someone forcibly took away part of the land."

"However…"

Ximen Yu’s tone became puzzled again.

"Some places, on the other hand, seem to have appeared out of nowhere, as if conjured from the void. These regions didn’t seem to exist in the ancient cultivation world."

"So, overall, compared to ancient times, the Xuanhuang Realm hasn’t shrunk. Instead, it has expanded."

"Truly bizarre, an enigma that defies explanation."

…

Hearing this, Li Fan narrowed his eyes.

"Are Fellow Daoist’s conclusions reliable?"

"Absolutely reliable! The Fallen Immortal Realm contains a panoramic view of the ancient Xuanhuang Realm. However, ordinary cultivators can only glimpse a small portion during each entry. By visiting many cultivators and piecing together fragments, I’ve essentially restored the ancient cultivation world’s landscape. This conclusion is irrefutable!" Ximen Yu declared firmly.

But they didn’t specify which parts were problematic.

Leyang Prefecture was located in the eastern central region of the Ten Thousand Immortals Alliance, several prefectures away from the Congyun Sea. However, with teleportation formation, the journey wouldn’t take long.

Fortunately, its essence was no different, and its potential was limitless.

"Planting spiritual herbs will also aid in refining the laws within the wood-attribute domain. But… specialization is key…"

Li Fan suddenly thought of Chen Ying, the Nascent Soul cultivator from the Medicinal Hall of Congyun Sea.

Since being conscripted into the Five Elements Cave Heaven, Chen Ying had vanished without a trace.

However, unlike in his past life, thanks to Li Fan’s warning, Chen Ying had not fallen yet.

He just couldn’t be contacted.

"He should still be in the Five Elements Cave Heaven, though I have no idea what he’s been up to." Li Fan recalled that in his previous life, just a few years later, in Year 38, the Five Elements Cave Heaven collapsed into oblivion due to the extraction of vast resources, leading to an imbalance in its elements.

"I wonder if the Ten Thousand Immortals Alliance will repeat the same mistake in this lifetime." Li Fan was still unsure why the Alliance was so aggressively exploiting the resources of the Five Elements Cave Heaven. Yet, judging by Chen Ying’s continued absence, it seemed their operations there hadn’t ceased.

After pondering for a moment, Li Fan shook his head and dismissed the thought.

Just as he was about to return to Shenhua Island, a notification from the Tianxuan Mirror arrived.

The former island lord of Ten Thousand Immortals Island, Immortal Lord Hongxi—a Soul Transformation cultivator who had been conscripted into the Alliance’s headquarters for years—

Had finally returned.

He ordered Li Fan, the "Secret Envoy," to report to him immediately.

Chapter 622

However, what Li Fan never anticipated was that when Immortal Lord Hong Xi actually met him, there was no tension or hostility. Instead, Hong Xi burst into hearty laughter and gave him a big hug.

Who would have thought that you'd emerge out of nowhere? Over the past few years, not only did various evaluation metrics not decline, but they even rose by several ranks!"

They were also awarded “performance” rewards based on their province’s overall ranking within the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance.

This was settled annually, and in addition to contribution points, a large amount of merit was distributed.

Chapter 624


“This is just a ceasefire in plain sight, switching to another form of competition.” Li Fan was quite familiar with this kind of situation.

To make it easier for all cultivators to witness the grand event, the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance specially crafted a magical mirror tool.

It was affordably priced—just 100 contribution points to purchase. Cultivators could use it to watch the scenes of the event anytime and anywhere. They could even replay the battles between both sides repeatedly. Most importantly, the mirror displayed real-time commentary synchronized with the Tianxuan Mirror, ensuring lower-level cultivators wouldn’t feel lost amidst the advanced techniques.

The “Tianling Viewing Mirror” became an instant hit among cultivators upon its release.

Apart from its low price and the rarity of missing such a grand occasion, some cultivators also bought it for collection purposes. According to veteran cultivators, during the first friendly exchange event, the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance had also released a similar viewing mirror.

At that time, it didn’t attract much attention because the event details could be casually searched in the Tianxuan Mirror. Only the more affluent cultivators purchased it.

What no one anticipated was that after the competition ended, the viewing mirrors became limited-edition treasures. Their inherent value wasn’t the main attraction; it was the battle scenes they recorded.

During the first exchange event, the representatives from both sides later rose to become prominent figures in their respective organizations. Almost all of them achieved the Dao Integration realm. For lower-level cultivators, repeatedly analyzing the discussions and battles of these elites proved extremely beneficial. Some even presented these mirrors, which recorded the victories of key elites, as gifts to the individuals themselves, winning their favor.

Over time, with the deaths of many cultivators, the remaining viewing mirrors became increasingly scarce. Today, they were so rare they could hardly be found.

With such precedent, it was no surprise that this round of “Tianling Viewing Mirrors” sold out rapidly.

For just 100 contribution points, Li Fan naturally bought one.

Upon receiving it, Li Fan found the workmanship of the mirror rather crude.

It was incomparable to the Tianxuan Mirror and even far inferior to ordinary copper mirrors used by mortals. It was essentially a piece of polished stone.

“Could this have been outsourced production again?”

“Selling for 100 contribution points—who knows how much the cost was? Although the unit price is low, considering how many cultivators are in the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance…”

“I wonder who’s profiting from this.”

The killing intent of heaven and earth was subtly infused into all things, almost imperceptible.

"The killing intent in this life is so overwhelming. It seems even stronger than in the previous ones."

"Tianyang’s life..."

"I’d like to see whether the Ink Death truly has the power to erase everything!"

Chapter 623: Calendar of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance


In the Tianxuan Mirror, beams of light and shadows appeared one after another.

Since the anchoring of the year 11 and the official foundation of the Congyun Immortal City under Li Fan's supervision, up until the end of year 14,

the settlement data for a total of four years instantly appeared before Li Fan.

"New Immortal Calendar, Year 2021: Comprehensive Ranking: 231st, rewarded with three Intermediate Grade B Merits and 11,000 Contribution Points."

"New Immortal Calendar, Year 2022: Comprehensive Ranking: 226th, rewarded with three Intermediate Grade B Merits and 15,000 Contribution Points. Additionally, due to active participation in the Congyun Sea Region's response to the Immortal Alliance’s recruitment policy during the Tianling Prefecture War, an extra reward of one Superior Grade B Merit."

...

With the completion of thirteen meritorious missions, Li Fan's merit level soared, eventually stopping at Level 22.

In his previous life, Li Fan had only managed to reach Merit Level 31 at the end of his lifespan by relying on unparalleled contributions, such as constructing the Tianxuan Spirit Locking Formation.

But now, by essentially being a hands-off overseer, he had effortlessly risen to Level 22.

Of course, this achievement was partly due to the Superior Grade A Merit reward from the foundation of Congyun City.

As his merit level increased, many cultivation techniques and treasures previously hidden in the Tianxuan Mirror were unlocked. However, having reached higher levels in his past life, Li Fan only needed a glance to notice that the list had only a few additional items. These were mainly treasures redeemable by regional administrators.

For example, the Mirror of All Living Beings, which monitors the overall number and cultivation levels of cultivators within a state; and the Bell of Myriad States, which displays the annual development status of other regions and predicts the local state's ranking in the annual comprehensive evaluation.

In summary, these tools were primarily designed to facilitate competition between regions and were of little practical use to Li Fan.

What truly caught Li Fan’s attention, however, was the date displayed in the settlement notification.

“New Immortal Calendar…”

As the name implies, the New Immortal Calendar was a system implemented starting from the year when the Immortal Ancestor rebuilt the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance.

Previously, all time references in various ancient texts that Li Fan consulted were deliberately vague, using terms like ancient, distant ancient, primordial, or broad time spans such as thousands or hundreds of years ago.

This was the first time Li Fan had encountered a precise record down to a specific year.

As for Sima Changkong's Bloodline History, it also followed a "Year One" system, using his own lineage’s beginning as its baseline. It didn’t apply universally to the overall immortal cultivation world.

"It seems the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance must have a detailed recording system internally. It’s just kept secret from the public."

Li Fan wasn’t surprised by this realization. Given that the Museum of Divine Relics housed various precious artifacts from the history of the Xuanhuang Realm, it was only natural that it would also preserve records of the true history.

“Ancient matters are clearly not suitable for public dissemination. Keeping people ignorant ensures stability.” Li Fan smirked coldly.

“If I recall correctly, reaching Merit Level 30 grants a free tour of the Museum of Divine Relics.”

Images of the museum’s central hall flashed in his mind, and Li Fan seemed to sense the hunger of [Truth].

But he forcibly suppressed his restlessness. The Museum of Divine Relics was heavily guarded, with the Longevity Beast Emperor Sanmo overseeing it. Acting recklessly would be akin to walking into a trap.

At least for now, it was beyond Li Fan’s capabilities to covet. He could only gradually strengthen himself through the cycles of reincarnation, uncover more secrets, and find the right breakthrough point. Only then would he have even the faintest hope of success.

After closing the merit record, Li Fan sent a message to the Immortal Lord Hong Xi, informing him that he had claimed all the merits accumulated over the past few years and expressing his gratitude for the guidance.

Immortal Lord Hong Xi laughed heartily and said little else, merely encouraging Li Fan to continue his efforts. He also assured Li Fan not to worry about the minds of others; he would handle them personally.

As expected, three days later, the returning Immortal Lord Hong Xi convened a meeting with all the internal cultivators of Congyun Sea.

Just as everyone assumed that the once-prominent Li Fan would lose power and be cast down to obscurity, Immortal Lord Hong Xi announced publicly that Li Fan would continue managing state affairs on his behalf.

This announcement brought immense joy to He Zhenghao and others, who had been restless with anxiety.

The rest of the cultivators, however, were left in shock and disbelief.

As they stole glances at Li Fan’s calm and composed face, their hearts were filled with both awe and fear, speculating endlessly about his background.

What kind of hidden power could Li Fan possess to force Immortal Lord Hong Xi, who had ruled Congyun Sea for centuries, to relinquish authority?

Ignoring the shifting expressions around him, Li Fan bowed respectfully to Immortal Lord Hong Xi and expressed his gratitude once again.

Immortal Lord Hong Xi waved his hand and stepped away, disappearing from the scene.

Li Fan, however, knew that Immortal Lord Hong Xi had grown tired of dealing with the mundane matters of Congyun Sea and was eager to leave everything behind.

But others were unaware of this.

In their eyes, Immortal Lord Hong Xi’s retreating figure seemed despondent.

The truth was clear to them now—Immortal Lord Hong Xi had indeed lost to Li Fan in the power struggle!

The cultivators’ hearts were stirred with tumultuous waves of realization. They lowered their heads, not daring to look directly at the triumphant envoy before them.

Seeing their reactions, Li Fan understood their thoughts but chose not to explain. Instead, he imitated Hong Xi’s demeanor.

“The governance of the Immortal Alliance must prioritize stability. Everything in Congyun Sea will remain as it is. Zhou Qingang, He Zhenghao, and Gao Yuan will assist me in managing all affairs.”

Zhou Qingang, He Zhenghao, and the others were overjoyed and quickly agreed.

“Now, disperse!” Li Fan waved his hand and disappeared as well.

After Li Fan’s departure, the Bureau of Administration Hall erupted into a commotion.

“Congratulations, Fellow Daoist Zhou!”

“Lord He, this is truly worth celebrating!”

…

Hearing their words as he walked away, Li Fan shook his head slightly.

He was about to return to Shenhua Island when he suddenly received another message.

“The Second Alliance of Ten Thousand Immortals and the Five Elders Association’s Friendly Exchange Meeting will take place in Tianling Prefecture in ten days.”

“At this former battlefield, both sides will set aside their grudges and forge new friendships.”

Li Fan’s first thought was of the scene of devastation he had previously witnessed in Tianling Prefecture.

“Hosting a friendly exchange event in such a place? Is that really appropriate?” Li Fan muttered to himself.

“Could it be that, under the guise of friendly exchange, tensions will remain high?”

Li Fan carefully searched for related information and indeed found some suspicious details.

In addition to the mutual exhibition of both parties’ "World-Defying Supreme Treasures," the exchange event would also include competitions in martial arts, philosophical debates, and formation testing.

Representatives from both sides would be the top young talents from their respective organizations.

The entire process of the competitions would be broadcast live.

Chapter 625


Beneath the Congyun Sea, where several vital ley lines converge, the energy of the earth veins surged turbulently, appearing far more agitated than before.

Using this powerful energy, Li Fan set up the [Earth-Fire Convergence Formation], placing the dormant Tianyang at its center.

He then gradually added materials such as Eternal Tribulation Gold, Radiant Heaven Crystal, and Purple Spirit Essence into the formation.

The formation resembled a massive furnace. Under the blazing heat of the Earthfire energy, these materials began to merge with Tianyang’s puppet body.

During Tianyang’s countless years of slumber, it was precisely this formation that allowed him to break through his own limits, ascending from a mere Foundation Establishment cultivator to become a Soul Transformation Immortal Monarch.

However, due to the mediocre heritage of the minor sect he had inherited, even with all its resources, Tianyang’s financial means were limited. Over millennia, reaching the Soul Transformation realm was already his peak achievement.

The puppet body, constrained by the innate limitations of its materials, lacked significant strength. While it could contend with those in the same realm, crossing realms to defeat enemies, as true prodigies did, was nearly impossible.

Now, with Li Fan’s assistance, all of this was about to change.

With so many rare treasures poured into its creation, even if it were purely a puppet, it could rival an ordinary Dao Integration cultivator.

Coupled with Tianyang’s indomitable spirit and will, he might even survive against the ultimate manifestation of the soul of heaven and earth—Ink Death.Li Fan’s eyes reflected the fierce glow of the [Earth-Fire Convergence Formation]. After observing for several days, he noticed the process was slower than expected.

“Junior Brother, let Senior Brother give you a little extra boost.”

With that, Li Fan tossed a massive pile of top-quality spirit stones, brimming with pure spiritual energy, into the formation.

Like dry wood meeting a roaring fire, or a strong wind fanning the flames, the effect was immediate. The efficiency of the Earth-Fire Convergence Formation doubled.

Li Fan continued to stare at Tianyang within the formation, his gaze deep and contemplative.

...

Ten days passed in the blink of an eye.

The Tianling Prefecture’s friendly exchange event was about to begin.

To prevent any unforeseen incidents, the entire Tianling Prefecture was locked down. Even all teleportation formation were deactivated, barring unrelated individuals from entering and causing disturbances.

Thus, the opening ceremony and the unveiling of the World-Defying Supreme Treasures were closed to ordinary cultivators.

These so-called "World-Defying Supreme Treasures" referred to peerless magical artifacts possessed by the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance and the Five Elders Association, capable of drastically altering the course of their wars. ȒâNóᛒËṣ

However, due to strict confidentiality, no details about these treasures were disclosed, leaving everyone itching with curiosity.

On the second day after the opening, the highly anticipated competition phase officially began.

Dao, Martial Arts, Tools, Formation, Pills, Talismans—

Each day featured a single category, with the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance and the Five Elders Association each sending three prodigies to compete.

The first event, and the most eye-catching, was the Martial Arts Duel.

At that moment, countless cultivators of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance watched their first representative step onto the stage through the Tianxuan Viewing Mirrors.

The participant appeared to be a teenager, around ten years old, with a genderless beauty. Dressed in white with a red ribbon tied around their head, they looked strikingly handsome.

The name "Di Luwu" appeared alongside them in the Viewing Mirror.

A buzz of astonishment swept through the crowd.

On the Five Elders Association’s side, their representatives looked grim.

“What’s the meaning of this? Sending a mere child to such an important event?”

“Are they mocking us, as if the Five Elders Association lacks capable individuals?”

...

All the cultivators present had extraordinary cultivation levels, and they could naturally see that the boy named Di Luwu had not maintained a childlike appearance after reaching adulthood. Instead, he genuinely appeared to be less than ten years old.

No matter how much of a genius one might be, how strong could someone become in such a short lifespan?

The expressions of the cultivators from the Five Elders Association were extremely grim. At that moment, a young swordsman in green robes stepped forward, his face filled with indignation and a hint of murderous intent.

"Guzhi, do not underestimate him!"

A middle-aged woman from the Five Elders Association, who appeared no different from a simple village farmer, suddenly shouted.

Her identity seemed particularly special. The green-robed youth, named Xu Guzhi, nodded solemnly in acknowledgment before gracefully stepping forward to face Di Luwu.

"Please enlighten me!" Xu Guzhi narrowed his eyes, his sword pointing directly at Di Luwu.

The battle was on the verge of breaking out, and the cultivators of the Ten Thousand Immortals Alliance noticed the information about the two contestants.

Both were at the peak of the Soul Transformation stage. Di Luwu was nine years old, while Xu Guzhi was fifty-six.

The cultivators across the world who witnessed this scene were utterly shocked.

"A nine-year-old at the Soul Transformation peak? Am I seeing this right?"

"Even if you started cultivating in the womb, it shouldn’t be possible to progress this quickly!"

"Is this real? Is Di Luwu the fastest cultivator in history? How did he achieve this?"

"Look at me, I’m already 378 years old and still stuck in the Nascent Soul stage. The gap between people truly makes one despair."

"Heh, you’re at least at the Nascent Soul stage. Should I, a mere Foundation Establishment cultivator, even say anything?"

...

Before the duel even began, it had already ignited worldwide debate. Cultivators speculated wildly about Di Luwu's background.

Even Li Fan’s eyes flickered with amazement and surprise.

After all, a nine-year-old at the Soul Transformation peak was simply beyond reason.

"Could it be the reincarnation technique like Senior Brother Zhang’s method? Or perhaps the body-possession rebirth technique of the Xuantian Sect’s Dharma King?"

"Or maybe..."

Li Fan stared intently at the perpetually cold expression on Di Luwu’s face, feeling a strange sense of familiarity.

"A Heavenly Warlock?"

"Is this Di Luwu from the [Era]?"

While Li Fan was lost in thought, Xu Guzhi moved.

With a swift swing of his sword, a massive sword shadow materialized and descended from the sky.

"A thousand swords unbroken, stretching like mountains."

The viewing mirror immediately displayed a synchronized explanation.

Countless gigantic sword shadows overlapped and pressed down on Di Luwu from all directions with the weight of a mountain, creating an unparalleled sense of oppression without any earth-shaking noise—just a silent and seamless execution.

In the midst of the surrounding swords, Di Luwu seemed frozen with fear, unmoving and at a loss.

The hearts of the cultivators from the Ten Thousand Immortals Alliance tightened instantly.

Just as the countless massive swords were about to strike, Di Luwu made his move.

A silver dragon, like a sudden thunderbolt, lit up the heavens and earth.

It swiftly pierced through the encircling swords.

Before anyone could react, it had already penetrated Xu Guzhi's chest.

Chapter 626


The attack by Di Luwu was unbelievably swift.

“What incredible speed! Such sharp spear techniques!”

He took a deep breath, and his injuries healed completely.

Xu Guzhi slightly opened his mouth and swallowed the straight sword in his hand.

With the sword consumed, his body disappeared from sight.

Amid the stunned gazes of the audience, Xu Guzhi vanished entirely!

It was only through the explanation appearing in the viewing mirror that the onlookers understood what had occurred:

“The sword returns to the sheath; its strike conceals itself in the void.”

Standing motionless in midair, he extended his right hand, curling his fingers in a provocative gesture.

Almost instantly, an invisible sword light emerged above Di Luwu’s head.

Silent and undetectable, it aimed to sever his head.

But as the strike descended, a burst of silver light erupted, intercepting the Hidden Returning Sword and neutralizing the killing blow.

Another wave of invisible sword energy silently approached, impossible to detect.

“Though the sword is formless, its intent lacks awareness.”

A violent surge of silver radiance erupted from his body, sweeping outward with the intent to annihilate everything in its path.

After a brief moment of blindness, the mirror gradually returned to normal.

Xu Guzhi remained concealed somewhere within the field!

Silver lightning serpents swept through the surrounding space, creating black void fissures.

Yet, Xu Guzhi could not be located.

From the spectator seats of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance, boos and jeers erupted:

"Don't call him Xu Guzhi anymore—rename him Xu Wugui!" [1]

Initially, everyone expected another intense battle, but the outcome was decided in an instant.

The one who delivered the punch? A seemingly ordinary peasant-looking woman from the Five Elders Association.

A message of "peace."

Moreover, this display seemed to set the tone for a period of "peace" in the near future, providing cultivators with a sense of relief and stability.

Thus, even after the friendly exchange meeting ended, discussions about it persisted among the cultivators.

"In my opinion, the so-called prodigies who participated in this event weren’t all that extraordinary. They were strong, no doubt, but not beyond imagination. I’m currently at the Nascent Soul stage. Once I break through, I might be able to challenge them!" Ř𝒶𐌽ȪＢÊ𝙨

"I’ve had similar thoughts. So it’s not just my imagination?"

"We should devote ourselves to cultivation. Who knows? The next time there’s a chance for such a grand performance, we might be the ones stepping into the spotlight and making a name for ourselves across the land."

In Li Fan's perception, the area ahead had become akin to an independent world.

"I fear my Binding Insect Divine Ability would be greatly weakened in that space," a thought quickly flashed through Li Fan's mind.

Chapter 628


The Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance's representative "Wu" displayed extraordinary skill, his moves creating an immense commotion.

Chapter 629


"Would you like to spend 10,000 contribution points to conduct a deduction of a divine ability? The first attempt has a 1% success rate. Each subsequent attempt increases the success rate until it reaches 100%."

Li Fan stared at the prompt displayed by the Tianxuan Mirror, his expression unchanging, and selected "Confirm."

Within the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance system, cultivators gradually unlock specific privileges as their merit levels increase.

These privileges manifest in various aspects of cultivation life, such as reduced contribution costs for using teleportation formations, or an increased number of items that can be sold to the Tianxuan Mirror at market-standard prices.

However, some significant privileges are only available upon reaching specific levels:

1. Level 5 Privilege: Once per year, one can request a free long-distance teleportation.

2. Level 10 Privilege: While searching the Tianxuan Mirror for information, one can preview materials and item details that are typically restricted to those a realm higher.

3. Level 15 Privilege: Every ten years, one can randomly contact a cultivator who is one major realm higher through the Tianxuan Mirror. This contact does not impose any obligations or responsibilities on either party, leaving the relationship to personal ability.

4. Level 20 Privilege: The ability to use contribution points for divine ability or combat technique deductions during the Sitting and Discussing Dao.

However, this deduction process has a reputation for being particularly harsh. Not only does it consume a massive amount of contribution points, but success is far from guaranteed.

Many cultivators in the system ridicule it as a "contribution-recovery trap."

When Li Fan confirmed his choice, the miniature figure representing him in the mirror began to move.

Its expression was stern, eyes fixed on the void ahead. The left hand executed a palm strike, while the right hand wielded a sword.

"If you proceed, the success rate will increase to 2%. If you abandon the process, all deduction data will be reset, requiring you to start over next time."

"You may also choose to supplement the divine ability's data details to further increase the success rate."

Chapter 635


At this moment, He Zhenghao had already cast aside his daughter's warning.

In his mind, even if the process of refining the Spirit of Heaven and Earth was extremely dangerous, he was not a reckless person. He would act according to the situation—if it truly became impossible, he would not throw his life away in vain. Taking some risks to gamble on an opportunity to ascend in one leap—why not?

However, He Zhenghao could never have imagined that the true Spirit of Heaven and Earth was on an entirely different level from what he had envisioned.

Ultimately, it was a matter of his limited perspective. Despite his broad travels and wide social connections, He Zhenghao was only at the Golden Core stage. He had never personally seen, nor even found records in ancient texts, detailing the true power of the Spirit of Heaven and Earth.

He merely knew of its existence.

It was like a farmer imagining the emperor's golden plow—far from reality. This, too, seemed to seal He Zhenghao’s tragic fate in this lifetime.

...

Meanwhile, while the gathered cultivators were still in the Administrative Hall discussing Li Fan’s prophecy regarding the underwater ascension of a hidden cave,

Li Fan himself had quietly arrived at the cave’s location.

Over a mere few hundred miles, the seabed formed three major fault steps, resembling steep terraces. Each step had a height difference of four to five thousand meters. Due to intense earth vein activity, towering mountain ranges had risen from the seabed, creating a spectacular and breathtaking scene—more magnificent than even the mountains on land.This was the very place where, in his previous life, He Zhenghao had formed his Golden Core: the Three Undersea Faults.

"In my past life, He Zhenghao, though somewhat unremarkable, never lost his drive for progress. The day he obtained the Hidden Dragon Art of Rivers and Mountains, he soared like a dragon from the abyss and rose powerfully. By comprehending the Golden Core through four laws, his future was boundless."

"But in this life, despite wielding far greater power and practicing a Dao Integration cultivation technique, he has been lax in his cultivation, forming his Golden Core with only a single law."

"I gave you the opportunity, but you failed to make use of it."

Li Fan felt a slight sense of regret in his heart.

Shaking his head slightly, he focused on the matter at hand.

Sweeping his divine sense across the mountainous faults below, his eyes narrowed slightly.

"Chaoyuan Sect..."

What he had said earlier in the Administrative Hall was no empty talk. Though the Chaoyuan Sect was shrouded in mystery and filled with dangers, in his previous life, after Shuofeng, Su Xiaomei, and the others entered, they all returned safely—and each had ascended an entire cultivation realm.

Setting aside the unexpected variable of He Zhenghao’s Foundation Establishment in the previous life, this ancient ruin was originally supposed to leave the Congyun Sea in the year 22 of anchoring and travel toward Jiushan State Prefecture.

Thus, at this moment, it remained silently hidden beneath the faults.

Having fully inherited the memories of Dugu Chang of the Medicine King Sect, Li Fan searched for traces of the Chaoyuan Sect within those memories but found nothing.

Not only that, but even the Cloud-Water Heavenly Palace, which claimed dominance over Congyun Sea, was similarly absent.

Neither sect could be found.

"Strange... Whether it is the Cloud-Water Heavenly Palace or the Chaoyuan Sect, the records in the Tianxuan Mirror indicate that they were renowned sects of ancient times. Although they couldn't compare to the Ten Great Immortal Sects, they were definitely stronger than the Medicine King Sect."

"So why do none of the Medicine King Sect's disciples have any knowledge of them?"

"Could it be that they existed in entirely different time periods? Did the Cloud-Water Heavenly Palace emerge more recently?"

Li Fan pondered for a moment but could not find an answer. Instead, the many clues seemed contradictory, revealing numerous inconsistencies.

Temporarily setting aside his doubts, he turned his gaze toward the seabed below and activated the newly mastered divine ability—Heaven-Shattering Heart Sword.

In the next instant, countless sword lights appeared amid the continuous undersea mountain ranges.

Illuminating the dark seabed, they sent thunderous roars echoing in all directions.

As the mountains crumbled, massive fissures split open across the ocean floor.

As if torn apart by countless sword lights in an instant, the vast underwater wonderland, stretching for hundreds of miles, completely collapsed and disappeared the moment Li Fan willed it.

Amid this catastrophe, Li Fan finally discovered traces of the hidden Chaoyuan Sect.

There was no obstruction—he simply watched as the ruins of ancient structures rose from the depths, breaking through the water’s surface.

Smaller and smaller it became, until it finally took the form of a cave dwelling, drifting toward Jiushan Prefecture.

After reaching the Nascent Soul stage, Li Fan's spiritual perception had become increasingly acute. The moment he directly faced the Chaoyuan Sect ruins, he even felt a faint sense of mortal danger.

"Opportunities in this world are endless. There's no need to take this risk. Let others explore it first, and once the mysteries within are fully understood, I’ll reconsider."

Watching the Chaoyuan Sect relics disappear into the distance, Li Fan thought to himself.

Though Li Fan himself remained indifferent, the emergence of the Chaoyuan Sect ruins caused an uproar among the cultivators.

Moments ago, he had just informed everyone that a mysterious underwater cave dwelling had appeared. Many cultivators hadn't even left the Administrative Hall yet when the relics surfaced.

What a coincidence!

Some cultivators even suspected that the cave dwelling was a fabrication by Li Fan—an elaborate ploy to once again showcase his unfathomable prophetic abilities.

However, this theory was quickly dismissed. The reason was simple—the ancient and solemn aura radiating from the Chaoyuan Sect ruins was impossible to fake.

Furthermore, due to the immense attention the relics attracted, cultivators working together soon identified the origins of the Grand Hall of Taiyuan within the ruins.

The Ancient Immortal Sect—Chaoyuan Sect!

A seasoned Soul Transformation cultivator, well-versed in the history of ancient cultivation, personally vouched for its authenticity, solidifying the relics as genuine.

As a result, cultivators from across Congyun Sea and even throughout the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance were drawn in by the allure of this so-called "fortuitous encounter," pursuing the ruins on their journey.

Among them was someone Li Fan hadn’t expected.

Inside the Administrative Hall

"You're going too? No matter how great the Chaoyuan Sect’s opportunity is, it still can’t compare to… Or are you just going to observe for a while and then return?"

Facing Gao Yuan's farewell, He Zhenghao was completely taken aback.

"Heh. After returning, I kept feeling like something was off. I pondered for three days and nights before I finally figured it out," Gao Yuan said with some emotion.

"To forge iron, one must be strong themselves. No matter how favored I am by my lord, my cultivation is still only at the Golden Core stage. Here in Congyun Sea, I might still hold some authority. But if my lord truly succeeds in his Dao Integration breakthrough, his subordinates will inevitably be filled with Soul Transformation and Nascent Soul cultivators. How could I possibly command respect? To better follow in my lord’s footsteps, I, Gao Yuan, must fight for my own strength!"

He Zhenghao, however, was not convinced by these righteous words. He scrutinized Gao Yuan with a skeptical gaze.

"Don't look at me like that," Gao Yuan chuckled. "I'm not lying to you this time. I’ve already applied for leave from my lord and will be departing immediately."

"What about you, Daoist He?" Gao Yuan gave He Zhenghao a meaningful look.

He Zhenghao hesitated for a moment but ultimately declined the invitation, citing the need for someone to maintain and oversee the affairs of Congyun Sea.

Seeing this, Gao Yuan said no more. He cupped his hands in farewell and swiftly departed.

Spending such a vast amount of contribution points, he had already prepared for the possibility of his information being exposed. But it didn’t matter—at most, the Five Elders Association might deduce that "Li Fan, the cultivator from the Heavenly Mechanism Sect," was also a member of the Heaven-Suppressing Society. After all, who would have thought that the cultivator making waves in the Xuanhuang Realm was, in reality, just a mere "mortal" from a small outer world?

Before long, all truths would be buried beneath the catastrophe of world destruction. Even if someone wanted to investigate, there would be no way to do so.

The river of time surged forward, and everything proceeded steadily, step by step.

The number of revived cultivators from the Medicine King Sect had now reached 346, including Liu San.

Although the vast majority were at the Foundation Establishment and Golden Core stages, with only five at the Nascent Soul stage, when united, they still formed a formidable force.

More importantly, as time passed, the effects of the Bloodline Transmission Ritual became increasingly apparent. Their reverence for Li Fan grew stronger by the day.

Moreover, Li Fan constantly reinforced their beliefs through indoctrination, repeatedly emphasizing the goal of "reviving the Medicine King Sect." Gradually, their gazes toward him began to reveal a near-fanatical devotion.

Li Fan was convinced that soon, even if he ordered them to sacrifice their lives for the Medicine King Sect, they would do so without hesitation.

"The Bloodline Transmission Ritual is truly extraordinary." Li Fan was extremely satisfied with the effects of this divine technique.

Of course, its remarkable effectiveness was largely built upon his absolute dominance in strength.

When he had attempted to use the ritual on a Soul Transformation cultivator, it had completely failed. Even among the five Nascent Soul cultivators, converting them had been extremely difficult. It was only with Liu San’s assistance that the process had barely succeeded.

Now that he had enough manpower, Li Fan gradually ceased the revival of further Medicine King Sect cultivators.

Li Fan knew that the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance monitored the number of cultivators in each state. The sudden increase of more than 300 cultivators was still within a reasonable range, given the vast population of cultivators in Congyun Sea. However, any further increase might arouse suspicion and lead to an investigation, so he decided to hold off for now.

After inquiring with Liu San about the detailed information regarding the still-slumbering Dao Integration elder, Li Fan used the second True Temptation Fruit.

He awakened a Dao Integration cultivator named Fang Zaiji.

This man was an elder of the Medicine King Sect, specializing in artifact refinement. The Small Medicine King Cauldrons used by the disciples were crafted by him.

However, Fang Zaiji was not originally a cultivator of the Medicine King Sect. Years ago, while being pursued and near death, he was saved by Liu Ruchen. To repay this kindness and to escape from his enemies, he chose to remain in the Medicine King Sect as a Guest Elder.

Fang Zaiji had little emotional attachment to the Medicine King Sect, but he was deeply interested in the refinement method of the sect’s treasured divine artifact, the "Medicine King True Cauldron".

Back then, Liu Ruchen had promised to lend him the Medicine King True Cauldron for research, which convinced him to stay.

Li Fan used the True Temptation Fruit to alter Fang Zaiji’s perception.

Now, in Fang Zaiji’s revised memories, his time in the Medicine King Sect was mostly distant from the other disciples.

Only Liu Yihang—who was actually Li Fan—constantly pestered him every day. He had practically watched Li Fan grow up and had already come to regard him as half a son.

Along with absolute trust in Li Fan’s commands, when the effects of the True Temptation Fruit faded and Fang Zaiji awoke—

After listening to Li Fan’s explanation, he quickly understood the current situation.

"It seems that the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance is even more sinister than the Ten Great Immortal Sects of back then," Fang Zaiji muttered, his eyes darkening.

"Sect Master, you should have awakened me earlier," he said with a trace of reproach in his tone.

Li Fan shook his head slightly and explained, "At the time, I wanted to secure Longevity Valley as a foothold first, so I awakened Elder Liu first."

"When I considered awakening you next, I learned that the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance was monitoring the number of cultivators in each state. At the time, I wasn’t sure what was going on, so I held off for safety reasons. Now that I understand the situation, it seems to be related to the new cultivation method of today’s cultivators. If not for Li Fan’s own experience of reincarnating through a hundred lifetimes—granting him an unshakable will—he would have succumbed to madness and insanity on the spot.

The number of cultivators dwindled to near extinction. Yet, mortals, like resilient weeds, began to emerge once again across the world.

Regarding the origins of these newly born mortals, some claimed they were survivors of the great migration. Others believed they were the descendants of cultivators. There were also those who suggested that mortals from the small worlds had broken through the blockade of the Immortal-Sealing Formation and returned.

Regardless, as cultivators gradually vanished from the land, the mortals of the Xuanhuang Realm began to thrive in the gaps left behind.

Along with the resurgence of mortals came the Xuanhuang Clear Heart Mantra.

Like folk songs and legends of unknown origin, it spread by word of mouth. Eventually, nearly every human tribe became aware of this technique, which allowed mortals to escape the influence of the Immortal-Mortal Miasma and once again embark on the path of cultivation.

Today's cultivators speculate that this could very well be the work of the Mysterious Eastern Extremity Heavenly Sovereign of the Ten Thousand Immortals Alliance.

After all, the Purification Spirit Pool, which also removes the Immortal-Mortal Miasma, was created by the Eastern Extremity Heavenly Sovereign. It is highly possible that the Xuanhuang Clear Heart Mantra was an earlier experiment before the creation of the Purification Spirit Pool.However, now that Li Fan understands the true nature of the Xuanhuang Clear Heart Mantra, he finds this possibility unlikely.

The Eastern Extremity Heavenly Sovereign, the nominal leader of the Ten Thousand Immortals Alliance, only appeared a few times in the alliance's earliest recorded history before vanishing entirely.

Rather than believing he was a true immortal, Li Fan considered it more likely that, like himself, the Eastern Extremity Heavenly Sovereign had uncovered the secrets of the Xuanhuang Clear Heart Mantra.

Perhaps, inspired by this discovery, he later created the Purification Spirit Pool.

"Could the disappearance of the Eastern Extremity Heavenly Sovereign also be related to the Xuanhuang Clear Heart Mantra?" This thought surfaced in Li Fan’s mind.

Yet, when he tried to search for records on the Eastern Extremity Heavenly Sovereign, he found almost nothing—just as before, the information was nearly nonexistent, with no additional records to be found.

This was completely inconsistent with the status of a leader of the Ten Thousand Immortals Alliance.

"This is truly unsettling."

Li Fan decided not to dwell on it further and instead focused once again on comprehending the Xuanhuang Immortal Heart Mantra.

Half a month later, Li Fan gathered everyone in the Administration Hall once more.

At first, they thought he had another major announcement to make, but instead, they were greeted with the news that he was going into seclusion again.

"Didn’t he just leave seclusion not long ago? And now he’s going back? Could it be that ancient cultivators were all this diligent?"

This was an absolute last resort. Even if they survived the calamity, they would not escape the punishment of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance.

But at this moment, having already committed the act of "slaughtering their own kin," the cultivators no longer cared about such consequences.

The Heavenly Origin Transformation Formation, originally linked to various earth vein nodes, was now reversed—starting to extract power directly from the earth veins.

Hummm…

Before long, a strange sound echoed in everyone’s ears.

It was as if the earth itself was toppling, mountains fracturing apart.

The already boiling sea grew even more violent. The Congyun Sea surged with monstrous waves, and dark storm clouds gathered from an unknown source, rolling in from the sky.

The howling wind roared, the ocean trembled.

Before the overwhelming might of heaven and earth, every cultivator in Congyun City turned pale as death, their bodies trembling uncontrollably.

However, infused with the yellowish earth vein power, the protective formation of Congyun City became even more solid and unyielding. Amidst the world-shaking destruction, it stood firm like an unshakable fortress in a storm, offering a sliver of hope to the cultivators.

The waves grew even fiercer.

As the surface of the Congyun Sea continued to recede, parts of the shallow seabed began to emerge.

But unlike a normal seabed covered in sediment, this one was entirely shrouded in a layer of an unknown black substance.

It was as if the rocks had been completely incinerated to ash.

"Even if we survive this disaster, it'll take at least several decades—maybe even centuries—for the Congyun Sea to recover."

Many cultivators, witnessing the scene, sighed in lament.

Yet, seeing that the Ink Flame had still not revealed itself, Immortal Lord Hongxi hardened his resolve completely.

"Continue—do not stop!"

The rumbling sound of the seabed fracturing echoed as the Heavenly Origin Transformation Formation continued operating at full power.

Boom!

It seemed to have reached a critical threshold, as fiery magma suddenly erupted from the ocean floor.

Then, as if triggering a chain reaction, volcanic flames burst forth across the entire Congyun Sea, with lava shooting toward the sky.

A thousand fiery dragons soared, scorching the heavens and earth.

Amid the distorted air, a figure half-red and half-black silently emerged beneath Congyun City.

"So, you've finally come out?"

A flash of killing intent and greed flickered in Immortal Lord Hongxi's eyes before his figure vanished.

In the next moment, he transformed into a continuous mountain range, encircling the entity at the center.

"That is..."

"Crimson Flame! The Spirit of Heaven and Earth, Crimson Flame!"

Witnessing the evolved form of Crimson Flame, the cultivators were all thrown into a frenzy.

Even though they had already seen its terrifying power—capable of incinerating the sea with a mere gesture—it did nothing to quell their burning desire.

"So it wasn't a meteor catastrophe, but rather the descent of the Spirit of Heaven and Earth!"

"Indeed! This is a great opportunity!"

"Sacrificing the Spirit of Heaven and Earth can grant us an instant breakthrough to Dao Integration!"

Within just a few breaths, the cultivators were consumed by greed. Some began rallying others to hunt down Crimson Flame together.

Others, having completely lost their minds, rushed toward Crimson Flame like moths to a flame.

As expected, before they could even approach, they were reduced to ashes by the intense heat.

"It's still Crimson Flame, not Ink Flame?"

Li Fan paid no heed to their deaths, instead fixating on the half-red, half-black mutated Crimson Flame, lost in thought.

His clone felt the same surge of greed.

However, unlike in previous lifetimes, where the mere sight of Crimson Flame nearly made him lose his sanity, this time was different.

Without consciously activating the Xuanhuang Immortal Heart Mantra, the greed from his clone dissipated on its own.

Like snow melting into water, it only caused faint ripples, leaving no real impact on him.

"Immortal techniques are truly extraordinary. Not only does my main body remain clear-minded, but even a clone thousands of miles away is unwavering."

Li Fan sighed inwardly.

Still, to avoid exposing himself, he feigned being deeply captivated by the Spirit of Heaven and Earth, struggling to restrain himself.

His eyes turned bloodshot, veins bulging, his body rigid.

He wanted to see—where did Immortal Lord Hongxi find the courage to face Crimson Flame alone?

After all, in the previous life, even a weakened version of Crimson Flame had been too powerful. Hongxi and several other Soul Transformation cultivators together were no match for it.

Let alone this black-red version in this life.

Without some secret weapon, Immortal Lord Hongxi would surely be instantly annihilated.

But clearly, Hongxi was not a reckless fool.

Under Li Fan’s watchful gaze, Hongxi flew toward Crimson Flame.

A towering mountain range materialized, momentarily trapping Crimson Flame. At the same time, Hongxi raised a small rectangular mirror and aimed it at Crimson Flame!

"That is..."

Li Fan’s pupils contracted sharply.

"Xuantian Sealing the Spirit!" Hongxi roared.

A radiant blue light shot forth from the mirror, striking Crimson Flame directly.

As if struck by a powerful gust of wind, Crimson Flame’s translucent body flickered unsteadily.

Yet despite its overwhelming might just moments ago, it was utterly powerless against this blue light!

As though inherently restrained, a look of astonishment appeared on Crimson Flame's face, and its body froze instantly!

A look of ecstasy surged onto Hongxi's face.

"This is bad!"

Li Fan’s heart sank.

"Could it be that in this life, Hongxi will actually succeed in Dao Integration so easily?"

He hadn’t expected that after returning from the Ten Thousand Immortals Alliance headquarters, Immortal Lord Hongxi would wield such a terrifying weapon—the Xuantian Sealing Spirit.

And in the face of this technique, the Spirit of Heaven and Earth was unbelievably feeble!

From a certain perspective, this was a case of cause and effect—Immortal Lord Hongxi was digging his own grave.

Noticing that his energy was depleting even faster than Crimson Flame’s, Hongxi’s expression kept shifting.

At this moment, if he withdrew the Xuantian Sealing Spirit Mirror and gave up suppressing Crimson Flame, focusing entirely on the situation at hand, he might be able to escape from the Earth-Fire Return to Origin Formation.

However, the Xuantian Sealing Spirit Mirror could only be used once. After activation, the mirror would turn into an ordinary object. To use it again, he would have to return to the Ten Thousand Immortals Alliance headquarters to request a recharge.

This meant that if he interrupted the process now, all his previous efforts would be wasted.

He might be able to save his life, but achieving Dao Integration? That would be out of the question.

On the other hand, if he fought to the death, there was indeed the risk of losing his life—but there was also a chance of breaking through to the Dao Integration realm! If he succeeded, the heavens and earth would be vast before him, and his fate would be forever changed!

Green and yellow intertwined like a sharp blade, about to pierce fiercely into Crimson Flame’s body.

In an unknown space.

"Each of us was drawn into activating a divine ability. It must be related to that entity we made a deal with through the [Heaven-Suppressing Alliance]."

"Zhou Qingang, Li Fan?"

"Are they all dead?"

"Heh, how interesting."

"These are mere trivial matters; it could just be a distraction meant to catch our attention. The real issue is—why has [Chaos] reappeared in the Xuanhuang Realm?"

"I'll have my subordinates investigate, but we shouldn't place too much hope in it. There’s something unusual about this."

"That old geezer Immortal Ancestor seems to have disappeared again recently."

"Oh? That reminds me of something amusing, hehe."

…

As the conversation continued, the five statues eventually closed their eyes once more.

Silence returned to the space.

Tianling Prefecture.

Looking toward the Congyun Sea in the distance, the vision in Li Fan's mind suddenly cut off.

He remained silent.

Focusing his senses, he detected no imminent danger.

After a long time, he finally let out a breath and flew swiftly toward the location of the Longevity Valley.

"As I expected, the 'Manifested Heavenly Sovereign Statue' isn’t just a simple communication tool linked to the Five Elders Association."

"Senior Sister Zhao, the robed cultivator, the scholar, the infant, and that invisible golden parchment…"

"They must correspond to the Longevity Immortal Heavenly Sovereigns of the Five Elders Association."

Li Fan’s eyes flickered with thought.

As the most valuable artifact obtained from his dealings with the Five Elders Association, he refused to believe that the Heavenly Sovereign Statue was merely a transmission device.

Even his own Soul Fragment Jade Slip carried a trace of his divine sense, after all.

Therefore, although the Five Elders Association did not explicitly state it, Li Fan still speculated that the Heavenly Sovereign Statue must contain some of the power of the Five Longevity Immortal Heavenly Sovereigns.

Using it to deceive others while simultaneously testing Mo Sha's true strength was a perfect strategy.

"I just don't know whether, after using the Manifested Heavenly Sovereign Statue in this way, my final request—that the Five Elders Association hide my identity, command Samantabhadra True Boat, sneak into the Ten Thousand Immortals Alliance through the White Mist Barrier, and create chaos across various locations—will be granted."

Li Fan pondered silently.

According to the Five Elders Association's spies, orders from the Manifested Heavenly Sovereign Statue were almost equivalent to a decree from the Heavenly Sovereigns themselves. As long as it did not threaten the rule of the Five Elders Association, it would be strictly carried out.

However, since it had only been a short time since the peace negotiations between the Five Elders Association and the Ten Thousand Immortals Alliance, and given that Li Fan had essentially tricked the Five Elders Association, it was uncertain whether all his orders would be implemented.

"No matter what, my goal has already been achieved. With so many forces erupting at once and the Chaos Technique further stirring the pot, everything has turned into an unsolvable mess."

"Even if someone wants to investigate, they likely won’t have the means to do so."

Restored to his original appearance, Li Fan thought to himself.

"The former cultivator of the Heavenly Mechanism Sect, Li Fan, is already dead. The only one who exists now is just an ordinary Nascent Soul cultivator."

Li Fan knew that his mysterious "death" and the sudden disappearance of billions of contribution points from his account would undoubtedly raise many suspicions.

But...

So what?

He was already "dead," and he had died on a battlefield surrounded by powerful figures.

How could they investigate?

Who would dare investigate?

Most likely, the matter would be quietly dismissed.

"As long as I hide in Longevity Valley for a while longer, all of this will be forgotten."

"By then, even if I openly proclaim myself as Li Fan, it probably won’t cause much of a stir."

...

Li Fan's eyes gleamed as he sped toward Longevity Valley.

After about half a month, he finally arrived at his destination.

Within the Essence Devouring White Mist, he located the markings left behind by Elder Liu, broke through the seal, and finally entered Longevity Valley.

A surge of dense wood-attribute spiritual energy washed over him, making Li Fan unconsciously squint his eyes in comfort.

"Young Master, you've arrived!"

Sensing Li Fan's aura, Liu San hurried over to greet him.

"Was everything successful?" he asked.

Li Fan nodded but did not elaborate.

Since Liu San trusted Li Fan deeply, he refrained from asking further questions.

"For the next few years, we will focus on laying low. Unless necessary, do not venture outside. Our priority is refining the Longevity Pill," Li Fan declared, setting the course of action for the near future.

Liu San immediately agreed.

"Apart from the Longevity Pill, I have found several other medicinal pills that could also fetch a high price," Liu San suggested.

"I noticed that New Method Cultivators tend to have highly volatile emotions. Since Longevity Valley has all the necessary herbs, I can take some time to refine the Supreme Emotionless Pill."

Liu San then explained the pill's effects to Li Fan.

It was quite similar to Blue Flame, which Li Fan had previously used. This pill would allow its user to maintain an almost absolute state of rationality.

Not only could it enhance combat performance by up to 200%, but it also had miraculous effects in breaking bottlenecks and achieving enlightenment.

Li Fan was very pleased with this.

"Elder Liu, you are absolutely right. This pill will surely be well-received in the Ten Thousand Immortals Alliance."

"However, do not overly pursue high-quality versions. Try to refine ones with lower medicinal potency instead," Li Fan instructed.

"Oh, right."

As if remembering something, Li Fan began introducing Liu San and the others to the existence of the Fallen Immortal Realm.

Chapter 651


"A single glance reflects ten thousand years, and after falling, one becomes a world of their own?!"

"How is this possible?"

Liu San was shocked by the unbelievable reality that Li Fan had just described.

"How could the Xuanhuang Realm have a True Immortal? Why have we never heard of such a thing?"

Even as a Dao Integration expert, upon hearing of the existence of the Fallen Immortal Realm, Liu San's reaction was no better than Li Fan's.

Li Fan smiled and said, "Elder Liu, there is no need for doubt. This matter is absolutely true—I have personally experienced it."

"What my eyes saw was exactly as it was back then. Truly the work of a True Immortal." He shook his head, full of emotion.

Hearing this, Liu San was completely convinced, but his heart grew even more astonished.

Suddenly, as if he had realized something, his eyes flashed with excitement.

"Young Master, you just said that the Fallen Immortal Realm is a true projection of the ancient Xuanhuang Realm. Does that mean that the Medicine King Sect from back then still exists within it?""The old sect master, even you and me, as well as all the other cultivators of the Medicine King Sect..."

"During our exploration, is it possible that we might encounter them?" Liu San’s voice trembled as he slowly asked.

Li Fan pondered for a moment before nodding, giving him a definite answer.

Throughout the history of the Xuanhuang Realm, there were indeed cases where ancient slumbering cultivators entered the Fallen Immortal Realm and encountered another version of themselves.

However, strange phenomena such as "the two cannot meet" or "a mutual resonance" never occurred. At the end of the day, when ancient cultivators arrived in the present, everything from the past was already gone. The Fallen Immortal Realm merely contained a projection of their past selves at a certain moment in time. Other than evoking feelings of nostalgia and sentimentality, seeing another version of oneself was no different from encountering any other being.

Likewise, the "natives" of the Fallen Immortal Realm would not mistake outsiders who entered as mere projections of the past. Even if their appearance and aura were exactly the same, it wouldn’t matter. They would simply assume it was some kind of illusionary technique.

However, Li Fan had once come across a discussion in the [Seeking Immortals] section of the Tianxuan Mirror. It speculated that if a cultivator survived from ancient times to the present and reached an unimaginably profound level of cultivation, they might achieve something called "Eternal Presence, Timeless Freedom."

The so-called Eternal Presence referred to a cultivator transcending the River of Time, allowing them to exist simultaneously in the past, present, and future. Every instance of themselves across time would be the same transcendent being. If such a cultivator projected into the Fallen Immortal Realm, their projection and true self might indeed be considered one and the same.

Though this was only a theoretical concept, it represented the ultimate pursuit of the Dao for cultivators, making it a topic of much fascination.

Some cultivators further argued that if such a being truly existed, they would have long since reversed cause and effect, turning time itself into an unbroken cycle. How could they possibly be captured by a mere glance from a True Immortal and drawn into the Fallen Immortal Realm?

Thus, the idea that the Fallen Immortal Realm’s projections were actually the true selves of people from reality remained a paradox.

Li Fan roughly explained these ideas to Liu San. Though Liu San nodded on the surface, appearing reassured, he was still eager to enter the Fallen Immortal Realm and see for himself.

Seeing this, Li Fan didn't mind. He simply shook his head with a faint smile and then carefully explained the ritual procedure to Liu San.

"Blessings to the Celestial Venerable Of Xuanhuang!"

Without hesitation, Liu San activated the ritual before Li Fan and entered the Fallen Immortal Realm.

Li Fan, however, narrowed his eyes slightly and gazed toward the sky.

Perhaps due to his recent breakthrough in the Xuanhuang Immortal Heart Mantra, his perception had become far keener than before.

At the very moment Liu San’s strand of divine consciousness vanished, Li Fan clearly sensed a shadow fleeting across the heavens of the real world.

"That was no illusion... The Fallen Immortal Realm, huh..."

The shadow disappeared from his perception in an instant, but Li Fan’s gaze lingered on the sky for a long time.

Li Fan had spent a long time wandering in the [Seeking Immortals] forum and knew that many cultivators had attempted to find traces of the Fallen Immortal Realm in the real world. However, it was said that without exception, they all failed.

They only knew of its existence and how to enter it.

But they could never observe it.

Yet now, Li Fan, who was merely at the Nascent Soul stage, had unexpectedly broken this pattern.

"My previous experiences in the Fallen Immortal Realm were different from others. I kept reliving certain scenarios in an endless cycle. I never understood the reason before. But now, it seems that it might be closely tied to the Xuanhuang Mantra."

"The True Immortal's legacy... the remnants of a True Immortal’s will… Maybe there really is some connection between the two."

"It’s been a long time since I entered the Fallen Immortal Realm. I hope that with the blessing of the Xuanhuang Immortal Heart Mantra this time, I’ll receive some surprises."

Li Fan pondered silently.

However, he did not act immediately. While waiting for Liu San to wake up, he took a stroll around Longevity Valley.

The valley was divided into separate areas by formations, each dedicated to growing different types of spiritual herbs. As expected from a secret realm sealed for a thousand years, even with the formations isolating the area, Li Fan could still feel the abundant vitality emanating from the spiritual fields.

From time to time, cultivators from the Medicine King Sect moved through the valley, using secret techniques to select and harvest the appropriate materials for alchemy.

In the distant open area, he could vaguely see several half-constructed buildings taking shape.

That was the new Medicine King Sect headquarters, being built under Fang Zaiji’s command.

"Quite an imposing sight," Li Fan nodded in admiration.

With the Congyun Sea Conflict settled, it was time to plan for the future.

His main objectives were twofold:

First, he needed to find a way to obtain the latter part of the Mountain Sitting Technique beyond the Nascent Soul stage.

Since the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance had not yet enacted the "The Plan of the Heavenly Sovereign of Reality and Illusion" to lure out hidden spies, the Five Elders Association had not been forced to send a Dao Integration powerhouse as a test. As a result, the great battle between the two sides, the scheme against Immortal Sage Jicheng, and his impending death due to lifespan exhaustion had not yet occurred.

Therefore, if Li Fan wanted to acquire the "Audience Law Jade Plaque"—the key to access Law Derivation Jade—he would need to find another method.

Fortunately, he had already made preparations, so this wasn’t a major concern.

His second goal was to accumulate experience and insights for advancing to the Soul Transformation stage. The Nascent Soul stage was essentially the process of cultivating and perfecting one's Cave-Heaven Domain, while the gap between Nascent Soul and Soul Transformation was the key dividing line in a cultivator’s actual combat power.

Take, for example, Immortal Lord Hongxi, who had perished in the Congyun Sea Calamity.

He built his Dao Foundation through the Five Elements Mountain and achieved Golden Core using the five elemental laws—Metal, Wood, Water, Fire, and Earth.

His talent was undeniable, and his initial path was smooth.

However, when it came to the crucial stages of "Seizing the essence of heaven and earth to form a Nascent Soul" and "Extracting the marrow of heaven and earth to obtain divine soul transformation," his promising future took a drastic downturn.

His so-called "Hundred Ridges Cave-Heaven" and "Taihua Giving Birth to a Thousand Mountains" were clearly far inferior in strength.

As a result, Immortal Lord Hongxi's combat power remained unimpressive. He spent his entire life trapped in the remote Congyun Sea, and breaking through any further was nearly impossible.

On the other hand, if Immortal Lord Hongxi had managed to cultivate the Five Elements Great Cave-Heaven to achieve Nascent Soul, how far could his potential have taken him?
