Chapter 652


With the Five Elements Great Cave-Heaven as a foundation, even if the Marrow of Heaven that Hongxi extracted during his Soul Transformation was unremarkable, his achievements would still be incomparable to today’s standards.

Was it because he didn’t want to?

No, it was simply because he couldn’t.

If rare treasures and heavenly laws could be obtained through personal effort, then at least there would still be some chance to strive for them.

However, by the time a cultivator reaches the Nascent Soul or Soul Transformation stage, acquiring a powerful and precious Cave-Heaven World or Heavenly Marrow is no longer just about diligence. Without a strong family background, sufficient resources, or extraordinary luck, how could one compete with other cultivators?

For an ordinary cultivator, simply securing enough resources to break through is already a great fortune. They have no luxury to pick and choose.

Take Diyi Jinglun, for example—he decisively abandoned the opportunity for Dao Integration when faced with the temptation of the Spirit of Heaven and Earth. Of course, this was partly because he was a peerless genius who looked down on the weak Spirit of Heaven and Earth. However, it was also because, as a high-ranking member of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance, the resources and knowledge he controlled were beyond the reach of ordinary cultivators.

The strong can afford to be selective about their path to immortality, carefully weighing every choice, making them even stronger.

Meanwhile, the weak must seize every rare opportunity for advancement, barely scraping by—thus, the weak remain weak.

This is why, from the Nascent Soul Realm onward, the gap between individual cultivators grows increasingly vast.Even within the same realm, instant defeat in battle is not unheard of.

Now, with his breakthrough through the Five Elements Great Cave-Heaven, Li Fan has already reached the pinnacle of the Nascent Soul Realm.

But when it comes to finding a Marrow of Heaven that matches his cultivation, he is still completely lost.

What is the Marrow of Heaven?

Long Jiuyuan used the 'Heavenly Spirit’s Thousand Waters' to achieve Soul Transformation.

Hongxi relied on Taihua’s Thousand Mountains to break through.

From the heaven and earth notices issued upon their deaths, some clues can be inferred.

Just as human marrow produces blood, Marrow of Heaven produces laws.

When a new law appears in the Xuanhuang World, it manifests as a change in nature—the heaven and earth undergoes transformation.

In Tianling Prefecture, thousands of rivers will form over the next few millennia.

In Taihua Prefecture, thousands of mountains will rise in the coming ages.

These are preordained, inevitable changes in Xuanhuang World over a certain region and period.

Extracting the Marrow of Heaven means taking the fundamental laws that drive these natural transformations and drawing them into oneself.

By channeling the immense power of heaven and earth, one can achieve an enormous leap in cultivation and battle prowess.

Furthermore, the initial fusion of heavenly laws within one’s body lays the groundwork for the Dao Integration stage, when a cultivator must sacrifice the Spirit of Heaven and Earth.

"Heaven and Earth transformations take tens of thousands of years. With ordinary perception, cultivators wouldn’t even notice them. But under the new Heavenly Sovereign Laws, one can detect even the subtlest changes—first tearing open a gap, then continuously drawing in and absorbing the world's originally slow-releasing source power at an accelerated rate."

"Though this greatly depletes the world’s potential, for cultivators, it provides a rapid surge in strength."

Li Fan’s mind raced, analyzing everything he had learned.

"The Five Elements Cave-Heaven is self-sustaining, forming a perfect cycle. It is a rare and precious opportunity. If I advance to Soul Transformation and extract the Marrow of Heaven, it must be related to this."

"However, the Five Elements, when manifest in the world, tend to disperse. A single type of Marrow of Heaven will likely correspond to only one elemental attribute."

"Attempting to cultivate multiple laws at the Soul Transformation stage, like during the Golden Core stage, is far more difficult."

Li Fan narrowed his eyes.

Beyond law creation, Marrow of Heaven also possesses immunity and resistance mechanisms.

Once a cultivator has absorbed a particular Marrow of Heaven, attempting to extract another will trigger resistance from the world itself, leading to rejection.

“The more one masters, the greater the repelling force. With each additional type, the difficulty increases almost exponentially. So, for the vast majority of cultivators in this world, extracting even a single type of Marrow of Heaven is already the limit.”

“Even someone as powerful as Long Jiuyuan, who could single-handedly battle the Spirit of Heaven and Earth and ascend to Dao Integration, faced the same challenge. This alone shows how difficult it is.”

“I’m afraid I can, at most, accommodate only two types of Marrow of Heaven at the same time…” Li Fan thought to himself, not blindly overestimating his abilities.

“To achieve a perfect breakthrough, unless…”

A sharp glint flashed in Li Fan’s eyes. “Extracting five different types of Marrow of Heaven simultaneously and utilizing the principle of mutual generation and restriction to achieve self-balancing.”

This was undoubtedly an outlandish idea.

Not to mention the rarity of encountering an opportunity to extract five types of Marrow of Heaven at once—even if such an opportunity arose, the chances of success would be minuscule.

Any rational cultivator would never attempt such a thing.

However, for Li Fan, it was not entirely impossible to try!

In his mind, the Dao Deviation Stone continuously emitted a soft blue glow, systematically integrating all the information he had ever come across, slowly deducing a potential method to realize his idea.

...

More than ten days later, Li Fan sensed Liu San awakening. His figure flickered, and he appeared in front of him.

It seemed that Liu San had spent an incredibly long time in the Fallen Immortal Realm. Just as he returned to the real world, he was still somewhat unaccustomed to it.

A hint of confusion flashed in his eyes.

However, the moment he saw Li Fan, that trace of bewilderment quickly faded.

“Young Master!” Liu San stood up, his expression calm and composed.

“How was it? Did you encounter the alchemists from the Medicine King Sect of the past?” Li Fan asked kindly.

Liu San shook his head.

“Strangely enough, the scene I experienced this time in the Fallen Immortal Realm was not the ancient cultivation world you described, Young Master. Instead, it was a time and space I had never heard of before.”

“In that world, immortal arts had been completely severed, and no cultivators existed anymore. The only way people could wield extraordinary powers was by resonating with ancient artifacts left behind from ages past. They were called something like ‘Divine Weapon Wielders’…”

“And this time, the person I possessed was merely a little brat, no more than seven or eight years old.”

As Liu San recalled the experience, he narrated everything to Li Fan.

“In the end, after enduring countless hardships and experiencing endless bloodshed and slaughter, I finally managed to resonate with the legendary strongest divine weapon.”

“The ‘Immortal Execution Sword’…”

As he spoke, Liu San took out a long sword that radiated a dazzling seven-colored light, yet seemed to exude an endless aura of slaughter.

Li Fan’s gaze sharpened. But after taking a closer look, he couldn’t help but chuckle.

Liu San then remarked, “Quite the grand name. But in truth, it’s nothing more than a Natal Flying Sword forged by a Nascent Soul-stage sword cultivator.”

“It only stood out among a pile of so-called ‘divine weapons’ because it happened to be tainted with a wisp of a fallen cultivator’s lingering soul.”

Liu San glanced at the flying sword before him with some disdain and commented, “The forging technique is crude, and the material is extremely ordinary. What a piece of junk.”

With that, he applied a slight force.

The so-called strongest divine weapon, the ‘Immortal Execution Sword,’ instantly crumbled into dust.

To prevent another ambush.

He performed a talisman seal, activating the entrance to the underground secluded chamber beneath the main hall, and then sealed the doorway behind him.

Taking out an ice-blue pill, it was none other than Liu San’s refined "Supreme Emotionless Pill". Li Fan consumed it.

A familiar sensation surged through him as he initiated the ritual.

"Blessings to the Celestial Venerable Of Xuanhuang!"

In front of him, two constantly flickering scenes appeared.

Both were familiar to Li Fan.

One was [Ningyuan's Longevity Fruit], and the other was [The Beast-Taming Sect’s Upheaval]—both events he had previously experienced in the Fallen Immortal Realm!

In an instant, the light and shadow in front of him surged toward him.

"Sigh, I wonder when Senior Brother Lu Ya will return."

A slightly dejected voice from Xu Ke reached Li Fan’s ears.

Chapter 654


Under the instinctive power of his possessed body, Li Fan struck Xu Ke with a claw.

Memories flooded into his mind naturally.

Since their return to the Beast-Taming Sect from the Sacred Beast Mountain of Nanming, Li Fan and Xu Ke had learned that both Emperor Sanmo and Senior Brother Lu Ya had gone out on important matters and were nowhere to be found.

As a result, the rewards promised for their mission could not be fulfilled, which Xu Ke had been complaining about ever since.

Of course, in Li Fan’s view, Xu Ke’s concern stemmed more from his pure longing for Senior Brother Lu Ya. After all, both were orphans from the Xuantian Temple in Ningyuan City and had joined the Beast-Taming Sect together. It wouldn’t be an exaggeration to say that they were like family, relying on each other for survival.

Ignoring Xu Ke’s grumbling, Li Fan closed his eyes and focused on cultivating the Creation Furnace Technique.

It was indeed a perfect technique, modified by Mr. Bai himself. Ever since he had begun cultivating it, not only had his physical body become increasingly powerful, but his essence, energy, and spirit had also surged daily. Even if he stayed awake for days without rest, he wouldn’t feel the slightest fatigue. More importantly, his Heavenly Fate Black Bird bloodline seemed to have become purer.

Li Fan’s originally jet-black feathers now occasionally reflected a seven-colored radiance under the sunlight, making him appear extraordinarily majestic.

Even Xu Ke couldn’t help but reach out to touch them from time to time—only to be ruthlessly swatted away by Li Fan.

The enhancement of his bloodline brought comprehensive improvements to his abilities.His divine ability, "The Mandate of Heaven is Mine," was now wielded with increasing ease, nourishing Xu Ke’s fortune while simultaneously reinforcing his own. By now, Li Fan had reached the first major breakthrough recorded in his inherited memories—he could form a Mandate Domain within a certain range around himself. This not only allowed him to foresee and avoid danger but also to use destiny itself as a weapon against his enemies.

This was an extraordinary feat.

Among the Heavenly Fate Black Bird clan, only adult black bird over a hundred years old could typically achieve this.

Yet, Li Fan had hatched less than five years ago—he was still a fledgling.

Breaking the growth limitations of spirit beasts demonstrated just how extraordinary Mr. Bai’s Creation Furnace Technique truly was.

"After returning from the Fallen Immortal Realm, everything besides the rewards for fulfilling obsessions will be forgotten—including all learned techniques. I wonder… with the support of the 'Xuanhuang Immortal Heart Mantra,' will this rule be altered?"

Even if he couldn’t bring the technique back to reality, the countless insights gained from cultivating it were already immensely beneficial.

The Calamity of Incompatible Cultivation Technique

For the Beast Taming Sect, which primarily cultivates only the Beast Control Technique, was nearly catastrophic.

Almost everyone could foresee that once countless cultivators were trapped at their current cultivation level, with their lifespan nearing its end, they would resort to extreme measures in a desperate attempt to survive.

As a result, the disciples of the Beast Taming Sect fell into a state of immense panic. In an instant, they distanced themselves from one another, their eyes filled with suspicion toward the senior and junior brothers and sisters they once held dear.

For now, due to the lingering rationality and conscience of the disciples, no one had resorted to violence.

Even with the Sect Master and the elders personally stepping forward to calm the situation, they were unable to halt the spread of fear that continued to fester within the sect.

Gradually, some disciples could no longer endure the pressure and began to secretly flee. Meanwhile, others, pushed to their mental limits, had bloodshot eyes and showed signs of hysteria.

Three days later, the Beast Taming Sect’s Sect Master convened a grand sect meeting to address the calamity that had descended upon the world and to announce a series of plans:

To prevent mutual slaughter caused by the incompatibility of cultivation techniques, the Sect Master took the lead in dispersing the Beast Control Technique, requiring all disciples to follow suit—retaining only their cultivation base.

The entire Beast Taming Sect would evacuate from the main world of Xuanhuang in batches, relocating to designated small pocket realms for refuge.

Since the strength of Beast Taming Sect cultivators primarily lay in the spirit beasts they controlled, dispersing their own cultivation techniques would not significantly weaken their actual combat ability. Though slightly affected, they could still fight effectively.

Moreover, the spirit beasts raised by the disciples were carefully nurtured from birth, forming deep bonds with their masters. Even without the Beast Control Technique, the disciples could still command their beasts.

This plan successfully averted the danger of internal conflict, so there was little opposition. Those who initially refused eventually relented once the Sect Master personally led by example.

As for how they could disperse their techniques without affecting their cultivation base…

"Could it be… him?"

The so-called "Heart-Linking Ring" was a mystical artifact personally crafted by Emperor Sanmo.

At first glance, it appeared as a circular doorway radiating a blue glow. When a beast passed through it, only an instant would pass in the real world. However, in that fleeting moment, the beast would experience countless lifelike illusionary realms, indistinguishable from reality.

The "Heart-Linking" test aimed to assess whether a beast would ever act against its master under extreme circumstances.

Forging this "Heart-Linking Ring" was no easy task, and in their haste, the Beast Taming Sect managed to create only one. Although the test itself took very little time, the sheer number of beasts in the sect was overwhelming. The key to their control was the sect's supreme treasure, the Ten Thousand Beasts Reincarnation Wheel. It was said that this wheel bore engravings of nearly every known beast in existence. Even when a new species of beast emerged, its image would soon appear on the wheel.

From the moment a beast was born, the Ten Thousand Beasts Reincarnation Wheel would imprint a brand upon its soul, binding it for eternity, ensuring that it could never escape the wheel’s control.

It was said that this treasure had originally been brought from the Nanming Sacred Beast Mountain by Emperor Sanmo and given to the sect’s founding ancestor, Wan Shiyong. It was from the Ten Thousand Beasts Reincarnation Wheel that Wan Shiyong comprehended the profound [True Art of Beast Control].

However, despite its incredible abilities, the Ten Thousand Beasts Reincarnation Wheel had several fatal flaws. It could only be used on newborn beasts. Additionally, any beast imprinted with its brand would suffer excruciating, never-ending pain, known as the Agony of the Wheel. This agony severely stunted their intelligence, making them capable of only the simplest tasks.

True beast taming required perfect synchronization between beast and master. Only then could a tamer wield their beast as effortlessly as an extension of their own body, maximizing combat potential. In battle, even the smallest details could determine victory or defeat. If a controlled beast lacked intelligence, it was as good as fighting with one arm tied behind one’s back.Thus, Beast Taming Sect cultivators used the True Art of Beast Control to nurture their life-bound spirit beasts from a young age. After they awakened, Liu San assigned a team to collect and organize their experiences. To him, the Fallen Immortal Realm was essentially an enormous treasure trove—a free trial ground. If used wisely, it could greatly accelerate the revival of Medicine King Sect.

When Li Fan emerged and learned of this, he compiled the "strategies" he had seen in the Seeker of Immortality section and shared them with the disciples to improve their efficiency in exploring.

Regarding the gains from the Fallen Immortal Realm, Liu San had once proposed that all disciples submit their findings to be distributed under Li Fan’s management.

However, Li Fan rejected this idea.

Seizing someone’s opportunity is akin to killing their parents.

However, the Bloodline Transmission Technique had yet to reach the level where others could be regarded as mere slaves. If it provoked rebellion among the disciples for the sake of insignificant benefits, it would be a complete loss.

"Stability comes first in all matters." Li Fan once again reminded Liu Sandao.

With Liu San's flattering words—"Young Master's foresight is beyond my own"—Li Fan quietly left the Longevity Valley.

As he traversed the white mist and was about to return to the normal territory of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance, he suddenly discovered a patrol team of Nascent Soul cultivators guarding the barrier outside the mist.

It was clearly a response to the continuous harassment and attacks by the Five Elders Association.

With a slight smile, Li Fan silently bypassed them and headed straight for Luoyan Prefecture.

His target was none other than Han Yi, who had already turned into a stone statue.

Li Fan did not know what kind of transformation Han Yi had undergone, but the stone statue he had become was truly eerie.

Previously, when investigating through the Tianxuan Mirror, Li Fan had noticed that despite a long time passing and countless cultivators passing by, none had been able to detect Han Yi's presence.

Let alone the fact that the stone statue was continuously absorbing the fortune and fate of nearby living beings.

From the scattered clues Li Fan had gathered, it was evident that the influence of Han Yi was slowly expanding.

If he remained in this state indefinitely, it was conceivable that one day, the entire Luoyan Prefecture would be affected.

Although Li Fan had been aware of this before, he had no means to resist the method of absorbing fortune, nor was he willing to take the risk of investigating further.

But now, after obtaining the Heavenly Fate Black Bird Feather and gaining the ability to use the divine powers of the Black Bird, he felt he could attempt an investigation.

After more than ten days, Li Fan arrived at the mortal town from his memories.

It was not far outside this town where Han Yi had been turned into a stone statue by a single glare from the old fisherman.

At this moment, it was clear that the town had already fallen within the range of Han Yi’s influence.

Looking over, Li Fan saw pillars of fortune and fate rising from the heads of the mortals in town. Regardless of their quality, each one was entangled with a dense black mist.

The specific manifestations were evident—misfortune plagued every single resident.

Some stumbled and injured themselves for no reason, which was already considered fortunate. Others choked to death while eating, failed in business and lost everything, or even suffered complete ruin.

Some mortals had begun to notice that something was very wrong and attempted to flee.

However, as soon as they reached the outskirts, they died inexplicably due to various strange accidents.

Observing from the sky for a while, Li Fan noticed that when a mortal died, their pillar of fortune immediately shattered.

At that moment, the black mist entwining it devoured it ravenously, swallowing it entirely before suddenly vanishing, its destination unknown.

"Interesting," Li Fan mused.

Just as this thought crossed his mind, he suddenly felt a chilling sensation behind him—something was rushing toward him at high speed.

His expression changed slightly, and he swiftly dodged, barely avoiding a streak of sword light.

"Be careful, fellow Daoist!"

The sword light narrowly missed Li Fan and struck the mortal city below.

"Boom!"

In an instant, the entire city was annihilated by the sword light.

The mortals within had no chance to even scream before being completely wiped out.

Chapter 662

From time to time, pillars of black flames would erupt from the depths of the earth, spreading through the air and distorting the atmosphere with their blistering heat.

What truly made Li Fan’s heart pound was the unsettling sight of countless pitch-black voids scattered irregularly across the ground and sky of this charred basin.

Like a worm-eaten apple, the land was riddled with scars.

Moreover, Li Fan soon realized that these dark voids were not completely static. Rather, they seemed to possess a life of their own, writhing slowly, or suddenly jumping to a different location—devouring everything within their reach.

Even Fang Zaiji, a Dao Integration cultivator, looked grim in the face of such an eerie scene.

"Sect Master, are you sure we should proceed?" he asked hesitantly.

Li Fan did not respond immediately. Instead, he carefully observed for a long time.

"If we're careful, there shouldn't be a big problem. Those void caverns seem to shift unpredictably, but in reality, they follow a set pattern. They only teleport to relatively empty areas and will not appear near existing caverns."

"So, as long as we maintain a certain distance from the void caverns and keep moving forward, we should be fine."

"Besides, don’t we still have the True Cauldron of the Medicine King?"

As he spoke, Li Fan tossed the Medicine King Cauldron toward a pitch-black void not far away.

"Sect Master!" Fang Zaiji exclaimed in a low voice.

The Medicine King Cauldron emitted an earthy-yellow glow that enveloped itself. In the midst of the void, though the glow gradually dimmed, it still managed to persist for over ten breaths of time.

"See? Even if we accidentally enter, this amount of time would be more than enough for us to escape." Retrieving the Medicine King True Cauldron, Li Fan looked at Fang Zaiji and said with a smile.

"Sect Master, you're far too reckless! What if something happened to the Medicine King True Cauldron? What then?" Fang Zaiji muttered.

"Isn't that why you're here? Even if the Medicine King Cauldron were lost, I believe you, sir, could refine a new one for our Medicine King Sect." Li Fan replied nonchalantly.

"Back in our time, nothing like this ever happened. Judging by the situation, it seems the heavens intend to completely erase this place."

Congyun Sea had always been vast, and now, in order to avoid the ever-present void caverns, their flying speed was even more affected. It took them over thirty days before they finally arrived at the entrance of the Small World of Exotic Beasts.

However, the sight before them made Li Fan’s expression darken.

The original entrance had been completely consumed by the void. Naturally, the passageway itself no longer existed.

Li Fan pondered for a moment and recalled that when Han Yi exited the Small World, he had done so from another location.

Thus, he set out for that spot.

Fortunately, luck was on their side this time. The entrance was not within the range of the void caverns but was instead hidden beneath pitch-black lava.

"Sect Master, what if we enter and this exit gets swallowed by the void? Wouldn't that mean we’d have no way to return?" Fang Zaiji noticed the issue as well. Just as Li Fan was about to step in, he abruptly stopped him and voiced his concern.

As he spoke, Li Fan cleared away the black lava. Then, he retrieved a thin piece of paper from his storage ring and gently pressed it against the entrance of the Small World.

"Mister Fang, let's go. Elder Liu will handle the preparations for the new passage in the Valley of Longevity."

Li Fan could only watch as thousands upon thousands of beasts knelt beneath the black three-legged pagoda, bowing their heads in reverence toward the black bird, as if pleading for mercy.

The effect was immediate.

With the three-legged pagoda as the center, within a radius of several thousand miles, every movement of the wind and grass was instantly perceivable to Li Fan with just a thought. Moreover, within this area, Li Fan nearly achieved the ability to replace Heaven itself."

Sunshine or storm, wind or rain—everything was under his control with a single thought.

After closing his eyes and searching for a moment, Li Fan furrowed his brows slightly.

"No matter. As long as I remain in this minor world, I will find it sooner or later." Li Fan did not mind.

In the following days, Li Fan and Fang Zaiji traveled across the Beast Realm. Everywhere they went, the beasts had no power to resist and submitted one after another.

...

With just a few casual remarks from the two Dao Integration cultivators, the fate of the Beast Realm’s creatures was already decided.

Ultimately, Xiao Hei had failed the "Heart-Linking Ring" trial and was exiled here by Emperor Sanmo.

...

...

Scenes flashed rapidly before Li Fan’s eyes.

He now knew that Xu Ke had once come to this Beast Realm and met Xiao Hei.

At that time, Xu Ke had already grown into a refined and heroic young man.

Master and beast companion reunited, sitting by the clear pond atop the mountain, chatting for a long time.

But in the end, Xu Ke came in a hurry and left just as quickly.

Xiao Hei originally wanted to follow Xu Ke, but at the time, the restrictions set by Emperor Sanmo were still in place. Moreover, Xu Ke had said that great upheavals were occurring in the outside world, and if Xiao Hei left with him, it might be dangerous.

So, Xu Ke told Xiao Hei to wait here until the time was right—he would come back to take him away.

After their farewell, they communicated a few more times.

Until one day…

Xiao Hei suddenly lost all sense of Xu Ke.

As Xu Ke’s companion beast, even though their master-servant bond had faded, a profound connection still existed between them.

No matter how many millions of miles apart they were, even across multiple worlds—

Xiao Hei could always faintly sense Xu Ke’s existence.

But now, for that connection to completely disappear, there was only one possibility.

Xu Ke was dead.

Chapter 670


As the Heavenly Fate Black Bird, Xiao Hei was naturally well aware of how extraordinary Xu Ke’s fortune was.

A Purple-Gold fourtune, one in a billion. No matter where he went, he could turn misfortune into blessings, transform crises into opportunities, and effortlessly obtain countless treasures and opportunities.

How could someone like him possibly die so easily?

Of course, destiny is not omnipotent. Possessing great fortune does not mean one is immortal. If an individual encounters a calamity beyond what their fate can withstand, they still face the risk of perishing.

However, aside from his own formidable destiny, Xu Ke also had the Red String Protection of Mr. Bai. Of course, this did not mean he lived as an ordinary mortal.

Without those around him realizing it, Xu Ke used the six severed heads of Red Nine-Headed, which had fallen into this world, as incubators. He combined them with gentler beast species he had brought from the Beast Taming Sect, breeding and cultivating various mutant spirit beasts.

His two loyal avian companions, Xiao Qing and Xiao Hong, never understood his true intentions. Yet, they assisted him, meticulously recording all his research findings.

Over the generations, the number and variety of mutant spirit beasts grew exponentially.

Though these mutant creatures were weaker than their original counterparts, their innate aggression had diminished. At the very least, they no longer attacked humans indiscriminately.

Many years passed, and the world witnessed an explosion of new exotic beast species.

Then, one day, Red Nine-Headed reappeared—without warning.

"If I had known earlier, I would have left with Lord Di Yi.. There was no need to suffer this humiliation in the Xuanhuang Realm!"

"Without the great leadership of Lord Di Yi, we demon beasts have indeed declined year after year. Originally, we thought that after the Great Catastrophe descended, humanity would soon be wiped out. But unexpectedly, powerful figures keep emerging one after another! This is simply unjust!"

"That guy from the Purple Heaven Sect is alright, not too outrageous. Speaking of true powerhouses, back in the day, I was right here..."

"Tsk tsk, the scars on my head still ache from time to time!"

The two fearsome demon beasts conversed freely in the sky, treating the many mortals of this world as nothing more than livestock to replenish their blood and vitality.

"Heh heh, big brother, don't take it to heart. Once we devour this realm and restore our strength, we'll go and settle the score with those people!" The Great Peng's eyes were fixed on the shivering mortals below, its saliva nearly dripping.

However, among demon beasts, hierarchy was strict.

"Big brother, please go first!" The Great Peng forcibly suppressed its hunger and flattered its companion.

Red Nine-Headed let out a cold snort, and in an instant, its body expanded once more. Its three remaining heads opened their enormous bloodthirsty mouths, ready to swallow this entire world.

But at that very moment, it caught sight of that familiar streak of red once again.

"How is this possible...?!"

This time, Red Nine-Headed was not as lucky as before.

Threads of silk directly pierced through its body, dragging it down from beyond the world.

Seeing its elder brother being slain in an instant, the Great Peng was so terrified that its soul nearly shattered.

No longer caring about any bonds of kinship, it transformed into a streak of black light and fled in panic.

The mortals, whose eyes could not perceive the full extent of what had transpired, only saw the two ferocious demon beasts about to commit atrocities—only to be slain by an immortal at the last moment.

Rejoicing in their miraculous survival, they erupted into cheers, chanting praises of the immortal’s divine grace and power.

Only Xu Ke, standing among the crowd, silently caressed the now noticeably thinner red string around his wrist, saying nothing.

Chapter 671


The corpse of Red Nine-Headed came at the perfect time to resolve Xu Ke's urgent dilemma.

With the increasing variety and number of exotic beasts, the six original heads used as breeding vessels had gradually been depleted.

Red Nine-Headed, despite being a single entity, possessed nine heads, each with a distinct personality.

Perhaps it was precisely this unique biological trait that allowed the exotic beasts cultivated from it to evolve in countless different directions.

If the breeding materials had been replaced with other equivalent demon beasts—such as that brown peng—it might not have produced the same effect.

Thus, the arrival of Red Nine-Headed was incredibly timely.

According to Xu Ke's calculations, once the number of existing exotic beast species reached a certain threshold, even without the flesh and blood of Red Nine-Headed, the sheer vastness of their population would be sufficient to sustain their self-propagation and evolution.

With that in mind, Xu Ke shifted his focus to how to control these exotic beasts.

Since most of the world's exotic beasts had been cultivated from Red Nine-Headed’s flesh and blood, and given his past research on the Ten Thousand Beasts Reincarnation Wheel, Xu Ke, after several generations of mortal lifetimes, finally devised the Unified Heart Technique—an advanced method of communication and control based on insights from the ancient text True Beast-Taming Technique.

After Xu Ke imparted this technique to the mortal tribes of this world, humans quickly established complete dominion over the land by commanding the countless exotic beasts within it. In doing so, they founded a vast human empire.Xu Ke was revered by the mortals as the "Holy Emperor", while Xiao Qing and Xiao Hong, his two lifelong companions, were honored as the "Holy Masters".

However, despite being exalted as an emperor, Xu Ke showed little interest in the mundane affairs of mortals.

He delegated authority, allowing humanity to govern itself. As for himself, he became increasingly reclusive, engaged in mysterious endeavors that even Xiao Qing and Xiao Hong knew nothing about.

Then, one day, Xu Ke unexpectedly brought a young boy before them.

He claimed that this was his descendant, created through his research on the gift left by the ancient being Di Yi. He had developed a technique known as the "Holy Blood Embryo Transformation", allowing him to generate offspring from his refined blood essence.

The Holy Blood Embryo Transformation was a technique that converted a portion of one’s own blood essence into an embryo capable of inheriting the majority of the creator’s memories.

This embryo required no maternal womb—only sufficient nourishment—and could mature into a human child in just seven days.

Moreover, both physical strength and intelligence would develop to an exceptionally high level.

Staring at the unfamiliar yet eerily familiar child, Xiao Qing and Xiao Hong felt a sense of unease creeping into their hearts.

Their premonition was correct.

Xu Ke instructed them not to interfere with human affairs unless the empire faced an existential crisis.

As for the Holy Embryo, bearing his bloodline, it would only serve as a puppet emperor.

After leaving these final instructions, Xu Ke abruptly departed.

He disclosed nothing about his destination and vanished without a trace.

Until Today, Many years later, Xiao Hei appeared at their doorstep.

By then, Xu Ke's aura had completely vanished—a fact Xiao Qing and Xiao Hong had already sensed.

Faced with Xiao Hei's furious accusations, the two could only remain silent, bearing the weight of her anger.

But after venting, Xiao Hei calmed down.

He knew Xu Ke well—his carefree yet stubborn nature.

Once he made a decision, not even Xiao Qing or Xiao Hong could change it.

When he saw his descendants—the Holy Embryo, now self-propagating through more than a dozen generations—Xiao Hei felt a deep sense of disappointment.

Though traces of Xu Ke’s presence still lingered in them, even their aura faintly resembled his…

But…

It was not Xu Ke.

Without a word, Xiao Hei turned and left the empire, never to return.

For years, Xiao Hei wandered through countless minor worlds, tirelessly searching for the true cause of Xu Ke’s disappearance.

But in the end, he found nothing.

His years of roaming beyond the Primordial World had drained his lifespan at an alarming rate.

As his final moments approached, Xiao Hei returned to the last place where he had seen Xu Ke.

There, lost in memories, he silently awaited death.

...

Xiao Hei’s body completely turned to dust, scattering into the heavens and earth.

Meanwhile, the image of Xiao Hei on the Black Bird Feather within Li Fan’s body grew increasingly vivid.

"Xiao Hei once merged with the world of the Beast Realm. Although he perished when his lifespan ended, by gathering the remnants of his drifting fate and using this feather from his own body..."

"Perhaps a form of rebirth could be achieved."

"However, even if it succeeds, this Xiao Hei will no longer be the same as before."

Li Fan shook his head slightly.

Leaving the wooden house, he arrived at the clear pool atop the mountain peak.

Raising his right hand, in the next moment, a brown jade bottle containing several grams of vital blood flew out from beneath the water, landing in Li Fan's palm.

The bottle was sealed with several layers of restrictions set by Xiao Hei, preserving the blood’s vitality even after thousands of years.

“There’s no rush. I should first uncover the mysteries of Han Yi’s statue.”

After a moment of contemplation, Li Fan put away the jade bottle.

With a single step, he returned to the black three-legged pagoda.

Through his perception, he noticed the disciples of the Medicine King Sect busy in various corners of the Beast Realm.

Judging by their movements, they seemed to be engraving a formation onto the land.

“Elder Liu, what are you all working on?”

After carefully observing for a while but failing to recognize the formation, Li Fan asked curiously.

"Heh, this was my idea!" Before Liu San could respond, Fang Zaiji hurriedly spoke up to claim credit.

"This world, while vast enough for our disciples to relax and train, has spiritual energy that is far too thin, making long-term cultivation difficult. On the other hand, the Longevity Valley is rich in spiritual energy. So, we are planning to transfer some of the spiritual energy from Longevity Valley to this place—of course, only on the condition that it does not affect the valley’s medicinal herbs."

Liu San then added, “For safety, I have already ordered the disciples to investigate whether any other passageways exist. If any are found, Old Fang and I will seal them off together.”

"This way, the only entrance from the outside world will be through Longevity Valley. And if Longevity Valley ever comes under attack and we are unable to resist, we can simply reopen the passage and retreat with ease."

"With this, the safety of our Medicine King Sect will be fully assured!"

Liu San explained proudly.

"Thank you both for your efforts."

Hearing this, Li Fan revealed a satisfied expression and nodded approvingly.

After entrusting Liu San and Fang Zaiji with the task of managing the connection between Longevity Valley and the Beast Realm, Li Fan took the Black Bird Feather infused with the fate of a small world.

He once again approached Han Yi’s stone statue.

As he felt an immense suction force coming from the statue, Li Fan focused his mind. Streams of fortune surged from the Black Bird Feather, counteracting the suction force.

At the same time, he pushed his speed to the limit and flew rapidly toward Han Yi.

Chapter 672


With every inch he advanced, the suction force drawing in his fate grew stronger.

The world’s heavenly fate stored within the Black Bird Feather gushed out uncontrollably, like a flood bursting through a dam, making Li Fan’s expression change slightly.

The terrifying Fortune-draining ability of Han Yi’s stone statue exceeded his expectations.

If it were an ordinary cultivator, they would likely be drained of all their fortune in an instant, bringing calamity upon themselves and dying on the spot!

Even someone as blessed with fortune as Xu Ke would struggle to last long here.

However…

An individual’s fortune alone was indeed incapable of sustaining itself within this fortune-absorbing domain. But the fate of an entire world—now, that was a different story.

After all, the stone statue had a limit to how quickly it could absorb fortune. Even as Li Fan rapidly approached its side, the amount of fortune being drained each moment was nothing compared to the immense reserves stored within the Black Bird Feather—merely a drop in the ocean.

"Han Yi must have encountered the Fisherman before ending up like this. Was it the Fisherman’s doing, or the effect of the Heavenly Fortune Sutra?"

Li Fan did not act recklessly but instead carefully analyzed the situation.

"Neither alive nor dead… something is strange about this."

Previously, through the Cloud-Water Dream Art, Li Fan had gained a general understanding of the Heavenly Fortune Sutra. However, none of its recorded techniques described such an eerie transformation.

If anything came close, it would be a divine ability known as [Severing Fortune, Return to the Pivot].

This technique allowed one to sever their own fortune in moments of life-threatening danger—completely cutting off all ties to the world and entering an realm of the Pivot, where there is no space and no self.

In this state, one’s body and mind would completely stagnate, as if they had escaped into the void itself, making them undetectable by others.

The state of returning to the Pivot may last anywhere from several months to several years, only gradually restoring itself once all external threats had passed.

It was a technique with severe side effects but also unparalleled survival potential.

"Perhaps the Fisherman’s attack interacted with [Severing Fortune, Return to the Pivot], leading to the creation of this stone statue."

After a long period of contemplation, Li Fan came to a realization.

"Although Han Yi activated this life-preserving divine ability, the power gap between him and the Fisherman was simply too vast. He didn’t even have time to fully enter the Returning To Pivot state before he was struck by the Fisherman’s technique."

"Hmm…"

"The Fisherman likely had no intention of killing Han Yi. He was merely searching for clues regarding the Heavenly Calamity Sword within Han Yi’s mind. But even so, Han Yi couldn’t endure it. The sheer force of the attack engulfed him, turning him into this stone-like state."

"Severing fortune means returning one’s fortune to the heavens—essentially forsaking it. But now, this state has transformed into one that absorbs fortune from the outside world instead."

"Is this due to the Fisherman’s attack?"

Li Fan’s thoughts raced, his expression turning serious.

After a while, he emerged from his deep contemplation and gazed at Han Yi’s frozen figure, his eyes cold.

"If this were a normal Return to Pivot state, you would eventually wake up one day. But with the Fisherman’s interference… in your current condition, you will never return to normal again."

"A fate worse than death. Let me put you out of your misery."

At this moment, Han Yi's thoughts were in absolute stasis. Because of this, Li Fan faced no resistance as he roamed freely through Han Yi’s mind. Every secret, even the darkest corners of Han Yi’s heart, were laid bare before Li Fan.

It could be said that at this moment, Li Fan understood Han Yi better than Han Yi himself.

After extracting every single thought from Han Yi’s mind, Li Fan flicked his finger, releasing a streak of pitch-black sword light.

The dark sword light swiftly pierced through the statue’s chest.

In an instant, the statue disintegrated into countless tiny particles, scattering into the heavens and earth.

At the same time, the Fortune-draining Domain that had enveloped the statue vanished without a trace.

Rather than any ominous signs appearing in the sky due to a cultivator’s fall, an invisible storm instead surged in place. The fortune energy that Han Yi had absorbed over time also returned to the heaven and earth following Han Yi’s demise.

Li Fan would not let such a rare opportunity slip by. He immediately activated the Black Bird Feather, seizing the moment before this unclaimed fortune completely dispersed and devoured it all. Then, before anyone could notice the anomaly in this place, he quietly disappeared.

Returning to Longevity Valley, he did not disturb Liu San and the others, who were still busy.

Li Fan entered the Sect Master's secluded cultivation chamber, where he placed the brown jade bottle containing Xu Ke’s essence blood and the materials needed to refine a clone in front of him.

Just as he was about to start the process, an inexplicable sense of unease arose in his heart.

"I am currently at the early Nascent Soul stage. The clone I refine will be limited to the Peak Golden Core stage. I intend to use the clone to cultivate Han Yi’s Heavenly Fortune Sutra. But if I create the clone first and then have it cultivate and break through on its own..."

"The bottleneck imposed by the Calamity of Heaven may be even more rigid than my own, causing unnecessary delays. It would be better for my main body to cultivate first and break through to the Mid Nascent Soul stage. That way, I can achieve twice the result with half the effort."

After contemplating this, Li Fan temporarily put away the materials and ascended into the sky of the Beast Realm.

"I achieved my Nascent Soul through the Five Elements Cave-Heaven. To break through quickly, I must deeply comprehend the Laws of the Five Elements."

"In the Xuanhuang Realm, I would have to spend great effort searching for suitable opportunities. But in this Beast Realm..."

"The laws of the heaven and earth operate, the Five Elements circulate—all within my grasp!"

"Although this small world is of a lower tier, and I must avoid excessive entanglement with it due to what happened to Xiao Hei… It is still more than sufficient to aid my rapid breakthrough to Mid Nascent Soul."

Closing his eyes, Li Fan focused, and in an instant, a massive inverted hourglass seemed to appear in the sky. The Five Elements Power sustaining the Beast Realm was slowly drawn into it. As the Five Elements clashed, deafening explosions echoed through the air. The sky itself transformed into a brilliant tapestry of five-colored radiance, creating a breathtaking spectacle.

Liu San and Fang Zaiji looked up, gazing at Li Fan, who stood motionless above the clouds, and nodded slightly.

"Young Master's aura when cultivating is truly extraordinary. He has quite a bit of the old master’s demeanor!" Liu San said with some relief.

"Heh, I think even Liu Ruchen can’t compare to him!" Fang Zaiji retorted without giving Liu San any face.

Liu San’s expression stiffened, but surprisingly, he did not argue back this time.

"For the new to surpass the old—that is a good thing. Otherwise, wouldn’t our Medicine King Sect be doomed to repeat the past?"

"It is a good thing!" Liu San repeated.

Ordering the disciples not to disturb Li Fan’s cultivation, the two of them then joined forces to set up protective barriers around him, finally putting their minds at ease.

Time flowed on as Li Fan immersed himself in cultivation.

In the blink of an eye, two years passed.

At this point, Li Fan had achieved complete control over his own Five Elements Cave-Heaven and the Beast Realm. He was akin to the very Dao governing these worlds.

Yet, upon closer comparison, he noticed many differences between the two.

The operation and evolution of the Cave-Heaven mostly occurred autonomously, following a set of inherent laws. While he could perceive every change occurring within it, his current level of comprehension was insufficient to fully understand, let alone manipulate or create at will.

The Beast Realm, however, was different. Wind and rain, thunder and lightning, ice and fire—every manifestation of the world's laws could be dictated at a single thought. If he wished, he could freeze the Beast Realm in a fixed state, preventing any future changes. At the same time, he could also reshape it as he pleased. As long as our disciples connect a strand of their divine sense to it before leaving, the formation will activate a counterattack if they are forcibly subjected to a soul search. Unless the enemy's soul is stronger than the combined souls of all the Medicine King Sect cultivators, even in their slumber, they will not be able to extract any information from our disciples' minds."

"The Great Dream Spring and Autumn Formation essentially links the thoughts of all participating cultivators into a grand dreamscape. Just as mortals do not realize they are dreaming, disciples will be unaware of the sealed information. Moreover, even if they are scattered across different regions of the Xuanhuang Realm, they can instantly communicate through the formation without being noticed by outsiders..."

Liu San carefully explained another wondrous function of the Great Dream Spring and Autumn Formation to Li Fan.

"Then I will have to trouble Elder Liu with this matter. Once the disciples go out, they may act freely, only needing to casually inquire about the [Heavenly Spirit Flower] when the opportunity arises. The Heavenly Spirit Flower is a unique treasure of the Tianling Prefecture within the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance—blessed by the essence of the heavens, it is breathtakingly beautiful. However, after the great battle in Tianling Prefecture several years ago, it underwent a strange transformation..."

Liu San did not question Li Fan's reasoning for this order but firmly committed it to memory.

After issuing the necessary instructions, Liu San immediately began organizing the disciples' connection to the formation.

Meanwhile, Li Fan departed ahead of time, leaving Longevity Valley.

Longevity Valley was located within the White Mist Barrier, at the border between Luoyan Prefecture and Lueying Prefecture.

Avoiding patrolling cultivators, Li Fan silently left the mist and arrived in the city of Tiancheng within Luoyan Prefecture.

Although located in the heart of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance, Luoyan Prefecture was not much more prosperous than Congyun Sea. In fact, it had even fewer cultivators. Most of Luoyan Prefecture was barren and lacked resources, but more importantly, it was plagued by strange occurrences.

For example, Li Fan was quite familiar with the [Heart Monkey], which had once broken out in a massive outbreak in this region. Although the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance did not keep detailed records of this event, in previous lifetimes, Li Fan noticed that when purchasing Heart Monkey bones in large quantities, most of them originated from Luoyan Prefecture. This led him to suspect the connection.

At this moment, Luoyan City was rather desolate.

Upon arriving at the Tianxuan Mirror, the first thing Li Fan did was search for information on addictive pills.

Although Liu San had mentioned that the disciples had already inquired and it seemed that the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance did not prohibit such substances, Li Fan knew that many secrets were hidden behind the merit ranking system. Not all knowledge was accessible to ordinary cultivators.

There were plenty of cultivators in the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance who had unknowingly broken taboos and died without ever understanding why.

Since this matter was crucial to his future plans, Li Fan had to confirm the alliance's stance.

His current identity was still that of a "clean slate" with a merit rank of one, but this did not prevent him from gathering information.

Taking out a jade bottle containing "Heart-Desire Ascension Pill", Li Fan prepared to list it for sale in the market.

Suddenly—

"Warning! The pill you are attempting to sell is a prohibited item. Your trading privileges have been temporarily frozen. Please dispose of the contraband immediately."

"Warning..."

A sharp, mechanical voice from the Tianxuan Mirror suddenly sounded, repeating itself incessantly.

Li Fan feigned an expression of extreme shock and innocence:

"What? A contraband item? What do you mean by that?"

"Isn't it just an ordinary pill...?"

The Tianxuan Mirror's cold voice repeated:

"Heart-Desire Ascension Pill—Ranked 3,674 on the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance's list of prohibited circulation items."

"Hazard Level: Grade B-Plus."

"Please dispose of it immediately."

Chapter 676

Any item capable of disrupting the balance of power would inevitably be subjected to strict control.

The fact that it was banned wasn’t surprising—it would have been odd if it weren’t.

From within his palm, he carefully retrieved and recondensed a small amount of the Heart-Desire Ascension Pill's powder, which he had deliberately preserved.

Moments later, a miniature version of the Heart-Desire Ascension Pill, shrunken by dozens of times, appeared in his hand.

Splitting it in two, Li Fan gazed at one half before consuming it.

He wasn’t taking it due to addiction but to verify a certain suspicion he had.

A slight dizziness washed over his mind.

For a fleeting moment, Li Fan felt as if he was once again witnessing the interwoven celestial network—the vast and intricate net of Heaven and Earth’s truths that he had previously glimpsed while comprehending the Human Dao Stardust.

It felt within reach, as if he could grasp it at any moment.

The fundamental truths of Heaven and Earth were laid bare before his eyes!

His eyes widened involuntarily, eager to see more.

But just then, the pill’s effects wore off.

Like an illusion dissolving into mist, the profound scene before him shattered and vanished.

An indescribable emptiness surged into his heart.

Li Fan, driven by his own will, began to resist the effects of the Heart-Desire Ascension Pill.

His face contorted, his entire body trembling uncontrollably.

Exerting all his strength, he fought against the wild, unrestrained desires surging within him.

Li Fan let out a deep breath, steadied his mind, and then swallowed the remaining half of the Ascension Pill.

The moment the desire surged again, he activated the Xuanhuang Immortal Heart Mantra.

Just as before, Li Fan once again saw the immense net woven from the principles of heaven and earth.

But under the influence of the Immortal Heart Mantra, his mind was as calm as still water, completely devoid of impulsive urges.

And so, he waited in silence for the effects to subside.

When the hallucinations before his eyes abruptly vanished and the emptiness and longing resurfaced in his heart, the Xuanhuang Immortal Heart Mantra began to operate slowly. Before these desires could affect his mind, they were instantly absorbed, transformed into nourishment for the mantra itself.

"Claiming to be an immortal before true immortals—what an utter joke." Li Fan felt not even the slightest ripple in his heart.

"No matter what, at least one thing is confirmed. Taking this Heart-Desire Ascension Pill can indeed assist in cultivating the Xuanhuang Immortal Heart Mantra, and I don’t even have to worry about side effects."

Once the desires faded, Li Fan ceased operating the Immortal Heart Mantra.

At present, he was still unable to keep the mantra running instinctively, like breathing. Perhaps only when he fully completed the mantra would he achieve such an effect.

As he left the underground chamber and set off toward Tianling Prefecture, a sudden thought surfaced in his mind.

"The heaven and earth principles seen under the effects of the Heart-Desire Ascension Pill are nothing more than illusions that are nearly real. No matter how many I take, they will never lead to true enlightenment. But on the other hand, if I could witness the real laws of heaven and earth—the kind that cultivators are inherently incapable of comprehending—wouldn’t the effect be even better?"

"After all, no matter how real an illusion may seem, it can never compare to true existence."

"A pill that can genuinely help cultivators attain enlightenment wouldn’t be something the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance would ban. But what if, among a batch of ineffective pseudo-law pills, there were one or two that actually contained a trace of heaven and earth’s true principles…"

Lost in thought, a strange smile crept onto Li Fan’s lips.

When he arrived at Tianling City, he temporarily set his thoughts aside.

He headed straight for a shop that sold Heavenly Spirit Flowers.

"Shopkeeper, give me a pot of Heavenly Spirit Flowers," Li Fan said.

"Ah, sir, you may not know this," the shopkeeper sighed bitterly, "but ever since a few years ago, all the Heavenly Spirit Flowers that have grown in this region have been like this!"

It was as if the flying abode that once soared into the sky, attracting cultivators to explore it, had never existed. All that remained were sparse records about the ancient Chaoyuan Sect.

Tianquan Prefecture was filled with the cave dwellings of the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance’s aristocracy.

Chapter 678


While flying, Li Fan occasionally sensed divine consciousness scanning him from below.

This mountain range was named Shuofeng Mountain.

Indeed, it was purchased by Immortal Sage Fei Xue and named after Shuo Feng. Back when Shuo Feng successfully established his Dao Foundation, this mountain range was a gift from Shuo Feng.

Although called a mountain range, it was actually a meticulously crafted cultivation cave estate. The sixteen peaks were arranged in a formation that gathered spiritual energy from heaven and earth. Moreover, they were forged from rare materials imbued with the laws of the universe. Residing here, even without actively cultivating, one would naturally absorb these laws, steadily refining their power.

Despite its remarkable nature, after Shuo Feng broke through to the Nascent Soul Realm, Immortal Sage Fei Xue gifted him another estate in Tianquan City.

Thus, Shuofeng Mountain gradually fell into neglect.

Now, he only visited occasionally for leisure.

Before long, at the summit of the central peak, Li Fan saw Shuo Feng in a flowing blue robe—

He stood with his hands behind his back, his expression calm and indifferent.

Surrounding him were six late-stage Nascent Soul cultivators, launching relentless attacks against him.

Yet, Shuo Feng did not activate his Cave-Heaven Power—he simply responded with pure spell techniques.

Heavenly Wonder Sword!

Boom! Boom!

Explosions echoed through the mountains.

Shuo Feng showed no mercy.

A puppet woven entirely of thread was having its strings slowly pulled away, unraveling its form.

A deep terror gripped his heart.

Yet, even as his mind raced for a solution, he could not think of a way to counter this Thread Extraction technique.

Li Fan, meanwhile, remained motionless in midair, his finger still locked onto Shuo Feng.

"What an incredible technique, Daoist friend."

He couldn't help but admit it with sincerity.

Chapter 679


"It's just a clever trick, nothing more. Brother Shuo, your Foundation Establishment artifact, the [Sword], is not adept at initiating attacks, but its defensive counterattacks are unparalleled. However, this [Thread Extraction] technique mimics the natural cycle of birth, aging, sickness, and death—the changes of human existence. Rather than an attack, it is more of a state-inflicting ability. That is why it did not trigger the [Sword]'s counterattack."

Having won the duel, Li Fan did not show any arrogance. Instead, he took the initiative to explain the reasoning to Shuo Feng.

Back when he was cultivating within the Root of Heaven and Earth, nurturing the Five Elements Cave-Heaven, Li Fan had experienced his own body being woven like delicate silk threads, continuously being drawn out.

At that time, he had gained an initial insight.

However, he was still far from being able to directly manifest it as a divine ability in the real world. It wasn’t until now—after gaining control over the Beast Realm's fate and breaking through to the Mid Nascent Soul stage—that he had almost become akin to the Dao of a small world itself.

In his mind, all life and death were but a single thought away.

Through this, Li Fan developed an entirely new and profound understanding of the composition and disintegration of all things.

Thus, the divine ability [Thread Extraction] was born.

As he explained to Shuo Feng, strictly speaking, [Thread Extraction] is not a direct offensive technique. Instead, it attaches an accelerating decay effect to the target—it is a transformation of the target itself.

Just as mortals inevitably age and die, all things in existence eventually reach their end and dissolve back into the world. [Thread Extraction] merely hastens this natural process.During his battle with Shuo Feng, Li Fan had demonstrated [Thread Extraction] at full power, making it appear overwhelmingly destructive. However, it had one critical weakness—its execution required continuous casting. If interrupted or disrupted, its effectiveness would be significantly diminished.

It was only because Shuo Feng's cultivation emphasized defensive counterattacks that [Thread Extraction] was particularly effective against him.

In reality, the optimal usage of Thread Extraction was not in the explosive, rapid application used in the duel. Instead, it should be employed covertly, working silently over time—gradually unraveling a target’s “threads” without them noticing.

By extending the timespan, the target would not develop visible wounds as Shuo Feng had during the battle.

Instead, they would simply feel increasingly weak, their body inexplicably deteriorating, their spirit and vitality steadily fading—yet they would never be able to pinpoint the cause.

In the end, they would watch helplessly as their life force withered away, perishing in agony.

The phrase "life fades like drawn silk" perfectly encapsulates the technique’s essence.

It was, without a doubt, an exceptional assassination technique—even surpassing many formless killing arts in effectiveness.

As someone who always kept a trump card hidden, Li Fan had deliberately concealed the true lethality of [Thread Extraction] during his match with Shuo Feng.

"Brother Li, you once praised me as a natural talent, but I believe your comprehension surpasses mine by far. This [Thread Extraction] technique is truly remarkable!"

Despite being defeated, Shuo Feng showed no anger. Instead, his attitude had grown noticeably more friendly.

The fleeting cold killing intent he had exhibited earlier had now vanished as if it had never existed.

"Brother Shuo, you flatter me. It was merely an insight I gained while traveling." Li Fan replied with a faint smile.

"Brother Li, there's no need for false modesty! In the Ten Thousand Immortal Alliance, there are countless who claim to be geniuses, but few can comprehend divine abilities on their own as you have!"

As he spoke, Shuo Feng patted his body. In an instant, a flash of white light enveloped him, and his attire changed.

Leading Li Fan up the mountain, he guided him to a small pavilion at the peak, inviting him inside.

The fragrance of the tea filled the air, invigorating the spirit.

Shuo Feng took a sip and said, "Brother Li, I have yet to think of a way to counter your divine ability. But once inspiration strikes, I will certainly seek you out for another match!"

Li Fan nodded slightly. "I’ll be waiting."

Shuo Feng laughed heartily. "Refreshing! Brother Li, your temperament suits me well! You’re far better than those spineless flatterers, who lack ability yet seek favor through sycophancy!"

Li Fan did not continue the topic but instead changed the subject.

"Speaking of sycophants, I actually have a matter where I’ll need your help, Brother Shuo."

"Oh? What is it? Speak freely."

Li Fan then expressed his desire to improve his merit ranking.

Just how profound was his understanding of the Dao of the Sword?

Just how deep was his comprehension of the very laws of the world?

His name: Situ Yao.

"Idlers, keep out."

Surprisingly, rather than feeling frustrated, the defeated disciples were overjoyed, as if they had gained immense enlightenment from their sparring session.

Realizing this was a rare opportunity, the disciples were eager to take their turn.

Seizing the moment, Li Fan stepped forward before anyone else and stood before Mr. Bai.

Even though he could overlook all beings in the Xuanhuang Realm as insignificant, in front of this enigmatic Mr. Bai, Li Fan couldn't help but feel a slight nervousness.

Since he had entered the Fallen Immortal Realm in an incarnated form, he was unable to use his own divine abilities.

Taking a deep breath, Li Fan recalled the cultivation technique of the body he had possessed—Ji Zhaoxuan.

It was an obscure technique that condensed alchemic energy into swords.

However, mastery of one technique leads to mastery of all.

By relying on sword energy, he could still manifest a portion of the power of his divine ability, Heaven-Shattering Heart Sword.

"Please enlighten me, sir."

Li Fan spoke in a deep voice.

In the next moment, with a shift of his mind, several sword auras shrouded in black demonic energy materialized around Mr. Bai.

The black swords let out piercing cries, as if they sought to shred Mr. Bai into countless pieces.

"Not bad. The creativity is commendable, but… does your heart truly align with your sword?"

Just as the black swords were about to strike Mr. Bai, they suddenly halted mid-air.

Time seemed to freeze.

In the eerie stillness, Li Fan faintly heard Mr. Bai’s gentle voice.

"If you treat your sword as a mere tool, then your sword will treat you as a tool in return."

Boom!

Like a bolt of lightning piercing through the fog, countless insights burst into Li Fan’s mind.

Endless possibilities for evolving the Heaven-Shattering Heart Sword unfolded before him.

So many, in fact, that he felt overwhelmed, unable to decide which path to take.

Situ Yao was undisputedly the strongest in the Heavenly Sword Sect. He hadn't fought seriously in years, and no one knew his true limits.

Yet, this absolute powerhouse of the Xuanhuang Realm, before even making a move, had already admitted he wasn’t Mr. Bai’s match!

Situ Yao was not the kind of person to lie or downplay his abilities. If he said he couldn't win, then it meant he truly believed it.

So, who exactly was this unremarkable-looking man? Where did he come from?

"To do the impossible, despite knowing it's impossible—isn't that your life’s creed, Situ?" Mr. Bai encouraged, seeing that Situ Yao was hesitating.

His tone was light, but to Situ Yao, the words hit like thunder.

A sudden surge of energy erupted from his body. His eyes narrowed as he scrutinized Mr. Bai, a flicker of doubt crossing his gaze.

However, being a true powerhouse, Situ Yao quickly suppressed his doubts and focused his mind.

"If that's the case, then I won't hold back," he said solemnly.

He took a step forward, raised his right hand, and swept his gaze across the disciples of the Heavenly Sword Sect who were watching.

Then, with utmost seriousness, he called out:

"Junior Brothers, bring your swords!"

In that instant, every single cultivator of the Heavenly Sword Sect—regardless of their location—heard Situ Yao's words.

They were momentarily stunned, but without the slightest hesitation, they all threw their lifebound flying swords into the sky.

As the Senior Brother of the sect, Situ Yao had always taken great care of the new disciples. He never put on airs or distanced himself. Whenever his junior disciples were in trouble, he would always stand up for them—even if it meant being biased in their favor.

He had held the title of Senior Brother for so many years. Every disciple, whether directly or indirectly, had received his kindness.

Now that he was asking to borrow their swords—how could they refuse?

And so, in the blink of an eye, tens of thousands of flying swords soared into the sky.

All of them surged toward Situ Yao.

For disciples of the Heavenly Sword Sect, half of their cultivation and battle strength resided in their lifebound flying swords.

From the Foundation Establishment stage onward, they poured their blood, sweat, and soul into forging their flying swords, strengthening their durability and lethality, gradually achieving complete harmony with them.

Thus, when Situ Yao uttered "Bring your swords",

It was not just tens of thousands of swords that took flight—

It was half of the entire Heavenly Sword Sect’s battle power.

Countless sword auras interwove, illuminating the sky in dazzling colors.

Situ Yao raised his hand, fingers shifting into a sword gesture.

The storm of swords roared toward their target—Mr. Bai.

Countless flying swords gathered into one, seemingly forming a giant sword that spanned the heavens and earth in the void.

It locked onto Mr. Bai from afar and arrived in an instant.

It seemed that in the next second, Mr. Bai would be pierced by ten thousand swords, dying a tragic death on the spot.

However, there was not the slightest trace of panic on Mr. Bai's face.

He merely revealed a faint smile and then raised the wooden sword in his hand.

Facing the ten thousand swords.

Buzz...

A resonant sword hum echoed from the wooden sword.

In that instant, time seemed to come to a halt.

Wherever the sword hum passed, the countless flying swords first stopped in mid-flight, frozen in place.

Then, their blades trembled violently, as if struggling fiercely against some invisible force.

Finally…

The first flying sword lost control and fell from the sky.

It plunged into the ground, its blade quivering slightly.

Then came the second, the third…

In the blink of an eye, countless flying swords rained down from the sky like a torrential storm, embedding themselves into the earth.

Densely packed, they formed an impenetrable graveyard of swords within a small area.

Yet, not a single one had touched even the corner of Mr. Bai’s robe.

The ultimate killing move that Situ Yao had cultivated for most of his life had been effortlessly neutralized.

At that moment, the entire Heavenly Sword Sect fell into a deathly silence.

The wooden sword in Mr. Bai's hand emitted another sword hum.

Then, all the disciples, including Li Fan, witnessed a scene that would remain etched in their memories forever.

All the flying swords embedded in the ground suddenly bent toward Mr. Bai's direction of their own accord.

As if paying homage to their emperor, they bowed in reverence.

Mr. Bai stood calmly, holding his wooden sword, his expression indifferent.

“You are…” At this moment, as if recalling something, Situ Yao’s pupils shrank abruptly, and he blurted out in shock.

Mr. Bai smiled slightly and gently waved his wooden sword once more.

In an instant, the countless flying swords returned to their respective owners.

“I came today to ask for a favor.” Having effortlessly resolved the conflict, Mr. Bai casually tossed his wooden sword aside and smiled as he addressed Situ Yao.

“Please, speak.” Situ Yao's tone was filled with deep respect.

Mr. Bai glanced around but did not immediately speak.

Situ Yao suddenly slapped his forehead as if realizing something. “Please, follow me.”

With that, he led Mr. Bai toward the grand hall of the Heavenly Sword Sect.

Only the many cultivators still standing in shock remained, unable to recover from the scene they had just witnessed.

“So this… is the true power of a supreme expert from the ancient cultivation world.” Li Fan was also awed by the overwhelming might of Situ Yao’s sword strike.

He had a vague feeling that if that single massive sword had been successfully unleashed, it could have torn a rift in the Xuanhuang Realm itself.

And yet, the fact that Mr. Bai had so casually neutralized the attack…

Somehow, it did not surprise him at all.

Chapter 683


After all, based on the current information available, Mr. Bai’s status has risen to an even higher level.

He seems to have surpassed the power limits of ordinary cultivators, and he may even be connected to the True Immortal who created the entire Fallen Immortal Realm.

At that moment, under everyone’s watchful eyes, a figure suddenly flew towards the wooden sword that Mr. Bai had thrown.

Ignoring the murderous gazes of the other cultivators who wished to kill him, Li Fan took a deep breath and gripped the wooden sword tightly.

In that fleeting instant, it felt as if a radiant white light illuminated the heavens and earth.Countless profound mysteries of the "sword" unfolded within his mind in an instant.

But in the very next moment…

A violent tremor shook the ground, and the wooden sword was forcibly wrenched from his grasp.

Li Fan snapped out of his enlightenment.

No one knew what he and Situ Yao had spoken about.

But from that day onward, the Heavenly Sword Sect bore a new mission:

To forge a legendary weapon that only exists in the stories of the sect— the World-Rifting Divine Weapon.

At any cost.

As an inner disciple, Li Fan was naturally required to contribute as well.

Like the other disciples, his task was to absorb insights from the wooden sword and channel them into a Sword Embryo—a type of primal stone.

One by one, countless primal stones infused with their sword comprehension were thrown into the massive crater at the back of the Heavenly Sword Sect.

Using molten flames, they forged the prototype of the World-Rifting Divine Weapon.

No one knew the true purpose of this divine weapon, but Senior Brother Situ Yao held immense authority, and the unparalleled power displayed by Mr. Bai had left the entire Heavenly Sword Sect in awe.

Thus, the disciples held no resentment toward this endeavor.

On the contrary, by comprehending the wooden sword’s mysteries, they could elevate their own cultivation and mastery of the sword. So why not?

And just like that, time passed swiftly.

Before Li Fan could fully savor the experience, the journey through the Fallen Immortal Realm had already come to an end.

As the surrounding scene faded, Li Fan found himself back in the warped, transparent bubble of space.

The three visions before him had dimmed and were no longer selectable.

However, he did not immediately leave. Instead, he silently reflected on everything he had witnessed in the Heavenly Sword Sect.

"Based on the timeline, the [Heaven Sword Sect's Divine Refinement] happened after [Ningyuan's Acquisition of the Longevity Fruit] but before the [Beast-Taming Sect’s Upheaval]."

"I never expected that the creation of the World-Rifting Divine Weapon was also Mr. Bai’s directive… Raising a Rift Whale, forging a World-Rifting Divine Weapon…"

"What exactly is Mr. Bai planning?"

"On the surface, it seems like he is preparing for an impending catastrophe, creating multiple contingencies and backup plans. But is that truly the case?"

Judging others by oneself, Li Fan always felt that behind everything Mr. Bai did, there might be other unknown secrets.

However, Mr. Bai was an extremely mysterious figure. His thoughts were not something that Li Fan could fathom at his current level.

After pondering for a long time, Li Fan still came up empty-handed and had no choice but to set it aside for now.

"Within the Fallen Immortal Realm, there is also a condensation of the Sword Dao’s laws. If I could take it out of the Fallen Immortal Realm, what kind of consequences would it bring?"

Back in the mortal small world, Li Fan had conducted a similar experiment before.

He understood that in the natural order, two identical heavenly treasures could not exist.

If, for some special reason, two did come into existence, then eventually, they would merge and elevate each other.

The weaker one would vanish, while the stronger one would remain.

"Although the wooden sword in Shuo Feng’s hands is said to be a wonder of the heavens, I have always felt that the one Mr. Bai wielded thousands of years ago was its complete form."

"After enduring a thousand years of trials and tribulations, its power may have weakened."

"So if I can take the wooden sword out, wouldn’t that mean..."

as if countless sharp blades were cutting through his body from the inside.

"Not only is its nature violent and difficult for cultivators to absorb, but it also naturally contains the attribute of 'Rend'..."
